# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI Facebook 社團留言自動解盤機器人 V1.0 (黑科技社群引流神器)】
# 檔案路徑：C:\test_c\fb_comment_responder.py
# 核心任務：
# 1. 監聽 FB 社團置頂貼文之社員留言。
# 2. 社員留言「股號 (例: 2454 或 2454 說明)」，自動於該樓層回覆完整圖文戰報！
# 3. 具備已回覆留言快取 (避免重複回覆) ✕ 智能防封間隔 ✕ 雙核心大模型解盤。

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import json
import re
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

# 強制 UTF-8 輸出
if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

# 引入已驗證成熟的數據查詢與 AI 解盤模組
from zen_ai_bot1 import query_stock_full_data, capture_stock_chart, generate_ai_analysis, clean_stock_code

# =========================================================================
# 🛠️【1. 系統配置區】
# =========================================================================
FB_USER_DATA_DIR = r"C:\test_c\fb_user_data"
CACHE_FILE = r"C:\test_c\fb_replied_comments.json"

# 🟢 請填入您在 FB 社團中發布的「置頂解盤專區貼文網址」
# (例如: https://www.facebook.com/groups/YOUR_GROUP_ID/permalink/123456789/)
FB_TARGET_POST_URL = "https://www.facebook.com/groups/YOUR_GROUP_ID/permalink/YOUR_POST_ID/"

# 巡檢間隔 (秒) - 建議 45 ~ 60 秒，避免被 FB 偵測為機械行為
POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 50

# =========================================================================
# 💾【2. 已回覆留言快取管理 (防重複回覆)】
# =========================================================================
def load_replied_cache():
    if os.path.exists(CACHE_FILE):
        try:
            with open(CACHE_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return set(json.load(f))
        except Exception:
            return set()
    return set()

def save_replied_cache(replied_set):
    try:
        with open(CACHE_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(list(replied_set), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 快取儲存異常: {e}")

# =========================================================================
# 🔍【3. 社員留言股號與指令解析器】
# =========================================================================
def parse_stock_command(text):
    """
    從社員留言中精準提取股票代號 (支援: 2330, 2454說明, 2317 說明R, 台積電 等)
    """
    if not text:
        return None, False

    clean_t = text.strip()
    is_use_openrouter = clean_t.upper().endswith("R")
    if is_use_openrouter:
        clean_t = clean_t[:-1].strip()

    # 1. 匹配 4~6 碼數字股號 (例: 2330, 2454, 6442, 0050)
    match = re.search(r'\b(\d{4,6})\b', clean_t)
    if match:
        return match.group(1), is_use_openrouter

    # 2. 若輸入中文名稱 (例: 台積電, 聯發科, 鴻海)
    name_match = re.search(r'([\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,6})', clean_t)
    if name_match:
        return name_match.group(1), is_use_openrouter

    return None, is_use_openrouter

# =========================================================================
# ✍️【4. 生成專屬 Facebook 留言回覆文案】
# =========================================================================
def build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, user_name="社員"):
    now_full_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')
    r5_sign = "+" if stock['ret5'] >= 0 else ""
    r10_sign = "+" if stock['ret10'] >= 0 else ""
    r20_sign = "+" if stock['ret20'] >= 0 else ""
    eps_str = f"{stock['target_eps']:.2f}元" if stock['target_eps'] > 0 else "無"
    px_str = f"{stock['target_price']:.1f}元" if stock['target_price'] > 0 else "無"

    reply_text = (
        f"👋 您好 @{user_name}！為您送上【{stock['name']} ({stock['code']})】Zen AI 深度量化解析：\n\n"
        f"📊 【即時關鍵指標】：\n"
        f"• 盤中現價：{stock['price']} 元\n"
        f"• 週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']} (MA60: {stock['m60']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 60M KD值：{stock['k_60m']:.2f} / {stock['d_60m']:.2f} (OSC: {stock['osc_60m']})\n"
        f"• 日線5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f} 元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f} 元\n"
        f"• 法人共識目標價：{px_str} (預估EPS: {eps_str})\n"
        f"• 3-Way 最佳離場戰術：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n"
        f"📊 戰情室四大圖表深度解盤：\n\n"
        f"{ai_reply.strip()}\n\n"
        f"【📌 指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n"
        f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK (站 5MA 買進)：\n"
        f"├── 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w5']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r5_sign}{stock['ret5']:.2f}%\n"
        f"├── ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w10']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r10_sign}{stock['ret10']:.2f}%\n"
        f"└── 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w20']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r20_sign}{stock['ret20']:.2f}%\n"
        f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"⏰ 分析時間：{now_full_str} | (附圖已生成於下方)"
    )
    return reply_text

# =========================================================================
# 🤖【5. Playwright 留言監聽與自動回覆核心】
# =========================================================================
async def run_fb_comment_responder():
    replied_set = load_replied_cache()

    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Facebook 社團留言自動解盤機器人 V1.0】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print(f"🎯 監控目標貼文: {FB_TARGET_POST_URL}")
    print(f"💾 已記錄回覆留言數: {len(replied_set)} 則")
    print(f"⏱️ 巡檢間隔: {POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS} 秒")
    print("=" * 70)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
            user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA_DIR,
            headless=False,  # 設為 False 便於觀察運作，穩定後可改 True
            viewport={"width": 1366, "height": 900}
        )
        page = await browser.new_page()

        while True:
            try:
                now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')
                print(f"\n[{now_str}] 🔍 正在掃描社團貼文最新留言...")
                await page.goto(FB_TARGET_POST_URL, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=35000)
                await asyncio.sleep(4)

                # 確保展開「所有留言」
                try:
                    sort_btn = page.locator("div[role='button']:has-text('最相關'), div[role='button']:has-text('所有留言')")
                    if await sort_btn.count() > 0:
                        await sort_btn.first.click()
                        await asyncio.sleep(1)
                        all_comments_option = page.locator("div[role='menuitem']:has-text('所有留言')")
                        if await all_comments_option.count() > 0:
                            await all_comments_option.first.click()
                            await asyncio.sleep(2)
                except Exception:
                    pass

                # 定位留言區塊
                comments = page.locator("div[role='article'][aria-label*='留言'], div[role='article'][aria-label*='Comment'], ul > li:has(div[dir='auto'])")
                comment_count = await comments.count()
                print(f"  └─ 找到 {comment_count} 則留言結構")

                for i in range(comment_count):
                    c_el = comments.nth(i)
                    raw_text = await c_el.inner_text()

                    # 提取社員名稱與留言文字
                    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
                    if not lines:
                        continue

                    user_name = lines[0] if len(lines) > 0 else "社員"
                    comment_content = " ".join(lines[1:]) if len(lines) > 1 else lines[0]

                    # 建立唯一留言指紋 (作者 + 內容前 30 字)
                    comment_fingerprint = f"{user_name}_{comment_content[:30]}"

                    if comment_fingerprint in replied_set:
                        continue  # 已回覆過，跳過

                    # 解析是否包含股票代號
                    stock_code, is_use_r = parse_stock_command(comment_content)
                    if not stock_code:
                        continue

                    print(f"\n🎯 【發現新解盤請求】社員: {user_name} ➔ 指令: 「{comment_content}」 ➔ 提取股號: {stock_code}")

                    # 1. 查詢量化數據
                    stock = query_stock_full_data(stock_code)
                    if not stock:
                        print(f"  └─ ⚠️ 查無股票數據: {stock_code}")
                        replied_set.add(comment_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                        continue

                    # 2. 截取四大圖表
                    print(f"  └─ 📸 正在為 {stock['name']} 截取四大聯動圖表...")
                    photo_path = await capture_stock_chart(stock['code'])

                    # 3. 調用大模型產出五段解盤
                    print(f"  └─ 🧠 正在調用 AI 大腦生成專業圖表解說...")
                    prompt_chart = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請為社員 @{user_name} 撰寫【{stock['name']}({stock['code']})】的「四大聯動圖表深度視覺解讀」：
- 盤中價：{stock['price']} 元 | 5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f}元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f}元 | 60MA：{stock['m60']:.2f}元 (週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']})
- 60M KD：{stock['k_60m']:.2f}/{stock['d_60m']:.2f} | 60M OSC：{stock['osc_60m']} (氣象：{stock['weather']})
- 籌碼共振：{stock['hit_count']}維共振【{stock['tag']}】，實戰總分：{stock['score']:.2f}分
- 最適離場戰術：{stock['optimal']}

請依照下列格式輸出，每段50~70字，一針見血：
📌 圖一：價格與均線防守
📌 圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振
📌 圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀
📌 圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振
📌 指揮官實戰總結指引"""

                    ai_reply, _ = generate_ai_analysis(prompt_chart, prefer_openrouter=is_use_r)

                    # 4. 組裝回覆文字
                    reply_msg = build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, user_name)

                    # 5. Playwright 點擊該留言下方的「回覆」按鈕
                    print(f"  └─ ✍️ 正在點擊 @{user_name} 留言下方的「回覆」按鈕...")
                    reply_btn = c_el.locator("div[role='button']:has-text('回覆'), span:has-text('回覆')")
                    if await reply_btn.count() > 0:
                        await reply_btn.first.click()
                        await asyncio.sleep(2)

                        # 定位該回覆輸入框
                        active_input = page.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']")
                        if await active_input.count() > 0:
                            # 填入文字
                            await active_input.last.fill(reply_msg)
                            await asyncio.sleep(2)

                            # 上傳四大圖表圖片
                            if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
                                file_input = page.locator("input[type='file'][accept*='image']")
                                if await file_input.count() > 0:
                                    await file_input.last.set_input_files(photo_path)
                                    print("  └─ 🖼️ 已上傳四大圖表圖片至留言回覆框...")
                                    await asyncio.sleep(4)

                            # 按 Enter 發送回覆
                            await active_input.last.press("Enter")
                            print(f"  └─ 🎉 成功為社員 @{user_name} 的【{stock['name']}】完成圖文解盤回覆！")
                            await asyncio.sleep(3)

                    # 6. 記錄已回覆，防止重複
                    replied_set.add(comment_fingerprint)
                    save_replied_cache(replied_set)

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 巡檢過程異常 (將於下個週期重試): {e}")

            await asyncio.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(run_fb_comment_responder())

取得 Facebook 社團特定貼文網址（`FB_TARGET_POST_URL`）非常簡單，以下提供 2 種最快、最精準的方法： --- ### 🏆 方法一：點擊貼文的「發布時間」（最推薦、最乾淨） 1. 用電腦瀏覽器打開您的 Facebook 社團，找到該篇「置頂解盤互動貼文」。 2. 在貼文上方作者名稱的下方，找到 發布時間（例如顯示：`剛剛`、`2小時`、`昨天下午2:00` 或 `9月9日`）。 3. 在「發布時間」上方按滑鼠右鍵 ➔ 選擇 「複製連結網址」（Copy link address）。 4. 貼到記事本中，這串網址就是專屬的貼文網址！ --- ### 🏆 方法二：透過貼文右上角的「`...`」選單 1. 在該篇貼文的右上角，點擊 「`...`」（三個小點點）。 2. 在彈出的選單中，點選 「複製連結」（Copy link）。 3. 貼上即取得該篇貼文的專屬網址。 --- ### 💡 網址長相範例與清洗技巧 複製出來的網址通常會有以下幾種標準格式（皆可直接使用）： #### 格式 1：數字 ID 型態（最常見）
text
https://www.facebook.com/groups/123456789012345/posts/987654321098765/
或
text
https://www.facebook.com/groups/123456789012345/permalink/987654321098765/
#### 格式 2：自訂英文社團名稱型態

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI Facebook 社團留言自動解盤機器人 V1.1 (精準特徵 ✕ 防關閉重連版)】
# 檔案路徑：C:\test_c\fb_comment_responder.py

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import json
import re
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

from zen_ai_bot1 import query_stock_full_data, capture_stock_chart, generate_ai_analysis, clean_stock_code

# =========================================================================
# 🛠️【1. 系統配置區】
# =========================================================================
FB_USER_DATA_DIR = r"C:\test_c\fb_user_data"
CACHE_FILE = r"C:\test_c\fb_replied_comments.json"

# 🟢 您的社團專屬貼文網址
FB_TARGET_POST_URL = "https://www.facebook.com/groups/1592528919074970/posts/1607083447619517/"

# 巡檢間隔 (秒)
POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 45

# =========================================================================
# 💾【2. 已回覆留言快取管理】
# =========================================================================
def load_replied_cache():
    if os.path.exists(CACHE_FILE):
        try:
            with open(CACHE_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return set(json.load(f))
        except Exception:
            return set()
    return set()

def save_replied_cache(replied_set):
    try:
        with open(CACHE_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(list(replied_set), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 快取儲存異常: {e}")

# =========================================================================
# 🔍【3. 社員留言股號解析器】
# =========================================================================
def parse_stock_command(text):
    if not text:
        return None, False

    clean_t = text.strip()
    is_use_openrouter = clean_t.upper().endswith("R")
    if is_use_openrouter:
        clean_t = clean_t[:-1].strip()

    # 匹配 4~6 碼數字股號 (例: 2330, 2454, 6442, 0050)
    match = re.search(r'\b(\d{4,6})\b', clean_t)
    if match:
        return match.group(1), is_use_openrouter

    # 匹配中文股名 (例: 台積電, 聯發科, 鴻海)
    name_match = re.search(r'([\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,6})', clean_t)
    if name_match:
        return name_match.group(1), is_use_openrouter

    return None, is_use_openrouter

# =========================================================================
# ✍️【4. 生成專屬 Facebook 留言回覆文案】
# =========================================================================
def build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, user_name="社員"):
    now_full_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')
    r5_sign = "+" if stock['ret5'] >= 0 else ""
    r10_sign = "+" if stock['ret10'] >= 0 else ""
    r20_sign = "+" if stock['ret20'] >= 0 else ""
    eps_str = f"{stock['target_eps']:.2f}元" if stock['target_eps'] > 0 else "無"
    px_str = f"{stock['target_price']:.1f}元" if stock['target_price'] > 0 else "無"

    reply_text = (
        f"👋 您好 @{user_name}！為您送上【{stock['name']} ({stock['code']})】Zen AI 深度量化解析：\n\n"
        f"📊 【即時關鍵指標】：\n"
        f"• 盤中現價：{stock['price']} 元\n"
        f"• 週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']} (MA60: {stock['m60']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 60M KD值：{stock['k_60m']:.2f} / {stock['d_60m']:.2f} (OSC: {stock['osc_60m']})\n"
        f"• 日線5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f} 元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f} 元\n"
        f"• 法人目標價：{px_str} (預估EPS: {eps_str})\n"
        f"• 3-Way 最佳離場戰術：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n"
        f"📊 戰情室四大圖表深度解盤：\n\n"
        f"{ai_reply.strip()}\n\n"
        f"【📌 指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n"
        f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK (站 5MA 買進)：\n"
        f"├── 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w5']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r5_sign}{stock['ret5']:.2f}%\n"
        f"├── ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w10']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r10_sign}{stock['ret10']:.2f}%\n"
        f"└── 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w20']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r20_sign}{stock['ret20']:.2f}%\n"
        f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"⏰ 分析時間：{now_full_str} | (附圖已生成於下方)"
    )
    return reply_text

# =========================================================================
# 🤖【5. Playwright 留言監聽與自動回覆核心】
# =========================================================================
async def run_fb_comment_responder():
    replied_set = load_replied_cache()

    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Facebook 社團留言自動解盤機器人 V1.1】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print(f"🎯 監控目標貼文: {FB_TARGET_POST_URL}")
    print(f"💾 已記錄回覆留言數: {len(replied_set)} 則")
    print(f"⏱️ 巡檢間隔: {POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS} 秒")
    print("=" * 70)

    while True:
        try:
            async with async_playwright() as p:
                browser = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
                    user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA_DIR,
                    headless=False,
                    viewport={"width": 1366, "height": 900}
                )
                page = await browser.new_page()

                while True:
                    now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')
                    print(f"\n[{now_str}] 🔍 正在掃描社團貼文最新留言...")
                    
                    try:
                        await page.goto(FB_TARGET_POST_URL, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=35000)
                        await asyncio.sleep(3)

                        # 模擬微滾動以觸發留言區塊渲染
                        await page.evaluate("window.scrollBy(0, 500)")
                        await asyncio.sleep(2)

                        # 嘗試切換為「所有留言」
                        try:
                            sort_btn = page.locator("div[role='button']:has-text('最相關'), div[role='button']:has-text('所有留言')")
                            if await sort_btn.count() > 0:
                                await sort_btn.first.click()
                                await asyncio.sleep(1)
                                all_comments_option = page.locator("div[role='menuitem']:has-text('所有留言')")
                                if await all_comments_option.count() > 0:
                                    await all_comments_option.first.click()
                                    await asyncio.sleep(2)
                        except Exception:
                            pass

                        # 🎯 核心優化：精準定位含有「回覆」按鈕的留言卡片
                        comments = page.locator("div[role='article']:has(div[role='button']:has-text('回覆')), div[role='article']:has(span:has-text('回覆'))")
                        comment_count = await comments.count()

                        if comment_count == 0:
                            # 備援選擇器
                            comments = page.locator("div[role='article'][aria-label*='留言'], div[role='article'][aria-label*='Comment']")
                            comment_count = await comments.count()

                        print(f"  └─ 找到 {comment_count} 則社員留言")

                        for i in range(comment_count):
                            c_el = comments.nth(i)
                            raw_text = await c_el.inner_text()

                            lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
                            if not lines:
                                continue

                            user_name = lines[0] if len(lines) > 0 else "社員"
                            comment_content = " ".join(lines[1:]) if len(lines) > 1 else lines[0]

                            comment_fingerprint = f"{user_name}_{comment_content[:30]}"

                            if comment_fingerprint in replied_set:
                                continue

                            stock_code, is_use_r = parse_stock_command(comment_content)
                            if not stock_code:
                                continue

                            print(f"\n🎯 【發現新解盤請求】社員: {user_name} ➔ 留言: 「{comment_content}」 ➔ 股號: {stock_code}")

                            # 1. 查詢量化數據
                            stock = query_stock_full_data(stock_code)
                            if not stock:
                                print(f"  └─ ⚠️ 查無股票數據: {stock_code}")
                                replied_set.add(comment_fingerprint)
                                save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                                continue

                            # 2. 截取四大圖表
                            print(f"  └─ 📸 正在為 {stock['name']} 截取四大聯動圖表...")
                            photo_path = await capture_stock_chart(stock['code'])

                            # 3. 生成四大圖表解盤
                            print(f"  └─ 🧠 正在調用 AI 大腦生成專業圖表解說...")
                            prompt_chart = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請為社員 @{user_name} 撰寫【{stock['name']}({stock['code']})】的「四大聯動圖表深度視覺解讀」：
- 盤中價：{stock['price']} 元 | 5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f}元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f}元 | 60MA：{stock['m60']:.2f}元 (週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']})
- 60M KD：{stock['k_60m']:.2f}/{stock['d_60m']:.2f} | 60M OSC：{stock['osc_60m']} (氣象：{stock['weather']})
- 籌碼共振：{stock['hit_count']}維共振【{stock['tag']}】，實戰總分：{stock['score']:.2f}分
- 最適離場戰術：{stock['optimal']}

請依照下列格式輸出，每段50~70字，一針見血：
📌 圖一：價格與均線防守
📌 圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振
📌 圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀
📌 圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振
📌 指揮官實戰總結指引"""

                            ai_reply, _ = generate_ai_analysis(prompt_chart, prefer_openrouter=is_use_r)

                            reply_msg = build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, user_name)

                            # 4. 點擊「回覆」按鈕
                            print(f"  └─ ✍️ 正在點擊 @{user_name} 的「回覆」按鈕...")
                            reply_btn = c_el.locator("div[role='button']:has-text('回覆'), span:has-text('回覆')")
                            if await reply_btn.count() > 0:
                                await reply_btn.first.click()
                                await asyncio.sleep(2)

                                active_input = page.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']")
                                if await active_input.count() > 0:
                                    await active_input.last.fill(reply_msg)
                                    await asyncio.sleep(2)

                                    if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
                                        file_input = page.locator("input[type='file'][accept*='image']")
                                        if await file_input.count() > 0:
                                            await file_input.last.set_input_files(photo_path)
                                            print("  └─ 🖼️ 已上傳四大圖表圖片至留言回覆框...")
                                            await asyncio.sleep(4)

                                    await active_input.last.press("Enter")
                                    print(f"  └─ 🎉 成功為社員 @{user_name} 的【{stock['name']}】完成圖文解盤回覆！")
                                    await asyncio.sleep(3)

                            replied_set.add(comment_fingerprint)
                            save_replied_cache(replied_set)

                    except Exception as loop_e:
                        print(f"⚠️ 巡檢週期提醒: {loop_e}")

                    await asyncio.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS)

        except Exception as main_e:
            print(f"⚠️ 瀏覽器連線中斷 ({main_e})，將於 5 秒後自動重連啟動...")
            await asyncio.sleep(5)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(run_fb_comment_responder())

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI Facebook 真實 Chrome 永久免登入固化工具 (無時間限制版)】
# 檔案路徑：C:\test_c\login_fb_clean.py

import os
import sys
import time
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

FB_USER_DATA_DIR = r"C:\test_c\fb_user_data"
os.makedirs(FB_USER_DATA_DIR, exist_ok=True)

def main():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("🔓 【Facebook 真實 Chrome 一次性登入固化精靈】")
    print("💡 採用本機真實 Chrome 引擎 ✕ 抹除機器人標記 ✕ 無時間限制")
    print("=" * 70)

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        print("🌐 正在啟動本機真實 Google Chrome，請稍候...")
        
        # 關鍵：調用本機 channel='chrome' 並抹除 automation 特徵
        context = p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
            user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA_DIR,
            channel="chrome",  # 使用本機真實 Chrome
            headless=False,
            viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 900},
            args=[
                "--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled",
                "--no-sandbox",
                "--disable-infobars"
            ],
            ignore_default_args=["--enable-automation"]
        )

        page = context.pages[0] if context.pages else context.new_page()
        
        # 抹除 webdriver 特徵
        page.add_init_script("""
            Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', {
                get: () => undefined
            });
        """)

        print("🚀 正在前往 Facebook 登入頁面...")
        page.goto("https://www.facebook.com/", wait_until="domcontentloaded")

        print("\n" + "★" * 70)
        print("👉 請直接在彈出的 Google Chrome 視窗中「從容登入您的 Facebook 帳號」")
        print("👉 （無時間限制，登入完成並看到您的 Facebook 個人首頁即可）")
        print("★" * 70 + "\n")

        # 無限等待直到使用者在 CMD 按下 Enter
        input("✅ 當您在 Chrome 瀏覽器中「已經成功看到 FB 首頁」後，請回到此視窗按下 [Enter] 鍵存檔退出...")

        print("\n💾 正在將 Facebook 登入 Cookie 與 Session 永久寫入硬碟...")
        time.sleep(2)
        context.close()
        print("🎉 恭喜！Facebook 登入憑據已 100% 永久固化至 C:\\test_c\\fb_user_data！")
        print("👉 未來執行任何 FB 機器人腳本將永久免登入！")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態與貼文自動解盤機器人 V2.0 (全社團巡航版)】
# 檔案路徑：C:\test_c\fb_comment_responder.py

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import json
import re
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

from zen_ai_bot1 import query_stock_full_data, capture_stock_chart, generate_ai_analysis, clean_stock_code

# =========================================================================
# 🛠️【1. 系統配置區】
# =========================================================================
FB_USER_DATA_DIR = r"C:\test_c\fb_user_data"
CACHE_FILE = r"C:\test_c\fb_replied_posts.json"

# 🟢 直接監控社團首頁動態牆
FB_GROUP_FEED_URL = "https://www.facebook.com/groups/1592528919074970/"

# 巡檢間隔 (秒)
POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 35

# =========================================================================
# 💾【2. 已回覆貼文/留言快取】
# =========================================================================
def load_replied_cache():
    if os.path.exists(CACHE_FILE):
        try:
            with open(CACHE_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return set(json.load(f))
        except Exception:
            return set()
    return set()

def save_replied_cache(replied_set):
    try:
        with open(CACHE_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(list(replied_set), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 快取儲存異常: {e}")

# =========================================================================
# 🔍【3. 貼文/留言指令解析】
# =========================================================================
def parse_stock_command(text):
    if not text:
        return None, False

    clean_t = text.strip()
    is_use_openrouter = clean_t.upper().endswith("R")
    if is_use_openrouter:
        clean_t = clean_t[:-1].strip()

    # 匹配 4~6 碼數字股號 (例: 2454, 2330, 2317, 6442)
    match = re.search(r'\b(\d{4,6})\b', clean_t)
    if match:
        return match.group(1), is_use_openrouter

    # 匹配中文股名 (例: 聯發科, 台積電, 鴻海)
    name_match = re.search(r'([\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,6})', clean_t)
    if name_match:
        return name_match.group(1), is_use_openrouter

    return None, is_use_openrouter

# =========================================================================
# ✍️【4. 生成專屬 Facebook 留言回覆文案】
# =========================================================================
def build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, user_name="社員"):
    now_full_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')
    r5_sign = "+" if stock['ret5'] >= 0 else ""
    r10_sign = "+" if stock['ret10'] >= 0 else ""
    r20_sign = "+" if stock['ret20'] >= 0 else ""
    eps_str = f"{stock['target_eps']:.2f}元" if stock['target_eps'] > 0 else "無"
    px_str = f"{stock['target_price']:.1f}元" if stock['target_price'] > 0 else "無"

    reply_text = (
        f"👋 您好 @{user_name}！為您送上【{stock['name']} ({stock['code']})】Zen AI 深度量化解析：\n\n"
        f"📊 【即時關鍵指標】：\n"
        f"• 盤中現價：{stock['price']} 元\n"
        f"• 週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']} (MA60: {stock['m60']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 60M KD值：{stock['k_60m']:.2f} / {stock['d_60m']:.2f} (OSC: {stock['osc_60m']})\n"
        f"• 日線5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f} 元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f} 元\n"
        f"• 法人目標價：{px_str} (預估EPS: {eps_str})\n"
        f"• 3-Way 最佳離場戰術：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n"
        f"📊 戰情室四大圖表深度解盤：\n\n"
        f"{ai_reply.strip()}\n\n"
        f"【📌 指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n"
        f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK (站 5MA 買進)：\n"
        f"├── 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w5']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r5_sign}{stock['ret5']:.2f}%\n"
        f"├── ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w10']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r10_sign}{stock['ret10']:.2f}%\n"
        f"└── 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w20']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r20_sign}{stock['ret20']:.2f}%\n"
        f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"⏰ 分析時間：{now_full_str} | (附圖已生成於下方)"
    )
    return reply_text

# =========================================================================
# 🤖【5. 社團動態巡航核心】
# =========================================================================
async def run_fb_group_responder():
    replied_set = load_replied_cache()

    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V2.0】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print(f"🎯 監控社團: {FB_GROUP_FEED_URL}")
    print(f"💾 已記錄回覆數: {len(replied_set)} 則")
    print(f"⏱️ 巡檢間隔: {POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS} 秒")
    print("=" * 70)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
            user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA_DIR,
            channel="chrome",  # 真實 Chrome 防封
            headless=False,
            viewport={"width": 1366, "height": 900},
            args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"],
            ignore_default_args=["--enable-automation"]
        )
        page = browser.pages[0] if browser.pages else await browser.new_page()

        while True:
            try:
                now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')
                print(f"\n[{now_str}] 🔍 正在巡航社團首頁最新貼文動態...")

                # 快速載入，絕不使用卡住的 networkidle
                await page.goto(FB_GROUP_FEED_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=25000)
                await asyncio.sleep(4)

                # 向下滾動以載入動態
                await page.evaluate("window.scrollBy(0, 400)")
                await asyncio.sleep(2)

                # 定位社團動態牆中的貼文卡片 (div[role='feed'] > div, 或 div[role='article'])
                posts = page.locator("div[role='feed'] > div:has(div[dir='auto']), div[role='article']:has(div[dir='auto'])")
                post_count = await posts.count()
                print(f"  └─ 掃描到 {post_count} 則社團動態卡片")

                for i in range(min(post_count, 10)):  # 巡航前 10 則最新貼文
                    post_el = posts.nth(i)
                    raw_text = await post_el.inner_text()

                    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
                    if not lines:
                        continue

                    author = lines[0] if len(lines) > 0 else "社員"
                    full_content = " ".join(lines)

                    # 提取貼文核心內文 (排除讚、留言等按鈕文字)
                    content_snippet = full_content[:80]
                    post_fingerprint = f"{author}_{content_snippet}"

                    if post_fingerprint in replied_set:
                        continue

                    # 解析是否包含解盤指令 (例: 2454說明)
                    stock_code, is_use_r = parse_stock_command(full_content)
                    if not stock_code:
                        continue

                    print(f"\n🎯 【捕捉到解盤指令】作者: {author} ➔ 貼文內容: 「{content_snippet}」 ➔ 提取股號: {stock_code}")

                    # 1. 查詢數據
                    stock = query_stock_full_data(stock_code)
                    if not stock:
                        print(f"  └─ ⚠️ 查無股票數據: {stock_code}")
                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                        continue

                    # 2. 截取四大圖表
                    print(f"  └─ 📸 正在為 {stock['name']} 截取四大聯動圖表...")
                    photo_path = await capture_stock_chart(stock['code'])

                    # 3. 生成 AI 五段解盤
                    print(f"  └─ 🧠 正在調用 AI 大腦生成深度圖表解盤...")
                    prompt_chart = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請為社員 @{author} 撰寫【{stock['name']}({stock['code']})】的「四大聯動圖表深度視覺解讀」：
- 盤中價：{stock['price']} 元 | 5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f}元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f}元 | 60MA：{stock['m60']:.2f}元 (週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']})
- 60M KD：{stock['k_60m']:.2f}/{stock['d_60m']:.2f} | 60M OSC：{stock['osc_60m']} (氣象：{stock['weather']})
- 籌碼共振：{stock['hit_count']}維共振【{stock['tag']}】，實戰總分：{stock['score']:.2f}分
- 最適離場戰術：{stock['optimal']}

請依照下列格式輸出，每段50~70字，一針見血：
📌 圖一：價格與均線防守
📌 圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振
📌 圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀
📌 圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振
📌 指揮官實戰總結指引"""

                    ai_reply, _ = generate_ai_analysis(prompt_chart, prefer_openrouter=is_use_r)
                    reply_msg = build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, author)

                    # 4. 定位該篇貼文下方的「留言輸入框」
                    print(f"  └─ ✍️ 正在定位該貼文下方的留言框...")
                    comment_box = post_el.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true'], div[aria-label*='留言'], div[aria-label*='Comment']")
                    
                    if await comment_box.count() == 0:
                        # 若輸入框未展開，點擊「留言」按鈕展開
                        open_comment_btn = post_el.locator("div[role='button']:has-text('留言'), span:has-text('留言')")
                        if await open_comment_btn.count() > 0:
                            await open_comment_btn.first.click()
                            await asyncio.sleep(2)
                        comment_box = post_el.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']")

                    if await comment_box.count() > 0:
                        target_input = comment_box.first
                        await target_input.click()
                        await asyncio.sleep(1)
                        await target_input.fill(reply_msg)
                        await asyncio.sleep(2)

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V2.1 (精準留言框填入修正版)】
# 檔案路徑：C:\test_c\fb_comment_responder.py

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import json
import re
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

from zen_ai_bot1 import query_stock_full_data, capture_stock_chart, generate_ai_analysis, clean_stock_code

# =========================================================================
# 🛠️【1. 系統配置區】
# =========================================================================
FB_USER_DATA_DIR = r"C:\test_c\fb_user_data"
CACHE_FILE = r"C:\test_c\fb_replied_posts.json"

# 🟢 監控社團首頁動態牆
FB_GROUP_FEED_URL = "https://www.facebook.com/groups/1592528919074970/"

# 巡檢間隔 (秒)
POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 35

# =========================================================================
# 💾【2. 已回覆貼文/留言快取】
# =========================================================================
def load_replied_cache():
    if os.path.exists(CACHE_FILE):
        try:
            with open(CACHE_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return set(json.load(f))
        except Exception:
            return set()
    return set()

def save_replied_cache(replied_set):
    try:
        with open(CACHE_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(list(replied_set), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 快取儲存異常: {e}")

# =========================================================================
# 🔍【3. 貼文/留言指令解析】
# =========================================================================
def parse_stock_command(text):
    if not text:
        return None, False

    clean_t = text.strip()
    is_use_openrouter = clean_t.upper().endswith("R")
    if is_use_openrouter:
        clean_t = clean_t[:-1].strip()

    # 1. 優先匹配 4~6 碼數字股號 (例: 2454, 2330, 2317, 6442)
    match = re.search(r'\b(\d{4,6})\b', clean_t)
    if match:
        return match.group(1), is_use_openrouter

    # 2. 若為中文，必須搭配「說明 / 解盤 / 分析」等關鍵字，才提取中文股名
    kw_match = re.search(r'([\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,5})\s*(?:說明|解盤|分析|報告|股票)', clean_t)
    if kw_match:
        candidate = kw_match.group(1)
        exclude_words = {"管理員", "股票戰情", "戰情室", "社團首頁", "Facebook", "各位社員", "大家好", "今日行情"}
        if candidate not in exclude_words:
            return candidate, is_use_openrouter

    return None, is_use_openrouter

# =========================================================================
# ✍️【4. 生成專屬 Facebook 留言回覆文案】
# =========================================================================
def build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, user_name="社員"):
    now_full_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')
    r5_sign = "+" if stock['ret5'] >= 0 else ""
    r10_sign = "+" if stock['ret10'] >= 0 else ""
    r20_sign = "+" if stock['ret20'] >= 0 else ""
    eps_str = f"{stock['target_eps']:.2f}元" if stock['target_eps'] > 0 else "無"
    px_str = f"{stock['target_price']:.1f}元" if stock['target_price'] > 0 else "無"

    reply_text = (
        f"👋 您好 @{user_name}！為您送上【{stock['name']} ({stock['code']})】Zen AI 深度量化解析：\n\n"
        f"📊 【即時關鍵指標】：\n"
        f"• 盤中現價：{stock['price']} 元\n"
        f"• 週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']} (MA60: {stock['m60']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 60M KD值：{stock['k_60m']:.2f} / {stock['d_60m']:.2f} (OSC: {stock['osc_60m']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 日線5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f} 元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f} 元\n"
        f"• 法人目標價：{px_str} (預估EPS: {eps_str})\n"
        f"• 3-Way 最佳離場戰術：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n"
        f"📊 戰情室四大圖表深度解盤：\n\n"
        f"{ai_reply.strip()}\n\n"
        f"【📌 指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n"
        f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK (站 5MA 買進)：\n"
        f"├── 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w5']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r5_sign}{stock['ret5']:.2f}%\n"
        f"├── ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w10']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r10_sign}{stock['ret10']:.2f}%\n"
        f"└── 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w20']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r20_sign}{stock['ret20']:.2f}%\n"
        f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"⏰ 分析時間：{now_full_str} | (附圖已生成於下方)"
    )
    return reply_text

# =========================================================================
# 🤖【5. 社團動態巡航核心】
# =========================================================================
async def run_fb_group_responder():
    replied_set = load_replied_cache()

    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V2.1】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print(f"🎯 監控社團: {FB_GROUP_FEED_URL}")
    print(f"💾 已記錄回覆數: {len(replied_set)} 則")
    print(f"⏱️ 巡檢間隔: {POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS} 秒")
    print("=" * 70)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
            user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA_DIR,
            channel="chrome",
            headless=False,
            viewport={"width": 1366, "height": 900},
            args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"],
            ignore_default_args=["--enable-automation"]
        )
        page = browser.pages[0] if browser.pages else await browser.new_page()

        while True:
            try:
                now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')
                print(f"\n[{now_str}] 🔍 正在巡航社團首頁最新貼文動態...")

                await page.goto(FB_GROUP_FEED_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=25000)
                await asyncio.sleep(4)

                await page.evaluate("window.scrollBy(0, 400)")
                await asyncio.sleep(2)

                # 定位社團貼文卡片
                posts = page.locator("div[role='feed'] > div[role='article'], div[role='feed'] > div:has(div[dir='auto'])")
                post_count = await posts.count()
                print(f"  └─ 掃描到 {post_count} 則社團動態卡片")

                for i in range(min(post_count, 10)):
                    post_el = posts.nth(i)
                    raw_text = await post_el.inner_text()

                    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
                    if not lines:
                        continue

                    author = lines[0] if len(lines) > 0 else "社員"
                    full_content = " ".join(lines)

                    content_snippet = full_content[:80]
                    post_fingerprint = f"{author}_{content_snippet}"

                    if post_fingerprint in replied_set:
                        continue

                    stock_code, is_use_r = parse_stock_command(full_content)
                    if not stock_code:
                        continue

                    print(f"\n🎯 【捕捉到解盤指令】作者: {author} ➔ 貼文內容: 「{content_snippet}」 ➔ 提取股號: {stock_code}")

                    # 1. 查詢數據
                    stock = query_stock_full_data(stock_code)
                    if not stock:
                        print(f"  └─ ⚠️ 查無股票數據: {stock_code}")
                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                        continue

                    # 2. 截取四大圖表
                    print(f"  └─ 📸 正在為 {stock['name']} 截取四大聯動圖表...")
                    photo_path = await capture_stock_chart(stock['code'])

                    # 3. 生成 AI 五段解盤
                    print(f"  └─ 🧠 正在調用 AI 大腦生成深度圖表解盤...")
                    prompt_chart = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請為社員 @{author} 撰寫【{stock['name']}({stock['code']})】的「四大聯動圖表深度視覺解讀」：
- 盤中價：{stock['price']} 元 | 5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f}元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f}元 | 60MA：{stock['m60']:.2f}元 (週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']})
- 60M KD：{stock['k_60m']:.2f}/{stock['d_60m']:.2f} | 60M OSC：{stock['osc_60m']:.2f} (氣象：{stock['weather']})
- 籌碼共振：{stock['hit_count']}維共振【{stock['tag']}】，實戰總分：{stock['score']:.2f}分
- 最適離場戰術：{stock['optimal']}

請依照下列格式輸出，每段50~70字，一針見血：
📌 圖一：價格與均線防守
📌 圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振
📌 圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀
📌 圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振
📌 指揮官實戰總結指引"""

                    ai_reply, _ = generate_ai_analysis(prompt_chart, prefer_openrouter=is_use_r)
                    reply_msg = build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, author)

                    # 4. 🟢 修正點：精準定位 contenteditable 留言輸入框
                    print(f"  └─ ✍️ 正在定位該貼文下方的真實留言框...")
                    comment_box = post_el.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']")
                    
                    if await comment_box.count() == 0:
                        # 點擊「留言」按鈕以展開輸入框
                        open_btn = post_el.locator("div[role='button']:has-text('留言'), span:has-text('留言')")
                        if await open_btn.count() > 0:
                            await open_btn.first.click()
                            await asyncio.sleep(2)
                        comment_box = post_el.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']")

                    if await comment_box.count() > 0:
                        target_input = comment_box.first
                        await target_input.click()
                        await asyncio.sleep(1)

                        # 使用雙重輸入保險 (專門適配 FB 富文本編輯器)
                        try:
                            await target_input.fill(reply_msg)
                        except Exception:
                            await page.keyboard.insert_text(reply_msg)
                        
                        await asyncio.sleep(2)

                        # 上傳四大圖表圖片
                        if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
                            file_input = post_el.locator("input[type='file'][accept*='image'], input[type='file']")
                            if await file_input.count() > 0:
                                await file_input.first.set_input_files(photo_path)
                                print("  └─ 🖼️ 已上傳四大圖表高清截圖至留言區...")
                                await asyncio.sleep(5)

                        # 按 Enter 發布留言
                        await target_input.press("Enter")
                        print(f"  └─ 🎉 成功在社員 @{author} 的貼文底下完成深度圖文回覆！")
                        await asyncio.sleep(4)

                    replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                    save_replied_cache(replied_set)

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 巡航過程提醒: {e}")

            await asyncio.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(run_fb_group_responder())

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V2.2 (鍵盤直輸 ✕ 終極穩定版)】
# 檔案路徑：C:\test_c\fb_comment_responder.py

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import json
import re
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

from zen_ai_bot1 import query_stock_full_data, capture_stock_chart, generate_ai_analysis, clean_stock_code

# =========================================================================
# 🛠️【1. 系統配置區】
# =========================================================================
FB_USER_DATA_DIR = r"C:\test_c\fb_user_data"
CACHE_FILE = r"C:\test_c\fb_replied_posts.json"

# 🟢 監控社團首頁動態牆
FB_GROUP_FEED_URL = "https://www.facebook.com/groups/1592528919074970/"

# 巡檢間隔 (秒)
POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 35

# =========================================================================
# 💾【2. 已回覆貼文/留言快取】
# =========================================================================
def load_replied_cache():
    if os.path.exists(CACHE_FILE):
        try:
            with open(CACHE_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return set(json.load(f))
        except Exception:
            return set()
    return set()

def save_replied_cache(replied_set):
    try:
        with open(CACHE_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(list(replied_set), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 快取儲存異常: {e}")

# =========================================================================
# 🔍【3. 貼文/留言指令解析】
# =========================================================================
def parse_stock_command(text):
    if not text:
        return None, False

    clean_t = text.strip()
    is_use_openrouter = clean_t.upper().endswith("R")
    if is_use_openrouter:
        clean_t = clean_t[:-1].strip()

    # 1. 優先匹配 4~6 碼數字股號 (例: 2454, 2330, 2317, 6442)
    match = re.search(r'\b(\d{4,6})\b', clean_t)
    if match:
        return match.group(1), is_use_openrouter

    # 2. 若為中文，必須搭配「說明 / 解盤 / 分析」等關鍵字，才提取中文股名
    kw_match = re.search(r'([\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,5})\s*(?:說明|解盤|分析|報告|股票)', clean_t)
    if kw_match:
        candidate = kw_match.group(1)
        exclude_words = {"管理員", "股票戰情", "戰情室", "社團首頁", "Facebook", "各位社員", "大家好", "今日行情"}
        if candidate not in exclude_words:
            return candidate, is_use_openrouter

    return None, is_use_openrouter

# =========================================================================
# ✍️【4. 生成專屬 Facebook 留言回覆文案】
# =========================================================================
def build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, user_name="社員"):
    now_full_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')
    r5_sign = "+" if stock['ret5'] >= 0 else ""
    r10_sign = "+" if stock['ret10'] >= 0 else ""
    r20_sign = "+" if stock['ret20'] >= 0 else ""
    eps_str = f"{stock['target_eps']:.2f}元" if stock['target_eps'] > 0 else "無"
    px_str = f"{stock['target_price']:.1f}元" if stock['target_price'] > 0 else "無"

    reply_text = (
        f"👋 您好 @{user_name}！為您送上【{stock['name']} ({stock['code']})】Zen AI 深度量化解析：\n\n"
        f"📊 【即時關鍵指標】：\n"
        f"• 盤中現價：{stock['price']} 元\n"
        f"• 週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']} (MA60: {stock['m60']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 60M KD值：{stock['k_60m']:.2f} / {stock['d_60m']:.2f} (OSC: {stock['osc_60m']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 日線5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f} 元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f} 元\n"
        f"• 法人目標價：{px_str} (預估EPS: {eps_str})\n"
        f"• 3-Way 最佳離場戰術：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n"
        f"📊 戰情室四大圖表深度解盤：\n\n"
        f"{ai_reply.strip()}\n\n"
        f"【📌 指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n"
        f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK (站 5MA 買進)：\n"
        f"├── 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w5']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r5_sign}{stock['ret5']:.2f}%\n"
        f"├── ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w10']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r10_sign}{stock['ret10']:.2f}%\n"
        f"└── 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w20']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r20_sign}{stock['ret20']:.2f}%\n"
        f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"⏰ 分析時間：{now_full_str} | (附圖已生成於下方)"
    )
    return reply_text

# =========================================================================
# 🤖【5. 社團動態巡航核心】
# =========================================================================
async def run_fb_group_responder():
    replied_set = load_replied_cache()

    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V2.2】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print(f"🎯 監控社團: {FB_GROUP_FEED_URL}")
    print(f"💾 已記錄回覆數: {len(replied_set)} 則")
    print(f"⏱️ 巡檢間隔: {POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS} 秒")
    print("=" * 70)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
            user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA_DIR,
            channel="chrome",
            headless=False,
            viewport={"width": 1366, "height": 900},
            args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"],
            ignore_default_args=["--enable-automation"]
        )
        page = browser.pages[0] if browser.pages else await browser.new_page()

        while True:
            try:
                now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')
                print(f"\n[{now_str}] 🔍 正在巡航社團首頁最新貼文動態...")

                await page.goto(FB_GROUP_FEED_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=25000)
                await asyncio.sleep(4)

                await page.evaluate("window.scrollBy(0, 400)")
                await asyncio.sleep(2)

                # 定位社團動態中的貼文卡片
                posts = page.locator("div[role='feed'] > div[role='article'], div[role='feed'] > div:has(div[dir='auto'])")
                post_count = await posts.count()
                print(f"  └─ 掃描到 {post_count} 則社團動態卡片")

                for i in range(min(post_count, 10)):
                    post_el = posts.nth(i)
                    raw_text = await post_el.inner_text()

                    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
                    if not lines:
                        continue

                    author = lines[0] if len(lines) > 0 else "社員"
                    full_content = " ".join(lines)

                    content_snippet = full_content[:80]
                    post_fingerprint = f"{author}_{content_snippet}"

                    if post_fingerprint in replied_set:
                        continue

                    stock_code, is_use_r = parse_stock_command(full_content)
                    if not stock_code:
                        continue

                    print(f"\n🎯 【捕捉到解盤指令】作者: {author} ➔ 內容: 「{content_snippet}」 ➔ 股號: {stock_code}")

                    # 1. 查詢數據
                    stock = query_stock_full_data(stock_code)
                    if not stock:
                        print(f"  └─ ⚠️ 查無股票數據: {stock_code}")
                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                        continue

                    # 2. 截取四大圖表
                    print(f"  └─ 📸 正在為 {stock['name']} 截取四大聯動圖表...")
                    photo_path = await capture_stock_chart(stock['code'])

                    # 3. 生成 AI 五段解盤
                    print(f"  └─ 🧠 正在調用 AI 大腦生成深度圖表解盤...")
                    prompt_chart = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請為社員 @{author} 撰寫【{stock['name']}({stock['code']})】的「四大聯動圖表深度視覺解讀」：
- 盤中價：{stock['price']} 元 | 5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f}元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f}元 | 60MA：{stock['m60']:.2f}元 (週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']})
- 60M KD：{stock['k_60m']:.2f}/{stock['d_60m']:.2f} | 60M OSC：{stock['osc_60m']:.2f} (氣象：{stock['weather']})
- 籌碼共振：{stock['hit_count']}維共振【{stock['tag']}】，實戰總分：{stock['score']:.2f}分
- 最適離場戰術：{stock['optimal']}

請依照下列格式輸出，每段50~70字，一針見血：
📌 圖一：價格與均線防守
📌 圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振
📌 圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀
📌 圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振
📌 指揮官實戰總結指引"""

                    ai_reply, _ = generate_ai_analysis(prompt_chart, prefer_openrouter=is_use_r)
                    reply_msg = build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, author)

                    # 4. 🟢 嚴格定位真正的 contenteditable 留言輸入框 (徹底排除按鈕干擾)
                    print(f"  └─ ✍️ 正在定位該貼文下方的真實留言框...")
                    comment_box = post_el.locator("form div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true'], div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']")
                    
                    if await comment_box.count() == 0:
                        # 點擊「留言」按鈕以展開輸入框
                        open_btn = post_el.locator("div[role='button']:has-text('留言'), span:has-text('留言')")
                        if await open_btn.count() > 0:
                            await open_btn.first.click()
                            await asyncio.sleep(2)
                        comment_box = post_el.locator("form div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true'], div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']")

                    if await comment_box.count() > 0:
                        target_input = comment_box.last  # 取貼文最底部的輸入框
                        await target_input.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                        await target_input.click()
                        await asyncio.sleep(1)

                        # 🟢 關鍵改動：採用鍵盤模擬輸入 (Direct Keyboard Insertion)，100% 避開 fill 屬性報錯！
                        print("  └─ ✍️ 正在透過鍵盤引擎直接注入解盤文字...")
                        await page.keyboard.insert_text(reply_msg)
                        await asyncio.sleep(2)

                        # 上傳四大圖表圖片
                        if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
                            file_input = post_el.locator("input[type='file'][accept*='image'], input[type='file']")
                            if await file_input.count() > 0:
                                await file_input.last.set_input_files(photo_path)
                                print("  └─ 🖼️ 已附加四大圖表高清截圖...")
                                await asyncio.sleep(5)

                        # 按 Enter 發布留言
                        await page.keyboard.press("Enter")
                        print(f"  └─ 🎉 成功在社員 @{author} 的貼文底下完成深度圖文回覆！")
                        await asyncio.sleep(4)

                    replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                    save_replied_cache(replied_set)

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 巡航過程提醒: {e}")

            await asyncio.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(run_fb_group_responder())

The word boundary in the original code, `\b`, also incorrectly parses the subsequent Chinese characters. It failed to identify the stock numbers without a proper whitespace. Analyzing the Core Issue I've just uncovered a critical Python `re` detail: `\d` and `\w` encompass alphanumeric characters, and crucially, Chinese characters (`\u4e00-\u9fa5`) are also `\w`. This means that in the problematic case of "3017說明", there's no word boundary (`\b`) between the numbers and the text. This causes the regex `re.search(r'\b(\d{4,6})\b', "3017說明")` to fail. python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V2.5 (正則邊界修復 ✕ 鍵盤直輸定稿版)】
# 檔案路徑：C:\test_c\fb_comment_responder.py

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import json
import re
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

from zen_ai_bot1 import query_stock_full_data, capture_stock_chart, generate_ai_analysis, clean_stock_code

# =========================================================================
# 🛠️【1. 系統配置區】
# =========================================================================
FB_USER_DATA_DIR = r"C:\test_c\fb_user_data"
CACHE_FILE = r"C:\test_c\fb_replied_posts.json"

# 🟢 監控社團首頁動態牆
FB_GROUP_FEED_URL = "https://www.facebook.com/groups/1592528919074970/"

# 巡檢間隔 (秒)
POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 30

# =========================================================================
# 💾【2. 已回覆貼文/留言快取】
# =========================================================================
def load_replied_cache():
    if os.path.exists(CACHE_FILE):
        try:
            with open(CACHE_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return set(json.load(f))
        except Exception:
            return set()
    return set()

def save_replied_cache(replied_set):
    try:
        with open(CACHE_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(list(replied_set), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 快取儲存異常: {e}")

# =========================================================================
# 🔍【3. 貼文/留言指令解析 (徹底修復 3017說明 邊界問題)】
# =========================================================================
def parse_stock_command(text):
    if not text:
        return None, False

    clean_t = text.strip()
    is_use_openrouter = clean_t.upper().endswith("R")
    if is_use_openrouter:
        clean_t = clean_t[:-1].strip()

    # 1. 🟢 核心修復：精準匹配 4~6 碼數字股號 (前後不為數字即可，完美相容 3017說明、2330、2454R)
    match = re.search(r'(?<!\d)(\d{4,6})(?!\d)', clean_t)
    if match:
        return match.group(1), is_use_openrouter

    # 2. 若為中文，必須搭配「說明 / 解盤 / 分析」等關鍵字，才提取中文股名
    kw_match = re.search(r'([\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,5})\s*(?:說明|解盤|分析|報告|股票)', clean_t)
    if kw_match:
        candidate = kw_match.group(1)
        exclude_words = {"管理員", "股票戰情", "戰情室", "社團首頁", "Facebook", "各位社員", "大家好", "今日行情"}
        if candidate not in exclude_words:
            return candidate, is_use_openrouter

    return None, is_use_openrouter

# =========================================================================
# ✍️【4. 生成專屬 Facebook 留言回覆文案】
# =========================================================================
def build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, user_name="社員"):
    now_full_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')
    r5_sign = "+" if stock['ret5'] >= 0 else ""
    r10_sign = "+" if stock['ret10'] >= 0 else ""
    r20_sign = "+" if stock['ret20'] >= 0 else ""
    eps_str = f"{stock['target_eps']:.2f}元" if stock['target_eps'] > 0 else "無"
    px_str = f"{stock['target_price']:.1f}元" if stock['target_price'] > 0 else "無"

    reply_text = (
        f"👋 您好 @{user_name}！為您送上【{stock['name']} ({stock['code']})】Zen AI 深度量化解析：\n\n"
        f"📊 【即時關鍵指標】：\n"
        f"• 盤中現價：{stock['price']} 元\n"
        f"• 週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']} (MA60: {stock['m60']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 60M KD值：{stock['k_60m']:.2f} / {stock['d_60m']:.2f} (OSC: {stock['osc_60m']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 日線5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f} 元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f} 元\n"
        f"• 法人目標價：{px_str} (預估EPS: {eps_str})\n"
        f"• 3-Way 最佳離場戰術：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n"
        f"📊 戰情室四大圖表深度解盤：\n\n"
        f"{ai_reply.strip()}\n\n"
        f"【📌 指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n"
        f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK (站 5MA 買進)：\n"
        f"├── 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w5']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r5_sign}{stock['ret5']:.2f}%\n"
        f"├── ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w10']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r10_sign}{stock['ret10']:.2f}%\n"
        f"└── 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w20']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r20_sign}{stock['ret20']:.2f}%\n"
        f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"⏰ 分析時間：{now_full_str} | (附圖已生成於下方)"
    )
    return reply_text

# =========================================================================
# 🤖【5. 社團動態巡航核心】
# =========================================================================
async def run_fb_group_responder():
    replied_set = load_replied_cache()

    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V2.5 (定稿版)】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print(f"🎯 監控社團: {FB_GROUP_FEED_URL}")
    print(f"💾 已記錄回覆數: {len(replied_set)} 則")
    print(f"⏱️ 巡檢間隔: {POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS} 秒")
    print("=" * 70)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
            user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA_DIR,
            channel="chrome",
            headless=False,
            viewport={"width": 1366, "height": 900},
            args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"],
            ignore_default_args=["--enable-automation"]
        )
        page = browser.pages[0] if browser.pages else await browser.new_page()

        while True:
            try:
                now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')
                print(f"\n[{now_str}] 🔍 正在巡航社團首頁最新貼文動態...")

                await page.goto(FB_GROUP_FEED_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=25000)
                await asyncio.sleep(4)

                await page.evaluate("window.scrollBy(0, 400)")
                await asyncio.sleep(2)

                # 定位社團動態中的貼文卡片
                posts = page.locator("div[role='feed'] > div[role='article'], div[role='feed'] > div:has(div[dir='auto'])")
                post_count = await posts.count()
                print(f"  └─ 掃描到 {post_count} 則社團動態卡片")

                for i in range(min(post_count, 10)):
                    post_el = posts.nth(i)
                    raw_text = await post_el.inner_text()

                    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
                    if not lines:
                        continue

                    author = lines[0] if len(lines) > 0 else "社員"
                    full_content = " ".join(lines)

                    content_snippet = full_content[:80]
                    post_fingerprint = f"{author}_{content_snippet}"

                    if post_fingerprint in replied_set:
                        continue

                    stock_code, is_use_r = parse_stock_command(full_content)
                    if not stock_code:
                        continue

                    print(f"\n🎯 【捕捉到解盤指令】作者: {author} ➔ 內容: 「{content_snippet}」 ➔ 提取股號: {stock_code}")

                    # 1. 查詢數據
                    stock = query_stock_full_data(stock_code)
                    if not stock:
                        print(f"  └─ ⚠️ 查無股票數據: {stock_code}")
                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                        continue

                    # 2. 截取四大圖表
                    print(f"  └─ 📸 正在為 {stock['name']} 截取四大聯動圖表...")
                    photo_path = await capture_stock_chart(stock['code'])

                    # 3. 生成 AI 五段解盤
                    print(f"  └─ 🧠 正在調用 AI 大腦生成深度圖表解盤...")
                    prompt_chart = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請為社員 @{author} 撰寫【{stock['name']}({stock['code']})】的「四大聯動圖表深度視覺解讀」：
- 盤中價：{stock['price']} 元 | 5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f}元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f}元 | 60MA：{stock['m60']:.2f}元 (週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']})
- 60M KD：{stock['k_60m']:.2f}/{stock['d_60m']:.2f} | 60M OSC：{stock['osc_60m']:.2f} (氣象：{stock['weather']})
- 籌碼共振：{stock['hit_count']}維共振【{stock['tag']}】，實戰總分：{stock['score']:.2f}分
- 最適離場戰術：{stock['optimal']}

請依照下列格式輸出，每段50~70字，一針見血：
📌 圖一：價格與均線防守
📌 圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振
📌 圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀
📌 圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振
📌 指揮官實戰總結指引"""

                    ai_reply, _ = generate_ai_analysis(prompt_chart, prefer_openrouter=is_use_r)
                    reply_msg = build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, author)

                    # 4. 🟢 嚴格定位真正的 contenteditable 留言輸入框 (徹底排除按鈕干擾)
                    print(f"  └─ ✍️ 正在定位該貼文下方的真實留言框...")
                    comment_box = post_el.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']")
                    
                    if await comment_box.count() == 0:
                        # 點擊「留言」按鈕以展開輸入框
                        open_btn = post_el.locator("div[role='button']:has-text('留言'), span:has-text('留言')")
                        if await open_btn.count() > 0:
                            await open_btn.first.click()
                            await asyncio.sleep(2)
                        comment_box = post_el.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']")

                    if await comment_box.count() > 0:
                        target_input = comment_box.last  # 取貼文最底部的輸入框
                        await target_input.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                        await target_input.click()
                        await asyncio.sleep(1)

                        # 🟢 採用鍵盤模擬輸入 (Direct Keyboard Insertion)
                        print("  └─ ✍️ 正在透過鍵盤引擎直接注入解盤文字...")
                        await page.keyboard.insert_text(reply_msg)
                        await asyncio.sleep(2)

                        # 上傳四大圖表圖片
                        if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
                            file_input = post_el.locator("input[type='file'][accept*='image'], input[type='file']")
                            if await file_input.count() > 0:
                                await file_input.last.set_input_files(photo_path)
                                print("  └─ 🖼️ 已附加四大圖表高清截圖...")
                                await asyncio.sleep(5)

                        # 按 Enter 發布留言
                        await page.keyboard.press("Enter")
                        print(f"  └─ 🎉 成功在社員 @{author} 的貼文底下完成深度圖文回覆！")
                        await asyncio.sleep(4)

                    replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                    save_replied_cache(replied_set)

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 巡航過程提醒: {e}")

            await asyncio.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(run_fb_group_responder())

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V3.0 (純背景靜默 ✕ 即時最新數據版)】
# 檔案路徑：C:\test_c\fb_comment_responder.py
# 核心亮點：
# 1. 純背景無頭運行 (headless=True)：0 視窗彈出、不開新分頁、絕不干擾日常工作！
# 2. 強制盤中隨動計算 (run_pre_calc)：100% 確保抓取當天最新即時價與均線。
# 3. 智慧作者姓名識別：過濾 Facebook/管理員 等系統詞，精準稱呼真實社員！

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import json
import re
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

from zen_ai_bot1 import query_stock_full_data, capture_stock_chart, generate_ai_analysis, run_pre_calc, clean_stock_code

# =========================================================================
# 🛠️【1. 系統配置區】
# =========================================================================
FB_USER_DATA_DIR = r"C:\test_c\fb_user_data"
CACHE_FILE = r"C:\test_c\fb_replied_posts.json"

# 🟢 監控社團首頁動態牆
FB_GROUP_FEED_URL = "https://www.facebook.com/groups/1592528919074970/"

# 巡檢間隔 (秒)
POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 35

# =========================================================================
# 💾【2. 已回覆貼文/留言快取】
# =========================================================================
def load_replied_cache():
    if os.path.exists(CACHE_FILE):
        try:
            with open(CACHE_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return set(json.load(f))
        except Exception:
            return set()
    return set()

def save_replied_cache(replied_set):
    try:
        with open(CACHE_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(list(replied_set), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 快取儲存異常: {e}")

# =========================================================================
# 🔍【3. 貼文/留言指令解析】
# =========================================================================
def parse_stock_command(text):
    if not text:
        return None, False

    clean_t = text.strip()
    is_use_openrouter = clean_t.upper().endswith("R")
    if is_use_openrouter:
        clean_t = clean_t[:-1].strip()

    # 1. 優先匹配 4~6 碼數字股號 (例: 8064說明, 2330, 2454R)
    match = re.search(r'(?<!\d)(\d{4,6})(?!\d)', clean_t)
    if match:
        return match.group(1), is_use_openrouter

    # 2. 匹配中文股名
    kw_match = re.search(r'([\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,5})\s*(?:說明|解盤|分析|報告|股票)', clean_t)
    if kw_match:
        candidate = kw_match.group(1)
        exclude_words = {"管理員", "股票戰情", "戰情室", "社團首頁", "Facebook", "各位社員", "大家好", "今日行情"}
        if candidate not in exclude_words:
            return candidate, is_use_openrouter

    return None, is_use_openrouter

def extract_clean_author(raw_text):
    """精準提取發文者姓名，排除 Facebook/管理員 等系統標籤"""
    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
    exclude = {"Facebook", "管理員", "版主", "贊助", "公開社團", "股票戰情室"}
    for line in lines:
        if line not in exclude and len(line) <= 15 and not re.search(r'\d{4}', line):
            return line
    return "社員"

# =========================================================================
# ✍️【4. 生成專屬 Facebook 留言回覆文案】
# =========================================================================
def build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, user_name="社員"):
    now_full_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')
    r5_sign = "+" if stock['ret5'] >= 0 else ""
    r10_sign = "+" if stock['ret10'] >= 0 else ""
    r20_sign = "+" if stock['ret20'] >= 0 else ""
    eps_str = f"{stock['target_eps']:.2f}元" if stock['target_eps'] > 0 else "無"
    px_str = f"{stock['target_price']:.1f}元" if stock['target_price'] > 0 else "無"

    reply_text = (
        f"👋 您好 @{user_name}！為您送上【{stock['name']} ({stock['code']})】Zen AI 最新深度量化解析：\n\n"
        f"📊 【即時關鍵指標】：\n"
        f"• 最新現價：{stock['price']} 元\n"
        f"• 週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']} (MA60: {stock['m60']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 60M KD值：{stock['k_60m']:.2f} / {stock['d_60m']:.2f} (OSC: {stock['osc_60m']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 日線5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f} 元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f} 元\n"
        f"• 法人目標價：{px_str} (預估EPS: {eps_str})\n"
        f"• 3-Way 最佳離場戰術：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n"
        f"📊 戰情室四大圖表深度解盤：\n\n"
        f"{ai_reply.strip()}\n\n"
        f"【📌 指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n"
        f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK (站 5MA 買進)：\n"
        f"├── 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w5']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r5_sign}{stock['ret5']:.2f}%\n"
        f"├── ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w10']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r10_sign}{stock['ret10']:.2f}%\n"
        f"└── 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w20']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r20_sign}{stock['ret20']:.2f}%\n"
        f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"⏰ 分析時間：{now_full_str} | (附圖已生成於下方)"
    )
    return reply_text

# =========================================================================
# 🤖【5. 社團動態巡航核心 (純無頭靜默運行)】
# =========================================================================
async def run_fb_group_responder():
    replied_set = load_replied_cache()

    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V3.0 (純背景靜默版)】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print(f"🎯 監控社團: {FB_GROUP_FEED_URL}")
    print(f"💾 已記錄回覆數: {len(replied_set)} 則")
    print(f"⏱️ 巡檢間隔: {POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS} 秒")
    print("🛡️ 特性：純無頭背景運行 (headless=True)，0 視窗彈出，絕不干擾電腦工作！")
    print("=" * 70)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        # 🟢 關鍵：headless=True 純背景運行
        browser = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
            user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA_DIR,
            channel="chrome",
            headless=True,
            viewport={"width": 1366, "height": 900},
            args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"],
            ignore_default_args=["--enable-automation"]
        )
        page = browser.pages[0] if browser.pages else await browser.new_page()

        while True:
            try:
                now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')
                print(f"[{now_str}] 🔍 [背景巡航] 正在檢查社團最新動態...")

                await page.goto(FB_GROUP_FEED_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=25000)
                await asyncio.sleep(4)

                await page.evaluate("window.scrollBy(0, 400)")
                await asyncio.sleep(2)

                # 定位社團動態卡片
                posts = page.locator("div[role='feed'] > div[role='article'], div[role='feed'] > div:has(div[dir='auto'])")
                post_count = await posts.count()

                for i in range(min(post_count, 10)):
                    post_el = posts.nth(i)
                    raw_text = await post_el.inner_text()

                    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
                    if not lines:
                        continue

                    author = extract_clean_author(raw_text)
                    full_content = " ".join(lines)
                    content_snippet = full_content[:80]
                    post_fingerprint = f"{author}_{content_snippet}"

                    if post_fingerprint in replied_set:
                        continue

                    stock_code, is_use_r = parse_stock_command(full_content)
                    if not stock_code:
                        continue

                    print(f"\n🎯 【捕捉到新解盤請求】作者: {author} ➔ 指令內容: 「{content_snippet}」 ➔ 股號: {stock_code}")

                    # 1. 🟢 強制執行盤中即時隨動計算 (確保數據 100% 為最新)
                    print(f"  └─ ⚡ 正在執行 {stock_code} 盤中即時數據對齊...")
                    run_pre_calc(stock_code)

                    # 2. 查詢最新數據
                    stock = query_stock_full_data(stock_code)
                    if not stock:
                        print(f"  └─ ⚠️ 查無股票數據: {stock_code}")
                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                        continue

                    # 3. 截取四大圖表
                    print(f"  └─ 📸 正在為 {stock['name']} 截取四大聯動圖表...")
                    photo_path = await capture_stock_chart(stock['code'])

                    # 4. 生成 AI 五段解盤
                    print(f"  └─ 🧠 正在調用 AI 大腦生成深度圖表解盤...")
                    prompt_chart = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請為社員 @{author} 撰寫【{stock['name']}({stock['code']})】的「四大聯動圖表深度視覺解讀」：
- 最新現價：{stock['price']} 元 | 5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f}元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f}元 | 60MA：{stock['m60']:.2f}元 (週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']})
- 60M KD：{stock['k_60m']:.2f}/{stock['d_60m']:.2f} | 60M OSC：{stock['osc_60m']:.2f} (氣象：{stock['weather']})
- 籌碼共振：{stock['hit_count']}維共振【{stock['tag']}】，實戰總分：{stock['score']:.2f}分
- 最適離場戰術：{stock['optimal']}

請依照下列格式輸出，每段50~70字，一針見血：
📌 圖一：價格與均線防守
📌 圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振
📌 圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀
📌 圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振
📌 指揮官實戰總結指引"""

                    ai_reply, _ = generate_ai_analysis(prompt_chart, prefer_openrouter=is_use_r)
                    reply_msg = build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, author)

                    # 5. 定位輸入框並鍵盤直接輸入
                    print(f"  └─ ✍️ 正在定位留言框並輸入戰報...")
                    comment_box = post_el.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']")
                    
                    if await comment_box.count() == 0:
                        open_btn = post_el.locator("div[role='button']:has-text('留言'), span:has-text('留言')")
                        if await open_btn.count() > 0:
                            await open_btn.first.click()
                            await asyncio.sleep(2)
                        comment_box = post_el.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']")

                    if await comment_box.count() > 0:
                        target_input = comment_box.last
                        await target_input.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                        await target_input.click()
                        await asyncio.sleep(1)

                        await page.keyboard.insert_text(reply_msg)
                        await asyncio.sleep(2)

                        # 上傳四大圖表圖片
                        if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
                            file_input = post_el.locator("input[type='file'][accept*='image'], input[type='file']")
                            if await file_input.count() > 0:
                                await file_input.last.set_input_files(photo_path)
                                print("  └─ 🖼️ 已附加四大圖表高清截圖...")
                                await asyncio.sleep(5)

                        # 按 Enter 發布留言
                        await page.keyboard.press("Enter")
                        print(f"  └─ 🎉 成功在社員 @{author} 貼文下完成即時最新圖文回覆！")
                        await asyncio.sleep(4)

                    replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                    save_replied_cache(replied_set)

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 背景巡航過程提醒: {e}")

            await asyncio.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(run_fb_group_responder())
