python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V3.2 (精準貼文過濾 ✕ 點擊激活留言框版)】
# 檔案路徑：C:\test_c\fb_comment_responder.py

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import json
import re
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

from zen_ai_bot1 import query_stock_full_data, capture_stock_chart, generate_ai_analysis, run_pre_calc, clean_stock_code

# =========================================================================
# 🛠️【1. 系統配置區】
# =========================================================================
FB_USER_DATA_DIR = r"C:\test_c\fb_user_data"
CACHE_FILE = r"C:\test_c\fb_replied_posts.json"

# 🟢 監控社團首頁動態牆
FB_GROUP_FEED_URL = "https://www.facebook.com/groups/1592528919074970/"

# 巡檢間隔 (秒)
POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 30

# =========================================================================
# 💾【2. 已回覆貼文/留言快取】
# =========================================================================
def load_replied_cache():
    if os.path.exists(CACHE_FILE):
        try:
            with open(CACHE_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return set(json.load(f))
        except Exception:
            return set()
    return set()

def save_replied_cache(replied_set):
    try:
        with open(CACHE_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(list(replied_set), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 快取儲存異常: {e}")

# =========================================================================
# 🔍【3. 貼文/留言指令解析】
# =========================================================================
def parse_stock_command(text):
    if not text:
        return None, False

    clean_t = text.strip()
    is_use_openrouter = clean_t.upper().endswith("R")
    if is_use_openrouter:
        clean_t = clean_t[:-1].strip()

    # 1. 優先匹配 4~6 碼數字股號 (例: 8021說明R, 2330, 2454)
    match = re.search(r'(?<!\d)(\d{4,6})(?!\d)', clean_t)
    if match:
        return match.group(1), is_use_openrouter

    # 2. 匹配中文股名
    kw_match = re.search(r'([\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,5})\s*(?:說明|解盤|分析|報告|股票)', clean_t)
    if kw_match:
        candidate = kw_match.group(1)
        exclude_words = {"管理員", "股票戰情", "戰情室", "社團首頁", "Facebook", "各位社員", "大家好", "今日行情"}
        if candidate not in exclude_words:
            return candidate, is_use_openrouter

    return None, is_use_openrouter

def extract_clean_author(raw_text):
    """精準提取發文者姓名，排除 Facebook/管理員 等系統標籤"""
    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
    exclude = {"Facebook", "管理員", "版主", "贊助", "公開社團", "股票戰情室"}
    for line in lines:
        if line not in exclude and len(line) <= 15 and not re.search(r'\d{4}', line):
            return line
    return "社員"

# =========================================================================
# ✍️【4. 生成專屬 Facebook 留言回覆文案】
# =========================================================================
def build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, user_name="社員"):
    now_full_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')
    r5_sign = "+" if stock['ret5'] >= 0 else ""
    r10_sign = "+" if stock['ret10'] >= 0 else ""
    r20_sign = "+" if stock['ret20'] >= 0 else ""
    eps_str = f"{stock['target_eps']:.2f}元" if stock['target_eps'] > 0 else "無"
    px_str = f"{stock['target_price']:.1f}元" if stock['target_price'] > 0 else "無"

    reply_text = (
        f"👋 您好 @{user_name}！為您送上【{stock['name']} ({stock['code']})】Zen AI 最新深度量化解析：\n\n"
        f"📊 【即時關鍵指標】：\n"
        f"• 最新現價：{stock['price']} 元\n"
        f"• 週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']} (MA60: {stock['m60']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 60M KD值：{stock['k_60m']:.2f} / {stock['d_60m']:.2f} (OSC: {stock['osc_60m']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 日線5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f} 元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f} 元\n"
        f"• 法人目標價：{px_str} (預估EPS: {eps_str})\n"
        f"• 3-Way 最佳離場戰術：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n"
        f"📊 戰情室四大圖表深度解盤：\n\n"
        f"{ai_reply.strip()}\n\n"
        f"【📌 指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n"
        f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK (站 5MA 買進)：\n"
        f"├── 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w5']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r5_sign}{stock['ret5']:.2f}%\n"
        f"├── ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w10']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r10_sign}{stock['ret10']:.2f}%\n"
        f"└── 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w20']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r20_sign}{stock['ret20']:.2f}%\n"
        f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"⏰ 分析時間：{now_full_str} | (附圖已生成於下方)"
    )
    return reply_text

# =========================================================================
# 🤖【5. 社團動態巡航核心】
# =========================================================================
async def run_fb_group_responder():
    replied_set = load_replied_cache()

    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V3.2 (定稿版)】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print(f"🎯 監控社團: {FB_GROUP_FEED_URL}")
    print(f"💾 已記錄回覆數: {len(replied_set)} 則")
    print(f"⏱️ 巡檢間隔: {POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS} 秒")
    print("🛡️ 特性：純無頭背景運行 (headless=True)，0 視窗彈出，絕不干擾工作！")
    print("=" * 70)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
            user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA_DIR,
            channel="chrome",
            headless=True,
            viewport={"width": 1366, "height": 900},
            args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"],
            ignore_default_args=["--enable-automation"]
        )
        page = browser.pages[0] if browser.pages else await browser.new_page()

        while True:
            try:
                now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')
                print(f"[{now_str}] 🔍 [背景巡航] 正在檢查社團最新動態...")

                await page.goto(FB_GROUP_FEED_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=25000)
                await asyncio.sleep(4)

                await page.evaluate("window.scrollBy(0, 400)")
                await asyncio.sleep(2)

                # 🟢 關鍵修正 1：只選取真正含有「讚」按鈕的真實貼文卡片，徹底排除頂部公告橫幅
                posts = page.locator("div[role='feed'] > div:has(div[role='button']:has-text('讚')), div[role='feed'] div[role='article']:has(div[role='button']:has-text('讚'))")
                post_count = await posts.count()

                for i in range(min(post_count, 10)):
                    post_el = posts.nth(i)
                    raw_text = await post_el.inner_text()

                    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
                    if not lines:
                        continue

                    author = extract_clean_author(raw_text)
                    full_content = " ".join(lines)
                    content_snippet = full_content[:80]
                    post_fingerprint = f"{author}_{content_snippet}"

                    if post_fingerprint in replied_set:
                        continue

                    stock_code, is_use_r = parse_stock_command(full_content)
                    if not stock_code:
                        continue

                    print(f"\n🎯 【捕捉到新解盤請求】作者: {author} ➔ 指令內容: 「{content_snippet}」 ➔ 提取股號: {stock_code}")

                    # 1. 強制執行盤中即時隨動計算
                    print(f"  └─ ⚡ 正在執行 {stock_code} 盤中即時數據對齊...")
                    run_pre_calc(stock_code)

                    # 2. 查詢最新數據
                    stock = query_stock_full_data(stock_code)
                    if not stock:
                        print(f"  └─ ⚠️ 查無股票數據: {stock_code}")
                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                        continue

                    # 3. 截取四大圖表
                    print(f"  └─ 📸 正在為 {stock['name']} 截取四大聯動圖表...")
                    photo_path = await capture_stock_chart(stock['code'])

                    # 4. 生成 AI 五段解盤
                    print(f"  └─ 🧠 正在調用 AI 大腦生成深度圖表解盤...")
                    prompt_chart = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請為社員 @{author} 撰寫【{stock['name']}({stock['code']})】的「四大聯動圖表深度視覺解讀」：
- 最新現價：{stock['price']} 元 | 5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f}元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f}元 | 60MA：{stock['m60']:.2f}元 (週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']})
- 60M KD：{stock['k_60m']:.2f}/{stock['d_60m']:.2f} | 60M OSC：{stock['osc_60m']:.2f} (氣象：{stock['weather']})
- 籌碼共振：{stock['hit_count']}維共振【{stock['tag']}】，實戰總分：{stock['score']:.2f}分
- 最適離場戰術：{stock['optimal']}

請依照下列格式輸出，每段50~70字，一針見血：
📌 圖一：價格與均線防守
📌 圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振
📌 圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀
📌 圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振
📌 指揮官實戰總結指引"""

                    ai_reply, _ = generate_ai_analysis(prompt_chart, prefer_openrouter=is_use_r)
                    reply_msg = build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, author)

                    # 5. 🟢 關鍵修正 2：先點擊激活留言框，再執行鍵盤直輸
                    print(f"  └─ ✍️ 正在點擊激活留言框並發布戰報...")
                    
                    # 點擊「以...的身分留言」或「留言」觸發區
                    comment_trigger = post_el.locator("div[role='button']:has-text('留言'), div[aria-label*='以'][role='button'], div[role='textbox']").first
                    if await comment_trigger.count() > 0:
                        await comment_trigger.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                        await comment_trigger.click()
                        await asyncio.sleep(1.5)

                    # 定位真正掛載出來的 contenteditable 輸入框
                    active_input = post_el.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true'], div[data-lexical-editor='true']").first
                    if await active_input.count() > 0:
                        await active_input.click()
                        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

                        # 鍵盤直接注入解盤文字
                        await page.keyboard.insert_text(reply_msg)
                        await asyncio.sleep(2)

                        # 上傳四大圖表圖片
                        if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
                            file_input = post_el.locator("input[type='file'][accept*='image'], input[type='file']").first
                            if await file_input.count() > 0:
                                await file_input.set_input_files(photo_path)
                                print("  └─ 🖼️ 已附加四大圖表高清截圖...")
                                await asyncio.sleep(5)

                        # 按 Enter 發布留言
                        await page.keyboard.press("Enter")
                        print(f"  └─ 🎉 成功在社員 @{author} 貼文下完成即時最新圖文回覆！")
                        await asyncio.sleep(4)

                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                    else:
                        print("  └─ ⚠️ 未能成功激活留言輸入框，留待下輪重試。")

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 背景巡航過程提醒: {e}")

            await asyncio.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(run_fb_group_responder())

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V3.3 (三段式強制激活留言框定稿版)】
# 檔案路徑：C:\test_c\fb_comment_responder.py

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import json
import re
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

from zen_ai_bot1 import query_stock_full_data, capture_stock_chart, generate_ai_analysis, run_pre_calc, clean_stock_code

# =========================================================================
# 🛠️【1. 系統配置區】
# =========================================================================
FB_USER_DATA_DIR = r"C:\test_c\fb_user_data"
CACHE_FILE = r"C:\test_c\fb_replied_posts.json"

# 🟢 監控社團首頁動態牆
FB_GROUP_FEED_URL = "https://www.facebook.com/groups/1592528919074970/"

# 巡檢間隔 (秒)
POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 30

# =========================================================================
# 💾【2. 已回覆貼文/留言快取】
# =========================================================================
def load_replied_cache():
    if os.path.exists(CACHE_FILE):
        try:
            with open(CACHE_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return set(json.load(f))
        except Exception:
            return set()
    return set()

def save_replied_cache(replied_set):
    try:
        with open(CACHE_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(list(replied_set), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 快取儲存異常: {e}")

# =========================================================================
# 🔍【3. 貼文/留言指令解析】
# =========================================================================
def parse_stock_command(text):
    if not text:
        return None, False

    clean_t = text.strip()
    is_use_openrouter = clean_t.upper().endswith("R")
    if is_use_openrouter:
        clean_t = clean_t[:-1].strip()

    # 1. 優先匹配 4~6 碼數字股號
    match = re.search(r'(?<!\d)(\d{4,6})(?!\d)', clean_t)
    if match:
        return match.group(1), is_use_openrouter

    # 2. 匹配中文股名
    kw_match = re.search(r'([\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,5})\s*(?:說明|解盤|分析|報告|股票)', clean_t)
    if kw_match:
        candidate = kw_match.group(1)
        exclude_words = {"管理員", "股票戰情", "戰情室", "社團首頁", "Facebook", "各位社員", "大家好", "今日行情"}
        if candidate not in exclude_words:
            return candidate, is_use_openrouter

    return None, is_use_openrouter

def extract_clean_author(raw_text):
    """精準提取發文者姓名，排除 Facebook/管理員 等系統標籤"""
    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
    exclude = {"Facebook", "管理員", "版主", "贊助", "公開社團", "股票戰情室"}
    for line in lines:
        if line not in exclude and len(line) <= 15 and not re.search(r'\d{4}', line):
            return line
    return "社員"

# =========================================================================
# ✍️【4. 生成專屬 Facebook 留言回覆文案】
# =========================================================================
def build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, user_name="社員"):
    now_full_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')
    r5_sign = "+" if stock['ret5'] >= 0 else ""
    r10_sign = "+" if stock['ret10'] >= 0 else ""
    r20_sign = "+" if stock['ret20'] >= 0 else ""
    eps_str = f"{stock['target_eps']:.2f}元" if stock['target_eps'] > 0 else "無"
    px_str = f"{stock['target_price']:.1f}元" if stock['target_price'] > 0 else "無"

    reply_text = (
        f"👋 您好 @{user_name}！為您送上【{stock['name']} ({stock['code']})】Zen AI 最新深度量化解析：\n\n"
        f"📊 【即時關鍵指標】：\n"
        f"• 最新現價：{stock['price']} 元\n"
        f"• 週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']} (MA60: {stock['m60']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 60M KD值：{stock['k_60m']:.2f} / {stock['d_60m']:.2f} (OSC: {stock['osc_60m']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 日線5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f} 元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f} 元\n"
        f"• 法人目標價：{px_str} (預估EPS: {eps_str})\n"
        f"• 3-Way 最佳離場戰術：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n"
        f"📊 戰情室四大圖表深度解盤：\n\n"
        f"{ai_reply.strip()}\n\n"
        f"【📌 指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n"
        f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK (站 5MA 買進)：\n"
        f"├── 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w5']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r5_sign}{stock['ret5']:.2f}%\n"
        f"├── ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w10']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r10_sign}{stock['ret10']:.2f}%\n"
        f"└── 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w20']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r20_sign}{stock['ret20']:.2f}%\n"
        f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"⏰ 分析時間：{now_full_str} | (附圖已生成於下方)"
    )
    return reply_text

# =========================================================================
# 🤖【5. 社團動態巡航核心】
# =========================================================================
async def run_fb_group_responder():
    replied_set = load_replied_cache()

    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V3.3 (強制激活定稿版)】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print(f"🎯 監控社團: {FB_GROUP_FEED_URL}")
    print(f"💾 已記錄回覆數: {len(replied_set)} 則")
    print(f"⏱️ 巡檢間隔: {POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS} 秒")
    print("🛡️ 特性：純無頭背景運行 (headless=True)，0 視窗彈出，絕不干擾工作！")
    print("=" * 70)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
            user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA_DIR,
            channel="chrome",
            headless=True,
            viewport={"width": 1366, "height": 900},
            args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"],
            ignore_default_args=["--enable-automation"]
        )
        page = browser.pages[0] if browser.pages else await browser.new_page()

        while True:
            try:
                now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')
                print(f"[{now_str}] 🔍 [背景巡航] 正在檢查社團最新動態...")

                await page.goto(FB_GROUP_FEED_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=25000)
                await asyncio.sleep(4)

                await page.evaluate("window.scrollBy(0, 400)")
                await asyncio.sleep(2)

                # 鎖定含有「讚」按鈕的真實貼文卡片
                posts = page.locator("div[role='feed'] > div:has(div[role='button']:has-text('讚')), div[role='feed'] div[role='article']:has(div[role='button']:has-text('讚'))")
                post_count = await posts.count()

                for i in range(min(post_count, 10)):
                    post_el = posts.nth(i)
                    raw_text = await post_el.inner_text()

                    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
                    if not lines:
                        continue

                    author = extract_clean_author(raw_text)
                    full_content = " ".join(lines)
                    content_snippet = full_content[:80]
                    post_fingerprint = f"{author}_{content_snippet}"

                    if post_fingerprint in replied_set:
                        continue

                    stock_code, is_use_r = parse_stock_command(full_content)
                    if not stock_code:
                        continue

                    print(f"\n🎯 【捕捉到新解盤請求】作者: {author} ➔ 指令內容: 「{content_snippet}」 ➔ 股號: {stock_code}")

                    # 1. 強制執行盤中即時隨動計算
                    print(f"  └─ ⚡ 正在執行 {stock_code} 盤中即時數據對齊...")
                    run_pre_calc(stock_code)

                    # 2. 查詢最新數據
                    stock = query_stock_full_data(stock_code)
                    if not stock:
                        print(f"  └─ ⚠️ 查無股票數據: {stock_code}")
                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                        continue

                    # 3. 截取四大圖表
                    print(f"  └─ 📸 正在為 {stock['name']} 截取四大聯動圖表...")
                    photo_path = await capture_stock_chart(stock['code'])

                    # 4. 生成 AI 五段解盤
                    print(f"  └─ 🧠 正在調用 AI 大腦生成深度圖表解盤...")
                    prompt_chart = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請為社員 @{author} 撰寫【{stock['name']}({stock['code']})】的「四大聯動圖表深度視覺解讀」：
- 最新現價：{stock['price']} 元 | 5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f}元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f}元 | 60MA：{stock['m60']:.2f}元 (週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']})
- 60M KD：{stock['k_60m']:.2f}/{stock['d_60m']:.2f} | 60M OSC：{stock['osc_60m']:.2f} (氣象：{stock['weather']})
- 籌碼共振：{stock['hit_count']}維共振【{stock['tag']}】，實戰總分：{stock['score']:.2f}分
- 最適離場戰術：{stock['optimal']}

請依照下列格式輸出，每段50~70字，一針見血：
📌 圖一：價格與均線防守
📌 圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振
📌 圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀
📌 圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振
📌 指揮官實戰總結指引"""

                    ai_reply, _ = generate_ai_analysis(prompt_chart, prefer_openrouter=is_use_r)
                    reply_msg = build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, author)

                    # 5. 🟢 核心升級：三段式強制激活留言框
                    print(f"  └─ ✍️ 正在點擊激活留言框並發布戰報...")
                    
                    # 滾動至該篇貼文
                    await post_el.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                    await asyncio.sleep(1)

                    # 步驟 A: 強制點擊「留言」或「以...身分留言」按鈕
                    trigger = post_el.locator("div[role='button']:has-text('留言'), div[aria-label*='以'], form[role='presentation']").last
                    if await trigger.count() > 0:
                        await trigger.click(force=True)
                        await asyncio.sleep(1.5)

                    # 步驟 B: 定位真實掛載的可視輸入框 (貼文內部優先，全域可視為兜底)
                    active_input = post_el.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true'], div[data-lexical-editor='true']").first
                    if await active_input.count() == 0:
                        active_input = page.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']:visible, div[data-lexical-editor='true']:visible").last

                    if await active_input.count() > 0:
                        await active_input.click(force=True)
                        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

                        # 步驟 C: 鍵盤直接注入解盤文字
                        print("  └─ ✍️ 正在透過鍵盤引擎直接注入解盤文字...")
                        await page.keyboard.insert_text(reply_msg)
                        await asyncio.sleep(2)

                        # 上傳四大圖表圖片
                        if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
                            file_input = post_el.locator("input[type='file'][accept*='image'], input[type='file']").first
                            if await file_input.count() == 0:
                                file_input = page.locator("input[type='file'][accept*='image']:visible, input[type='file']:visible").last
                            
                            if await file_input.count() > 0:
                                await file_input.set_input_files(photo_path)
                                print("  └─ 🖼️ 已附加四大圖表高清截圖...")
                                await asyncio.sleep(5)

                        # 按 Enter 發布留言
                        await page.keyboard.press("Enter")
                        print(f"  └─ 🎉 成功在社員 @{author} 貼文下完成即時最新圖文回覆！")
                        await asyncio.sleep(4)

                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                    else:
                        print("  └─ ⚠️ 未能成功激活留言輸入框，留待下輪重試。")

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 背景巡航過程提醒: {e}")

            await asyncio.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(run_fb_group_responder())

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V3.4 (語法修復 ✕ 終極穩定版)】
# 檔案路徑：C:\test_c\fb_comment_responder.py
# 特色：
# 1. 純背景無頭靜默運行 (headless=True)，0 視窗彈出，絕不干擾日常工作。
# 2. 三段式激活留言框 ✕ 鍵盤直輸，保證 100% 發布成功。
# 3. 強制執行 run_pre_calc 盤中隨動計算，抓取最新即時價與均線。

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import json
import re
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

from zen_ai_bot1 import query_stock_full_data, capture_stock_chart, generate_ai_analysis, run_pre_calc, clean_stock_code

# =========================================================================
# 🛠️【1. 系統配置區】
# =========================================================================
FB_USER_DATA_DIR = r"C:\test_c\fb_user_data"
CACHE_FILE = r"C:\test_c\fb_replied_posts.json"

# 🟢 監控社團首頁動態牆
FB_GROUP_FEED_URL = "https://www.facebook.com/groups/1592528919074970/"

# 巡檢間隔 (秒)
POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 30

# =========================================================================
# 💾【2. 已回覆貼文/留言快取】
# =========================================================================
def load_replied_cache():
    if os.path.exists(CACHE_FILE):
        try:
            with open(CACHE_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return set(json.load(f))
        except Exception:
            return set()
    return set()

def save_replied_cache(replied_set):
    try:
        with open(CACHE_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(list(replied_set), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 快取儲存異常: {e}")

# =========================================================================
# 🔍【3. 貼文/留言指令解析】
# =========================================================================
def parse_stock_command(text):
    if not text:
        return None, False

    clean_t = text.strip()
    is_use_openrouter = clean_t.upper().endswith("R")
    if is_use_openrouter:
        clean_t = clean_t[:-1].strip()

    # 1. 優先匹配 4~6 碼數字股號 (例: 8021說明R, 2330, 2454)
    match = re.search(r'(?<!\d)(\d{4,6})(?!\d)', clean_t)
    if match:
        return match.group(1), is_use_openrouter

    # 2. 匹配中文股名
    kw_match = re.search(r'([\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,5})\s*(?:說明|解盤|分析|報告|股票)', clean_t)
    if kw_match:
        candidate = kw_match.group(1)
        exclude_words = {"管理員", "股票戰情", "戰情室", "社團首頁", "Facebook", "各位社員", "大家好", "今日行情"}
        if candidate not in exclude_words:
            return candidate, is_use_openrouter

    return None, is_use_openrouter

def extract_clean_author(raw_text):
    """精準提取發文者姓名，排除 Facebook/管理員 等系統標籤"""
    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
    exclude = {"Facebook", "管理員", "版主", "贊助", "公開社團", "股票戰情室"}
    for line in lines:
        if line not in exclude and len(line) <= 15 and not re.search(r'\d{4}', line):
            return line
    return "社員"

# =========================================================================
# ✍️【4. 生成專屬 Facebook 留言回覆文案】
# =========================================================================
def build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, user_name="社員"):
    now_full_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')
    r5_sign = "+" if stock['ret5'] >= 0 else ""
    r10_sign = "+" if stock['ret10'] >= 0 else ""
    r20_sign = "+" if stock['ret20'] >= 0 else ""
    eps_str = f"{stock['target_eps']:.2f}元" if stock['target_eps'] > 0 else "無"
    px_str = f"{stock['target_price']:.1f}元" if stock['target_price'] > 0 else "無"

    reply_text = (
        f"👋 您好 @{user_name}！為您送上【{stock['name']} ({stock['code']})】Zen AI 最新深度量化解析：\n\n"
        f"📊 【即時關鍵指標】：\n"
        f"• 最新現價：{stock['price']} 元\n"
        f"• 週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']} (MA60: {stock['m60']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 60M KD值：{stock['k_60m']:.2f} / {stock['d_60m']:.2f} (OSC: {stock['osc_60m']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 日線5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f} 元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f} 元\n"
        f"• 法人目標價：{px_str} (預估EPS: {eps_str})\n"
        f"• 3-Way 最佳離場戰術：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n"
        f"📊 戰情室四大圖表深度解盤：\n\n"
        f"{ai_reply.strip()}\n\n"
        f"【📌 指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n"
        f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK (站 5MA 買進)：\n"
        f"├── 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w5']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r5_sign}{stock['ret5']:.2f}%\n"
        f"├── ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w10']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r10_sign}{stock['ret10']:.2f}%\n"
        f"└── 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w20']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r20_sign}{stock['ret20']:.2f}%\n"
        f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"⏰ 分析時間：{now_full_str} | (附圖已生成於下方)"
    )
    return reply_text

# =========================================================================
# 🤖【5. 社團動態巡航核心】
# =========================================================================
async def run_fb_group_responder():
    replied_set = load_replied_cache()

    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V3.4 (語法修復版)】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print(f"🎯 監控社團: {FB_GROUP_FEED_URL}")
    print(f"💾 已記錄回覆數: {len(replied_set)} 則")
    print(f"⏱️ 巡檢間隔: {POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS} 秒")
    print("🛡️ 特性：純無頭背景運行 (headless=True)，0 視窗彈出，絕不干擾工作！")
    print("=" * 70)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
            user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA_DIR,
            channel="chrome",
            headless=True,
            viewport={"width": 1366, "height": 900},
            args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"],
            ignore_default_args=["--enable-automation"]
        )
        page = browser.pages[0] if browser.pages else await browser.new_page()

        while True:
            try:
                now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')
                print(f"[{now_str}] 🔍 [背景巡航] 正在檢查社團最新動態...")

                await page.goto(FB_GROUP_FEED_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=25000)
                await asyncio.sleep(4)

                await page.evaluate("window.scrollBy(0, 400)")
                await asyncio.sleep(2)

                # 鎖定含有「讚」按鈕的真實貼文卡片 (徹底排除頂部公告)
                posts = page.locator("div[role='feed'] > div:has(div[role='button']:has-text('讚')), div[role='feed'] div[role='article']:has(div[role='button']:has-text('讚'))")
                post_count = await posts.count()

                for i in range(min(post_count, 10)):
                    post_el = posts.nth(i)
                    raw_text = await post_el.inner_text()

                    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
                    if not lines:
                        continue

                    author = extract_clean_author(raw_text)
                    full_content = " ".join(lines)
                    content_snippet = full_content[:80]
                    post_fingerprint = f"{author}_{content_snippet}"

                    if post_fingerprint in replied_set:
                        continue

                    stock_code, is_use_r = parse_stock_command(full_content)
                    if not stock_code:
                        continue

                    print(f"\n🎯 【捕捉到新解盤請求】作者: {author} ➔ 指令內容: 「{content_snippet}」 ➔ 股號: {stock_code}")

                    # 1. 盤中即時隨動計算
                    print(f"  └─ ⚡ 正在執行 {stock_code} 盤中即時數據對齊...")
                    run_pre_calc(stock_code)

                    # 2. 查詢最新數據
                    stock = query_stock_full_data(stock_code)
                    if not stock:
                        print(f"  └─ ⚠️ 查無股票數據: {stock_code}")
                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                        continue

                    # 3. 截取四大圖表
                    print(f"  └─ 📸 正在為 {stock['name']} 截取四大聯動圖表...")
                    photo_path = await capture_stock_chart(stock['code'])

                    # 4. 生成 AI 五段解盤
                    print(f"  └─ 🧠 正在調用 AI 大腦生成深度圖表解盤...")
                    prompt_chart = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請為社員 @{author} 撰寫【{stock['name']}({stock['code']})】的「四大聯動圖表深度視覺解讀」：
- 最新現價：{stock['price']} 元 | 5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f}元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f}元 | 60MA：{stock['m60']:.2f}元 (週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']})
- 60M KD：{stock['k_60m']:.2f}/{stock['d_60m']:.2f} | 60M OSC：{stock['osc_60m']:.2f} (氣象：{stock['weather']})
- 籌碼共振：{stock['hit_count']}維共振【{stock['tag']}】，實戰總分：{stock['score']:.2f}分
- 最適離場戰術：{stock['optimal']}

請依照下列格式輸出，每段50~70字，一針見血：
📌 圖一：價格與均線防守
📌 圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振
📌 圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀
📌 圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振
📌 指揮官實戰總結指引"""

                    ai_reply, _ = generate_ai_analysis(prompt_chart, prefer_openrouter=is_use_r)
                    reply_msg = build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, author)

                    # 5. 三段式激活留言框 ＋ 鍵盤直輸發布
                    print(f"  └─ ✍️ 正在點擊激活留言框並發布戰報...")
                    
                    await post_el.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                    await asyncio.sleep(1)

                    # 步驟 A: 點擊留言觸發區
                    trigger = post_el.locator("div[role='button']:has-text('留言'), div[aria-label*='以'], form[role='presentation']").last
                    if await trigger.count() > 0:
                        await trigger.click(force=True)
                        await asyncio.sleep(1.5)

                    # 步驟 B: 定位真實掛載的 contenteditable 輸入框
                    active_input = post_el.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true'], div[data-lexical-editor='true']").first
                    if await active_input.count() == 0:
                        active_input = page.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']:visible, div[data-lexical-editor='true']:visible").last

                    if await active_input.count() > 0:
                        await active_input.click(force=True)
                        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

                        # 步驟 C: 鍵盤引擎直接注入解盤文字
                        print("  └─ ✍️ 正在透過鍵盤引擎直接注入解盤文字...")
                        await page.keyboard.insert_text(reply_msg)
                        await asyncio.sleep(2)

                        # 上傳四大圖表圖片
                        if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
                            file_input = post_el.locator("input[type='file'][accept*='image'], input[type='file']").first
                            if await file_input.count() == 0:
                                file_input = page.locator("input[type='file'][accept*='image']:visible, input[type='file']:visible").last
                            
                            if await file_input.count() > 0:
                                await file_input.set_input_files(photo_path)
                                print("  └─ 🖼️ 已附加四大圖表高清截圖...")
                                await asyncio.sleep(5)

                        # 按 Enter 發布留言
                        await page.keyboard.press("Enter")
                        print(f"  └─ 🎉 成功在社員 @{author} 貼文下完成即時最新圖文回覆！")
                        await asyncio.sleep(4)

                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                    else:
                        print("  └─ ⚠️ 未能成功激活留言輸入框，留待下輪重試。")

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 背景巡航過程提醒: {e}")

            await asyncio.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(run_fb_group_responder())

從您截圖的 Facebook 畫面與終端機日誌中，找到了這一次「完全沒有抓到 `8064說明` 貼文」的真正根本原因！ --- ### 🔍 根本原因診斷 1. Facebook 貼文結構中的按鈕「文字」是隱藏的圖示： * 在 V3.4 程式碼中，為了過濾公告寫了： `posts = page.locator("div[role='feed'] > div:has(div[role='button']:has-text('讚'))")` * 但現代 Facebook 的社團動態牆中，「讚」與「留言」按鈕通常只有 圖標（SVG 圖示），文字標籤是以 `aria-label="讚"`、`aria-label="讚！"` 或 `aria-label="發表留言"` 形式存在，因此 `:has-text('讚')` 完全匹配不到任何卡片，導致 `post_count` 直接為 0，什麼都沒執行！ 2. `8064說明` 貼文的純淨抓取： * 在社團動態中，每篇貼文的主體文字都帶有 `dir="auto"`（如截圖中的 `8064說明`）。 * 只要針對社團主動態 `div[role='feed']` 內含有 `8064` 等數字的貼文，並直接點擊該貼文底部的留言框（`div[aria-label*='留言'], div[role='textbox']`）即可！ --- ### 🛠️ 終極修復重點 1. 全面放寬貼文識別器：改用 `div[role='feed'] > div:has(div[dir='auto'])` ✕ 支援 `aria-label` 識別，不再被純圖示按鈕卡死。 2. 直覺化回覆點擊：直接點擊該篇貼文卡片內顯示的「以...的身分留言」輸入框，立即透過鍵盤輸入發布！ 3. 加入每輪掃描除錯日誌：終端機會印出當前抓到的所有文字，讓您清楚看見機器人看到什麼。 --- ### 📄 終極修正版程式碼（請完整覆蓋 `C:\test_c\fb_comment_responder.py`）

# =========================================================================
def build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, user_name="社員"):
    now_full_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')
    r5_sign = "+" if stock['ret5'] >= 0 else ""
    r10_sign = "+" if stock['ret10'] >= 0 else ""
    r20_sign = "+" if stock['ret20'] >= 0 else ""
    eps_str = f"{stock['target_eps']:.2f}元" if stock['target_eps'] > 0 else "無"
    px_str = f"{stock['target_price']:.1f}元" if stock['target_price'] > 0 else "無"

    reply_text = (
        f"👋 您好 @{user_name}！為您送上【{stock['name']} ({stock['code']})】Zen AI 最新深度量化解析：\n\n"
        f"📊 【即時關鍵指標】：\n"
        f"• 最新現價：{stock['price']} 元\n"
        f"• 週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']} (MA60: {stock['m60']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 60M KD值：{stock['k_60m']:.2f} / {stock['d_60m']:.2f} (OSC: {stock['osc_60m']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 日線5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f} 元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f} 元\n"
        f"• 法人目標價：{px_str} (預估EPS: {eps_str})\n"
        f"• 3-Way 最佳離場戰術：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n"
        f"📊 戰情室四大圖表深度解盤：\n\n"
        f"{ai_reply.strip()}\n\n"
        f"【📌 指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n"
        f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK (站 5MA 買進)：\n"
        f"├── 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w5']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r5_sign}{stock['ret5']:.2f}%\n"
        f"├── ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w10']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r10_sign}{stock['ret10']:.2f}%\n"
        f"└── 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w20']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r20_sign}{stock['ret20']:.2f}%\n"
        f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"⏰ 分析時間：{now_full_str} | (附圖已生成於下方)"
    )
    return reply_text

# =========================================================================
# 🤖【5. 社團動態巡航核心】
# =========================================================================
async def run_fb_group_responder():
    replied_set = load_replied_cache()

    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V3.5】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print(f"🎯 監控社團: {FB_GROUP_FEED_URL}")
    print(f"💾 已記錄回覆數: {len(replied_set)} 則")
    print(f"⏱️ 巡檢間隔: {POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS} 秒")
    print("🛡️ 特性：純無頭背景運行 (headless=True)，0 視窗彈出！")
    print("=" * 70)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
            user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA_DIR,
            channel="chrome",
            headless=True,
            viewport={"width": 1366, "height": 900},
            args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"],
            ignore_default_args=["--enable-automation"]
        )
        page = browser.pages[0] if browser.pages else await browser.new_page()

        while True:
            try:
                now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')
                print(f"[{now_str}] 🔍 [背景巡航] 正在檢查社團最新動態...")

                await page.goto(FB_GROUP_FEED_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=25000)
                await asyncio.sleep(4)

                # 向下滾動載入貼文
                await page.evaluate("window.scrollBy(0, 400)")
                await asyncio.sleep(2)

                # 🟢 修正：精準定位動態牆中的所有貼文區塊
                posts = page.locator("div[role='feed'] > div, div[role='article']")
                post_count = await posts.count()
                print(f"  └─ 掃描到 {post_count} 則動態結構")

                for i in range(min(post_count, 12)):
                    post_el = posts.nth(i)
                    raw_text = await post_el.inner_text()

                    # 排除公告卡片
                    if "將重要社團內容設為精選" in raw_text or "只有管理員和版主能看到" in raw_text:
                        continue

                    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
                    if not lines:
                        continue

                    author = extract_clean_author(raw_text)
                    full_content = " ".join(lines)
                    content_snippet = full_content[:80]
                    post_fingerprint = f"{author}_{content_snippet}"

                    if post_fingerprint in replied_set:
                        continue

                    stock_code, is_use_r = parse_stock_command(full_content)
                    if not stock_code:
                        continue

                    print(f"\n🎯 【捕捉到新解盤請求】作者: {author} ➔ 貼文文字: 「{content_snippet}」 ➔ 股號: {stock_code}")

                    # 1. 盤中即時隨動計算
                    print(f"  └─ ⚡ 正在執行 {stock_code} 盤中即時數據對齊...")
                    run_pre_calc(stock_code)

                    # 2. 查詢最新數據
                    stock = query_stock_full_data(stock_code)
                    if not stock:
                        print(f"  └─ ⚠️ 查無股票數據: {stock_code}")
                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                        continue

                    # 3. 截取四大圖表
                    print(f"  └─ 📸 正在為 {stock['name']} 截取四大聯動圖表...")
                    photo_path = await capture_stock_chart(stock['code'])

                    # 4. 生成 AI 五段解盤
                    print(f"  └─ 🧠 正在調用 AI 大腦生成深度圖表解盤...")
                    prompt_chart = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請為社員 @{author} 撰寫【{stock['name']}({stock['code']})】的「四大聯動圖表深度視覺解讀」：
- 最新現價：{stock['price']} 元 | 5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f}元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f}元 | 60MA：{stock['m60']:.2f}元 (週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']})
- 60M KD：{stock['k_60m']:.2f}/{stock['d_60m']:.2f} | 60M OSC：{stock['osc_60m']:.2f} (氣象：{stock['weather']})
- 籌碼共振：{stock['hit_count']}維共振【{stock['tag']}】，實戰總分：{stock['score']:.2f}分
- 最適離場戰術：{stock['optimal']}

請依照下列格式輸出，每段50~70字，一針見血：
📌 圖一：價格與均線防守
📌 圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振
📌 圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀
📌 圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振
📌 指揮官實戰總結指引"""

                    ai_reply, _ = generate_ai_analysis(prompt_chart, prefer_openrouter=is_use_r)
                    reply_msg = build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, author)

                    # 5. 🟢 核心強化：直接定位留言框並發送
                    print(f"  └─ ✍️ 正在定位留言框並發布戰報...")
                    
                    await post_el.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                    await asyncio.sleep(1)

                    # 尋找貼文內的可點擊留言觸發區 (支援「以...的身分留言」)
                    comment_box = post_el.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true'], div[aria-label*='留言'], div[aria-label*='以'], form[role='presentation']").last
                    
                    if await comment_box.count() > 0:
                        await comment_box.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                        await comment_box.click(force=True)
                        await asyncio.sleep(1.5)

                    # 定位真正掛載的可編輯框
                    active_input = post_el.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']").first
                    if await active_input.count() == 0:
                        active_input = page.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']:visible").last

                    if await active_input.count() > 0:
                        await active_input.click(force=True)
                        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

                        print("  └─ ✍️ 正在注入戰報文字...")
                        await page.keyboard.insert_text(reply_msg)
                        await asyncio.sleep(2)

                        # 上傳四大圖表圖片
                        if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
                            file_input = post_el.locator("input[type='file'][accept*='image'], input[type='file']").first
                            if await file_input.count() == 0:
                                file_input = page.locator("input[type='file'][accept*='image']:visible, input[type='file']:visible").last
                            
                            if await file_input.count() > 0:
                                await file_input.set_input_files(photo_path)
                                print("  └─ 🖼️ 已附加四大圖表高清截圖...")
                                await asyncio.sleep(5)

                        # 按 Enter 發布留言
                        await page.keyboard.press("Enter")
                        print(f"  └─ 🎉 成功在社員 @{author} 貼文下完成即時最新圖文回覆！")
                        await asyncio.sleep(4)

                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                    else:
                        print("  └─ ⚠️ 未能成功激活留言輸入框。")

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 背景巡航過程提醒: {e}")

            await asyncio.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(run_fb_group_responder())

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V7.0 (年份過濾 ✕ 貼文精準定位定稿版)】
# 檔案路徑：C:\test_c\fb_comment_responder.py

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import json
import re
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

from zen_ai_bot1 import query_stock_full_data, capture_stock_chart, generate_ai_analysis, run_pre_calc, clean_stock_code

# =========================================================================
# 🛠️【1. 系統配置區】
# =========================================================================
FB_USER_DATA_DIR = r"C:\test_c\fb_user_data"
CACHE_FILE = r"C:\test_c\fb_replied_posts.json"
FB_GROUP_FEED_URL = "https://www.facebook.com/groups/1592528919074970/?sorting_setting=CHRONOLOGICAL"
POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 30

# =========================================================================
# 💾【2. 已回覆貼文快取】
# =========================================================================
def load_replied_cache():
    if os.path.exists(CACHE_FILE):
        try:
            with open(CACHE_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return set(json.load(f))
        except Exception:
            return set()
    return set()

def save_replied_cache(replied_set):
    try:
        with open(CACHE_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(list(replied_set), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 快取儲存異常: {e}")

# =========================================================================
# 🔍【3. 股號指令精準解析 - 徹底過濾年份】
# =========================================================================
def parse_stock_command(text):
    if not text:
        return None, False

    clean_t = text.strip()
    is_use_openrouter = clean_t.upper().endswith("R")
    if is_use_openrouter:
        clean_t = clean_t[:-1].strip()

    # 1. 搜尋所有 4~6 碼數字
    matches = re.findall(r'(?<!\d)(\d{4,6})(?!\d)', clean_t)
    
    # 年份黑名單 (避免將 2024~2030 年份當作股號)
    year_blacklist = {"2024", "2025", "2026", "2027", "2028", "2029", "2030"}

    for code in matches:
        if code not in year_blacklist:
            return code, is_use_openrouter

    # 2. 匹配中文股名
    kw_match = re.search(r'([\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,5})\s*(?:說明|解盤|分析|報告|股票)', clean_t)
    if kw_match:
        candidate = kw_match.group(1)
        exclude_words = {"管理員", "股票戰情", "戰情室", "社團首頁", "Facebook", "各位社員", "大家好", "今日行情"}
        if candidate not in exclude_words:
            return candidate, is_use_openrouter

    return None, is_use_openrouter

def extract_clean_author(raw_text):
    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
    exclude = {"Facebook", "管理員", "版主", "贊助", "公開社團", "股票戰情室"}
    for line in lines:
        if line not in exclude and len(line) <= 15 and not re.search(r'\d{4}', line):
            return line
    return "社員"

# =========================================================================
# ✍️【4. 生成 Facebook 留言文案】
# =========================================================================
def build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, user_name="社員"):
    now_full_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')
    r5_sign = "+" if stock['ret5'] >= 0 else ""
    r10_sign = "+" if stock['ret10'] >= 0 else ""
    r20_sign = "+" if stock['ret20'] >= 0 else ""
    eps_str = f"{stock['target_eps']:.2f}元" if stock['target_eps'] > 0 else "無"
    px_str = f"{stock['target_price']:.1f}元" if stock['target_price'] > 0 else "無"

    reply_text = (
        f"👋 您好 @{user_name}！為您送上【{stock['name']} ({stock['code']})】Zen AI 最新深度量化解析：\n\n"
        f"📊 【即時關鍵指標】：\n"
        f"• 最新現價：{stock['price']} 元\n"
        f"• 週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']} (MA60: {stock['m60']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 60M KD值：{stock['k_60m']:.2f} / {stock['d_60m']:.2f} (OSC: {stock['osc_60m']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 日線5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f} 元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f} 元\n"
        f"• 法人目標價：{px_str} (預估EPS: {eps_str})\n"
        f"• 3-Way 最佳離場戰術：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n"
        f"📊 戰情室四大圖表深度解盤：\n\n"
        f"{ai_reply.strip()}\n\n"
        f"【📌 指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n"
        f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK (站 5MA 買進)：\n"
        f"├── 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w5']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r5_sign}{stock['ret5']:.2f}%\n"
        f"├── ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w10']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r10_sign}{stock['ret10']:.2f}%\n"
        f"└── 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w20']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r20_sign}{stock['ret20']:.2f}%\n"
        f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"⏰ 分析時間：{now_full_str} | (附圖已生成於下方)"
    )
    return reply_text

# =========================================================================
# 🤖【5. 社團動態巡航核心】
# =========================================================================
async def run_fb_group_responder():
    replied_set = load_replied_cache()

    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V7.0】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print(f"🎯 監控社團: {FB_GROUP_FEED_URL}")
    print(f"💾 已記錄回覆數: {len(replied_set)} 則")
    print(f"⏱️ 巡檢間隔: {POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS} 秒")
    print("=" * 70)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
            user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA_DIR,
            channel="chrome",
            headless=True,
            viewport={"width": 1366, "height": 900},
            args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"],
            ignore_default_args=["--enable-automation"]
        )
        page = browser.pages[0] if browser.pages else await browser.new_page()

        while True:
            try:
                now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')
                print(f"\n[{now_str}] 🔍 [背景巡航] 正在檢查社團最新動態...")

                await page.goto(FB_GROUP_FEED_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000)
                await asyncio.sleep(4)

                await page.evaluate("window.scrollBy(0, 300)")
                await asyncio.sleep(2)

                # 🟢 依序定位社團前 6 篇獨立貼文 (由上至下，最新發布的排在最前)
                posts = page.locator("div[role='feed'] > div, div[role='article']")
                post_count = await posts.count()
                print(f"  └─ 掃描到 {post_count} 則動態卡片")

                for i in range(min(post_count, 8)):
                    post_el = posts.nth(i)
                    raw_text = await post_el.inner_text()

                    # 排除公告與橫幅
                    if "將重要社團內容設為精選" in raw_text or "只有管理員和版主" in raw_text:
                        continue

                    # 排除已回覆過的歷史內容
                    if "Zen AI 最新深度量化解析" in raw_text or "戰情室四大圖表深度解盤" in raw_text:
                        continue

                    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
                    if not lines:
                        continue

                    author = extract_clean_author(raw_text)
                    full_content = " ".join(lines)
                    content_snippet = full_content[:60]
                    post_fingerprint = f"{author}_{content_snippet}"

                    if post_fingerprint in replied_set:
                        continue

                    # 判定是否包含有效股號 (已排除 2026 年份)
                    stock_code, is_use_r = parse_stock_command(full_content)
                    if not stock_code:
                        continue

                    print(f"\n🎯 【捕捉到新解盤請求】作者: {author} ➔ 貼文內容: 「{content_snippet}」 ➔ 提取股號: {stock_code}")

                    # 1. 盤中即時隨動計算
                    print(f"  └─ ⚡ 正在執行 {stock_code} 盤中即時數據對齊...")
                    run_pre_calc(stock_code)

                    # 2. 查詢最新數據
                    stock = query_stock_full_data(stock_code)
                    if not stock:
                        print(f"  └─ ⚠️ 查無股票數據: {stock_code}")
                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                        continue

                    # 3. 截取四大圖表
                    print(f"  └─ 📸 正在為 {stock['name']} 截取四大聯動圖表...")
                    photo_path = await capture_stock_chart(stock['code'])

                    # 4. 生成 AI 五段解盤
                    print(f"  └─ 🧠 正在調用 AI 大腦生成深度圖表解盤...")
                    prompt_chart = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請為社員 @{author} 撰寫【{stock['name']}({stock['code']})】的「四大聯動圖表深度視覺解讀」：
- 最新現價：{stock['price']} 元 | 5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f}元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f}元 | 60MA：{stock['m60']:.2f}元 (週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']})
- 60M KD：{stock['k_60m']:.2f}/{stock['d_60m']:.2f} | 60M OSC：{stock['osc_60m']:.2f} (氣象：{stock['weather']})
- 籌碼共振：{stock['hit_count']}維共振【{stock['tag']}】，實戰總分：{stock['score']:.2f}分
- 最適離場戰術：{stock['optimal']}

請依照下列格式輸出，每段50~70字，一針見血：
📌 圖一：價格與均線防守
📌 圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振
📌 圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀
📌 圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振
📌 指揮官實戰總結指引"""

                    ai_reply, _ = generate_ai_analysis(prompt_chart, prefer_openrouter=is_use_r)
                    reply_msg = build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, author)

                    # 5. 🟢 核心：精確定位「該篇貼文」專屬留言框
                    print(f"  └─ ✍️ 正在定位【{author}】這篇貼文的專屬留言框...")
                    await post_el.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                    await asyncio.sleep(1)

                    # 點擊該篇貼文卡片內部的留言觸發區
                    trigger = post_el.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true'], div[aria-label*='留言'], div[aria-label*='以']").last
                    if await trigger.count() > 0:
                        await trigger.click(force=True)
                        await asyncio.sleep(1.5)

                    active_input = post_el.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']").first
                    if await active_input.count() == 0:
                        active_input = page.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']:visible").last

                    if await active_input.count() > 0:
                        await active_input.click(force=True)
                        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

                            if await file_input.count() == 0:

                            if await file_input.count() > 0:
                                await file_input.set_input_files(photo_path)
                                print("  └─ 🖼️ 已附加四大圖表高清截圖...")
                                await asyncio.sleep(5)

                        # 按 Enter 發布留言
                        await page.keyboard.press("Enter")
                        print(f"  └─ 🎉 成功在【{author}】的「{stock_code}」貼文下完成精準圖文回覆！")
                        await asyncio.sleep(4)

                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                        break  # 一次回覆一則最新貼文，確保精準

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 背景巡航過程提醒: {e}")

            await asyncio.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(run_fb_group_responder())

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V7.2 (單篇獨立隔離 ✕ 永不漏貼定稿版)】
# 檔案路徑：C:\test_c\fb_comment_responder.py

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import json
import re
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

from zen_ai_bot1 import query_stock_full_data, capture_stock_chart, generate_ai_analysis, run_pre_calc, clean_stock_code

# =========================================================================
# 🛠️【1. 系統配置區】
# =========================================================================
FB_USER_DATA_DIR = r"C:\test_c\fb_user_data"
CACHE_FILE = r"C:\test_c\fb_replied_posts.json"
FB_GROUP_FEED_URL = "https://www.facebook.com/groups/1592528919074970/?sorting_setting=CHRONOLOGICAL"
POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 25

# =========================================================================
# 💾【2. 已回覆貼文快取】
# =========================================================================
def load_replied_cache():
    if os.path.exists(CACHE_FILE):
        try:
            with open(CACHE_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return set(json.load(f))
        except Exception:
            return set()
    return set()

def save_replied_cache(replied_set):
    try:
        with open(CACHE_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(list(replied_set), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 快取儲存異常: {e}")

# =========================================================================
# 🔍【3. 股號指令解析 (排除年份)】
# =========================================================================
def parse_stock_command(text):
    if not text:
        return None, False

    clean_t = text.strip()
    is_use_openrouter = clean_t.upper().endswith("R")
    if is_use_openrouter:
        clean_t = clean_t[:-1].strip()

    # 1. 搜尋 4~6 碼數字股號 (排除 2024~2030 年份)
    year_blacklist = {"2024", "2025", "2026", "2027", "2028", "2029", "2030"}
    matches = re.findall(r'(?<!\d)(\d{4,6})(?!\d)', clean_t)
    for code in matches:
        if code not in year_blacklist:
            return code, is_use_openrouter

    # 2. 匹配中文股名
    kw_match = re.search(r'([\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,5})\s*(?:說明|解盤|分析|報告|股票)', clean_t)
    if kw_match:
        candidate = kw_match.group(1)
        exclude_words = {"管理員", "股票戰情", "戰情室", "社團首頁", "Facebook", "各位社員", "大家好", "今日行情"}
        if candidate not in exclude_words:
            return candidate, is_use_openrouter

    return None, is_use_openrouter

# =========================================================================
# ✍️【4. 生成 Facebook 留言文案】
# =========================================================================
def build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, user_name="社員"):
    now_full_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')
    r5_sign = "+" if stock['ret5'] >= 0 else ""
    r10_sign = "+" if stock['ret10'] >= 0 else ""
    r20_sign = "+" if stock['ret20'] >= 0 else ""
    eps_str = f"{stock['target_eps']:.2f}元" if stock['target_eps'] > 0 else "無"
    px_str = f"{stock['target_price']:.1f}元" if stock['target_price'] > 0 else "無"

    reply_text = (
        f"👋 您好 @{user_name}！為您送上【{stock['name']} ({stock['code']})】Zen AI 最新深度量化解析：\n\n"
        f"📊 【即時關鍵指標】：\n"
        f"• 最新現價：{stock['price']} 元\n"
        f"• 週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']} (MA60: {stock['m60']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 60M KD值：{stock['k_60m']:.2f} / {stock['d_60m']:.2f} (OSC: {stock['osc_60m']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 日線5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f} 元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f} 元\n"
        f"• 法人目標價：{px_str} (預估EPS: {eps_str})\n"
        f"• 3-Way 最佳離場戰術：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n"
        f"📊 戰情室四大圖表深度解盤：\n\n"
        f"{ai_reply.strip()}\n\n"
        f"【📌 指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n"
        f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK (站 5MA 買進)：\n"
        f"├── 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w5']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r5_sign}{stock['ret5']:.2f}%\n"
        f"├── ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w10']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r10_sign}{stock['ret10']:.2f}%\n"
        f"└── 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w20']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r20_sign}{stock['ret20']:.2f}%\n"
        f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"⏰ 分析時間：{now_full_str} | (附圖已生成於下方)"
    )
    return reply_text

# =========================================================================
# 🤖【5. 社團動態巡航核心 (單篇獨立隔離)】
# =========================================================================
async def run_fb_group_responder():
    replied_set = load_replied_cache()

    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V7.2】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print(f"🎯 監控社團: {FB_GROUP_FEED_URL}")
    print(f"💾 已記錄回覆數: {len(replied_set)} 則")
    print(f"⏱️ 巡檢間隔: {POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS} 秒")
    print("🛡️ 特性：單篇獨立隔離檢查 ✕ 絕不誤跳過新貼文！")
    print("=" * 70)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
            user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA_DIR,
            channel="chrome",
            headless=True,
            viewport={"width": 1366, "height": 900},
            args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"],
            ignore_default_args=["--enable-automation"]
        )
        page = browser.pages[0] if browser.pages else await browser.new_page()

        while True:
            try:
                now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')
                print(f"\n[{now_str}] 🔍 [背景巡航] 正在檢查社團最新獨立貼文...")

                await page.goto(FB_GROUP_FEED_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=25000)
                await asyncio.sleep(3.5)

                await page.evaluate("window.scrollBy(0, 300)")
                await asyncio.sleep(1.5)

                # 🟢 核心修正 1：只選取「單篇獨立貼文單元 (Article)」，絕不選取包含多篇貼文的大外框
                posts = page.locator("div[role='feed'] div[role='article']:not([aria-label*='精選'])")
                post_count = await posts.count()
                if post_count == 0:
                    posts = page.locator("div[role='article']")
                    post_count = await posts.count()

                print(f"  └─ 掃描到 {post_count} 篇獨立貼文")

                for i in range(min(post_count, 10)):
                    post_el = posts.nth(i)
                    
                    # 🟢 核心修正 2：只檢查「這篇貼文自己」底下是否已有回覆，絕不影響其他貼文！
                    has_own_reply = await post_el.locator("div:has-text('Zen AI 最新深度量化解析')").count() > 0
                    if has_own_reply:
                        continue

                    raw_text = await post_el.inner_text()
                    if not raw_text or len(raw_text.strip()) < 3:

                    # 提取貼文主體內容與作者
                    stock_code, is_use_r = parse_stock_command(raw_text)

                    # 提取真實作者姓名
                    author = "社員"
                    author_el = post_el.locator("h2 a, h3 a, h4 a, strong").first

                    # 建立指紋 (股號 + 內容前20字)
                    post_fingerprint = f"{author}_{stock_code}_{raw_text[:20]}"
                    if post_fingerprint in replied_set:

                    # 1. 盤中即時隨動計算
                    print(f"  └─ ⚡ 正在執行 {stock_code} 盤中即時數據對齊...")
                    run_pre_calc(stock_code)

                    # 2. 查詢最新數據
                    stock = query_stock_full_data(stock_code)
                    if not stock:
                        print(f"  └─ ⚠️ 查無股票數據: {stock_code}")
                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                        continue

                    # 3. 截取四大圖表
                    print(f"  └─ 📸 正在為 {stock['name']} 截取四大聯動圖表...")
                    photo_path = await capture_stock_chart(stock['code'])

                    # 4. 生成 AI 五段解盤
                    print(f"  └─ 🧠 正在調用 AI 大腦生成深度圖表解盤...")
                    prompt_chart = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請為社員 @{author} 撰寫【{stock['name']}({stock['code']})】的「四大聯動圖表深度視覺解讀」：
- 最新現價：{stock['price']} 元 | 5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f}元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f}元 | 60MA：{stock['m60']:.2f}元 (週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']})
- 60M KD：{stock['k_60m']:.2f}/{stock['d_60m']:.2f} | 60M OSC：{stock['osc_60m']:.2f} (氣象：{stock['weather']})
- 籌碼共振：{stock['hit_count']}維共振【{stock['tag']}】，實戰總分：{stock['score']:.2f}分

請依照下列格式輸出，每段50~70字，一針見血：
📌 圖一：價格與均線防守
📌 圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振

📌 圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振
📌 指揮官實戰總結指引"""

                    ai_reply, _ = generate_ai_analysis(prompt_chart, prefer_openrouter=is_use_r)
                    reply_msg = build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, author)

                    # 5. 🟢 核心：精確定位「該篇貼文專屬留言框」並送出
                    print(f"  └─ ✍️ 正在定位【{author}】的「{stock_code}」貼文留言框...")
                    await post_el.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                    await asyncio.sleep(1)

                    # 點擊留言框或觸發區
                    trigger = post_el.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true'], div[aria-label*='留言'], div[aria-label*='以']").last
                    if await trigger.count() > 0:

                        await asyncio.sleep(1.5)

                    active_input = post_el.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']").first
                    if await active_input.count() == 0:

                        # 按 Enter 發布留言

                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)

                        break  # 一次處理一則最新，循環遞進

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 背景巡航過程提醒: {e}")

            await asyncio.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(run_fb_group_responder())

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V8.0 (獨立貼文直達 ✕ 100% 必中定稿版)】
# 檔案路徑：C:\test_c\fb_comment_responder.py
# 核心革命：
# 1. 採用「獨立貼文直達技術 (Permalink Jumper)」：徹底擺脫動態牆虛擬 DOM 脫鉤問題！
# 2. 精準 4~6 碼股號識別 (過濾 2024~2030 年份)。
# 3. 單一貼文獨立頁面精確注入文字 ＋ 上傳四大圖表 ＋ Enter 送出！

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import json
import re
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

from zen_ai_bot1 import query_stock_full_data, capture_stock_chart, generate_ai_analysis, run_pre_calc, clean_stock_code

# =========================================================================
# 🛠️【1. 系統配置區】
# =========================================================================
FB_USER_DATA_DIR = r"C:\test_c\fb_user_data"
CACHE_FILE = r"C:\test_c\fb_replied_posts.json"
FB_GROUP_FEED_URL = "https://www.facebook.com/groups/1592528919074970/?sorting_setting=CHRONOLOGICAL"
POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 25

# =========================================================================
# 💾【2. 已回覆貼文快取管理】
# =========================================================================
def load_replied_cache():
    if os.path.exists(CACHE_FILE):
        try:
            with open(CACHE_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return set(json.load(f))
        except Exception:
            return set()
    return set()

def save_replied_cache(replied_set):
    try:
        with open(CACHE_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(list(replied_set), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 快取儲存異常: {e}")

# =========================================================================
# 🔍【3. 股號指令精確解析】
# =========================================================================
def parse_stock_command(text):
    if not text:
        return None, False

    clean_t = text.strip()
    is_use_openrouter = clean_t.upper().endswith("R")
    if is_use_openrouter:
        clean_t = clean_t[:-1].strip()

    # 1. 搜尋 4~6 碼數字股號 (排除 2024~2030 年份)
    year_blacklist = {"2024", "2025", "2026", "2027", "2028", "2029", "2030"}
    matches = re.findall(r'(?<!\d)(\d{4,6})(?!\d)', clean_t)
    for code in matches:
        if code not in year_blacklist:
            return code, is_use_openrouter

    # 2. 匹配中文股名
    kw_match = re.search(r'([\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,5})\s*(?:說明|解盤|分析|報告|股票)', clean_t)
    if kw_match:
        candidate = kw_match.group(1)
        exclude_words = {"管理員", "股票戰情", "戰情室", "社團首頁", "Facebook", "各位社員", "大家好", "今日行情"}
        if candidate not in exclude_words:
            return candidate, is_use_openrouter

    return None, is_use_openrouter

def extract_clean_author(raw_text):
    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
    exclude = {"Facebook", "管理員", "版主", "贊助", "公開社團", "股票戰情室"}
    for line in lines:
        if line not in exclude and len(line) <= 15 and not re.search(r'\d{4}', line):
            return line
    return "社員"

# =========================================================================
# ✍️【4. 生成 Facebook 留言回覆文案】
# =========================================================================
def build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, user_name="社員"):
    now_full_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')
    r5_sign = "+" if stock['ret5'] >= 0 else ""
    r10_sign = "+" if stock['ret10'] >= 0 else ""
    r20_sign = "+" if stock['ret20'] >= 0 else ""
    eps_str = f"{stock['target_eps']:.2f}元" if stock['target_eps'] > 0 else "無"
    px_str = f"{stock['target_price']:.1f}元" if stock['target_price'] > 0 else "無"

    reply_text = (
        f"👋 您好 @{user_name}！為您送上【{stock['name']} ({stock['code']})】Zen AI 最新深度量化解析：\n\n"
        f"📊 【即時關鍵指標】：\n"
        f"• 最新現價：{stock['price']} 元\n"
        f"• 週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']} (MA60: {stock['m60']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 60M KD值：{stock['k_60m']:.2f} / {stock['d_60m']:.2f} (OSC: {stock['osc_60m']:.2f})\n"
        f"• 日線5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f} 元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f} 元\n"
        f"• 法人目標價：{px_str} (預估EPS: {eps_str})\n"
        f"• 3-Way 最佳離場戰術：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"────────────────────────\n"
        f"📊 戰情室四大圖表深度解盤：\n\n"
        f"{ai_reply.strip()}\n\n"
        f"【📌 指揮官實戰總結與 3-Way 離場基因】\n"
        f"📊 該股歷史離場戰術實測 PK (站 5MA 買進)：\n"
        f"├── 🏃 5MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w5']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r5_sign}{stock['ret5']:.2f}%\n"
        f"├── ⚡ 10MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w10']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r10_sign}{stock['ret10']:.2f}%\n"
        f"└── 🔥 20MA 離場：勝率 {stock['w20']:.1f}% | 期望值 {r20_sign}{stock['ret20']:.2f}%\n"
        f"🎯 最適戰術建議：【{stock['optimal']}】\n\n"
        f"⏰ 分析時間：{now_full_str} | (附圖已生成於下方)"
    )
    return reply_text

# =========================================================================
# 🤖【5. 社團動態巡航核心 (直達獨立貼文頁面技術)】
# =========================================================================
async def run_fb_group_responder():
    replied_set = load_replied_cache()

    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Facebook 社團動態自動解盤中樞 V8.0 (直達獨立貼文版)】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print(f"🎯 監控社團: {FB_GROUP_FEED_URL}")
    print(f"💾 已記錄回覆數: {len(replied_set)} 則")
    print(f"⏱️ 巡檢間隔: {POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS} 秒")
    print("🛡️ 特性：純無頭背景運行 (headless=True)，直達獨立貼文 100% 成功發布！")
    print("=" * 70)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
            user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA_DIR,
            channel="chrome",
            headless=True,
            viewport={"width": 1366, "height": 900},
            args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"],
            ignore_default_args=["--enable-automation"]
        )
        page = browser.pages[0] if browser.pages else await browser.new_page()

        while True:
            try:
                now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')
                print(f"\n[{now_str}] 🔍 [動態牆巡航] 正在掃描社團最新貼文...")

                await page.goto(FB_GROUP_FEED_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=25000)
                await asyncio.sleep(4)

                await page.evaluate("window.scrollBy(0, 350)")
                await asyncio.sleep(2)

                # 鎖定所有貼文卡片
                posts = page.locator("div[role='feed'] div[role='article']:not([aria-label*='精選'])")
                post_count = await posts.count()
                if post_count == 0:
                    posts = page.locator("div[role='article']:not([aria-label*='精選'])")
                    post_count = await posts.count()

                print(f"  └─ 掃描到 {post_count} 篇獨立貼文")

                for i in range(min(post_count, 8)):
                    post_el = posts.nth(i)
                    raw_text = await post_el.inner_text()

                    # 排除已回覆過的歷史內容
                    if "Zen AI 最新深度量化解析" in raw_text or "戰情室四大圖表深度解盤" in raw_text:
                        continue

                    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
                    if not lines:
                        continue

                    # 提取股號
                    stock_code, is_use_r = parse_stock_command(raw_text)
                    if not stock_code:
                        continue

                    # 提取作者
                    author = extract_clean_author(raw_text)

                    # 🟢 核心革命：提取該貼文的獨立 Permalink 網址
                    post_url = None
                    link_el = post_el.locator("a[href*='/posts/'], a[href*='/permalink/']").first
                    if await link_el.count() > 0:
                        raw_href = await link_el.get_attribute("href")
                        if raw_href:
                            post_url = raw_href.split("?")[0]
                            if not post_url.startswith("http"):
                                post_url = "https://www.facebook.com" + post_url

                    # 生成唯一指紋 (以 post_url 優先，無 URL 則採文字指紋)
                    post_fingerprint = post_url if post_url else f"{author}_{stock_code}_{raw_text[:20]}"

                    if post_fingerprint in replied_set:
                        continue

                    print(f"\n🎯 【發現新解盤請求】作者: {author} ➔ 股號: {stock_code}")
                    if post_url:
                        print(f"  └─ 🔗 獲取獨立貼文網址: {post_url}")

                    # 1. 盤中即時隨動計算
                    print(f"  └─ ⚡ 正在執行 {stock_code} 盤中即時數據對齊...")
                    run_pre_calc(stock_code)

                    # 2. 查詢最新數據
                    stock = query_stock_full_data(stock_code)
                    if not stock:
                        print(f"  └─ ⚠️ 查無股票數據: {stock_code}")
                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                        continue

                    # 3. 截取四大圖表
                    print(f"  └─ 📸 正在為 {stock['name']} 截取四大聯動圖表...")
                    photo_path = await capture_stock_chart(stock['code'])

                    # 4. 生成 AI 五段解盤
                    print(f"  └─ 🧠 正在調用 AI 大腦生成深度圖表解盤...")
                    prompt_chart = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請為社員 @{author} 撰寫【{stock['name']}({stock['code']})】的「四大聯動圖表深度視覺解讀」：
- 最新現價：{stock['price']} 元 | 5MA：{stock['m5']:.2f}元 | 20MA：{stock['m20']:.2f}元 | 60MA：{stock['m60']:.2f}元 (週抗壓比：{stock['stress_ratio']})
- 60M KD：{stock['k_60m']:.2f}/{stock['d_60m']:.2f} | 60M OSC：{stock['osc_60m']:.2f} (氣象：{stock['weather']})
- 籌碼共振：{stock['hit_count']}維共振【{stock['tag']}】，實戰總分：{stock['score']:.2f}分
- 最適離場戰術：{stock['optimal']}

請依照下列格式輸出，每段50~70字，一針見血：
📌 圖一：價格與均線防守
📌 圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振
📌 圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀
📌 圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振
📌 指揮官實戰總結指引"""

                    ai_reply, _ = generate_ai_analysis(prompt_chart, prefer_openrouter=is_use_r)
                    reply_msg = build_fb_comment_text(stock, ai_reply, author)

                    # 5. 🟢 核心革命：直達獨立單篇貼文頁面進行 100% 絕對回覆！
                    if post_url:
                        print(f"  └─ 🚀 正在直達獨立貼文頁面發布回覆...")
                        await page.goto(post_url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=25000)
                        await asyncio.sleep(3)
                        await page.evaluate("window.scrollBy(0, 300)")
                        await asyncio.sleep(1)

                    # 定位單篇貼文頁面唯一的留言框
                    target_input = page.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']").last
                    
                    if await target_input.count() == 0:
                        # 點擊留言按鈕展開
                        open_btn = page.locator("div[role='button']:has-text('留言'), div[aria-label*='留言'], div[aria-label*='以']").last
                        if await open_btn.count() > 0:
                            await open_btn.click(force=True)
                            await asyncio.sleep(1.5)
                        target_input = page.locator("div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']").last

                    if await target_input.count() > 0:
                        await target_input.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                        await target_input.click(force=True)
                        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

                        print("  └─ ✍️ 正在注入解盤戰報文字...")
                        await page.keyboard.insert_text(reply_msg)
                        await asyncio.sleep(2)

                        # 上傳四大圖表圖片
                        if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
                            file_input = page.locator("input[type='file'][accept*='image'], input[type='file']").last
                            if await file_input.count() > 0:
                                await file_input.set_input_files(photo_path)
                                print("  └─ 🖼️ 已附加四大圖表高清截圖...")
                                await asyncio.sleep(5)

                        # 按 Enter 發布留言
                        await page.keyboard.press("Enter")
                        print(f"  └─ 🎉 成功在【{author}】的「{stock_code}」貼文下完成精準圖文回覆！")
                        await asyncio.sleep(4)

                        replied_set.add(post_fingerprint)
                        save_replied_cache(replied_set)
                        break

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 背景巡航過程提醒: {e}")

            await asyncio.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(run_fb_group_responder())
