# 🌐【3. LINE Webhook 處理】
# =========================================================================
@app.route("/callback", methods=['POST'])
def callback():
    signature = request.headers.get('X-Line-Signature', '')
    body = request.get_data(as_text=True)
    try:
        handler.handle(body, signature)
    except InvalidSignatureError:
        abort(400)
    return 'OK'

@handler.add(MessageEvent, message=TextMessage)
def handle_line_text_message(event):
    raw_text = event.message.text.strip()
    print(f"\n📩 [LINE 收到指令] 「{raw_text}」")

    is_use_r = raw_text.upper().endswith("R")
    clean_kw = raw_text[:-1].strip() if is_use_r else raw_text
    stock_code = clean_stock_code(re.sub(r'(說明|詳細|圖文|圖片|圖|解盤)', '', clean_kw).strip())
    if not stock_code:
        stock_code = "2330"

    stock, photo_path, full_report = build_master_full_report(stock_code, prefer_openrouter=True)
    if not stock:
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=full_report))
        return

    messages = []
    if len(full_report) > 4500:
        messages.append(TextSendMessage(text=full_report[:4500]))
        messages.append(TextSendMessage(text=full_report[4500:]))
    else:
        messages.append(TextSendMessage(text=full_report))

    if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
        filename = os.path.basename(photo_path)
        img_url = f"{NGROK_DOMAIN}/static/{filename}"
        messages.append(ImageSendMessage(original_content_url=img_url, preview_image_url=img_url))

    try:
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, messages)
        print(f"✅ LINE 已成功發送【{stock['name']}】深度圖文戰報！")
    except LineBotApiError as e:
        print(f"⚠️ LINE 回覆錯誤: {e}")

# 1. 🤖 推播解盤至 TG
@app.route("/push_to_tg", methods=['POST', 'OPTIONS'])
def api_push_to_tg():
    if request.method == 'OPTIONS':
        return jsonify({"status": "ok"}), 200

    data = request.json or {}
    stock_code = clean_stock_code(data.get("stock", data.get("code", "2330")))
    print(f"🌐 [網頁 API] 觸發【推播解盤至 TG】: {stock_code}")

    stock, photo_path, full_report = build_master_full_report(stock_code, prefer_openrouter=True)
    if not stock:
        return jsonify({"status": "error", "message": full_report}), 400

    # 發送 Telegram
    url_text = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage"
    requests.post(url_text, json={"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID, "text": full_report, "parse_mode": "Markdown"}, timeout=8)

    if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
        url_photo = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_BOT_TOKEN}/sendPhoto"
        with open(photo_path, "rb") as f:
            requests.post(url_photo, data={"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID}, files={"photo": f}, timeout=10)

    return jsonify({"status": "success", "message": f"{stock['name']} 深度戰報已成功推送到 Telegram！"})

# 2. 📱 推播解盤至 LINE
@app.route("/push_to_line", methods=['POST', 'OPTIONS'])
def api_push_to_line():
    if request.method == 'OPTIONS':
        return jsonify({"status": "ok"}), 200

    data = request.json or {}
    stock_code = clean_stock_code(data.get("stock", data.get("code", "2330")))
    print(f"🌐 [網頁 API] 觸發【推播解盤至 LINE】: {stock_code}")

# 3. 🤖 數據卡片至 TG (0 秒極速純數據卡片)
@app.route("/push_data_to_tg", methods=['POST', 'OPTIONS'])
def api_push_data_to_tg():
    if request.method == 'OPTIONS':
        return jsonify({"status": "ok"}), 200

    data = request.json or {}
    stock_code = clean_stock_code(data.get("stock", data.get("code", "2330")))
    custom_text = data.get("text") or data.get("message") or data.get("data")
    print(f"🌐 [網頁 API] 觸發【數據卡片至 TG】: {stock_code}")

    # 若前端有傳遞單列整理好的文字，直接發送；否則由後端生成純數據卡片
    if custom_text and len(str(custom_text).strip()) > 15:
        card_text = str(custom_text).strip()
    else:
        run_pre_calc(stock_code)
        stock = query_stock_full_data(stock_code)
        if not stock:
            return jsonify({"status": "error", "message": "查無股票數據"}), 400
        card_text = build_data_card_text(stock)

    url_text = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage"
    requests.post(url_text, json={"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID, "text": card_text, "parse_mode": "Markdown"}, timeout=6)
    return jsonify({"status": "success", "message": f"【{stock_code}】數據卡片已成功推送到 Telegram！"})

@app.route("/api/screenshot", methods=['GET', 'POST', 'OPTIONS'])
def api_screenshot():
    if request.method == 'OPTIONS':
        return jsonify({"status": "ok"}), 200

    stock_code = clean_stock_code(request.args.get("stock", "2330"))
    if request.is_json and request.json:
        stock_code = clean_stock_code(request.json.get("stock", stock_code))

    print(f"🌐 [網頁 API] 觸發【截圖 API】: {stock_code}")
    photo_path = None
    try:
        photo_path = asyncio.run(capture_stock_chart(stock_code))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 截圖失敗: {e}")

    if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
        filename = os.path.basename(photo_path)
        return jsonify({"status": "success", "image_url": f"{NGROK_DOMAIN}/static/{filename}", "local_path": photo_path})
    return jsonify({"status": "error", "message": "截圖失敗"}), 500

def send_to_line(message_text, image_path=None):
    if not LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN: return
    url = "https://notify-api.line.me/api/notify"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN}"}
    payload = {"message": message_text}
    try:
        if image_path and os.path.exists(image_path):
            with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
                requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=payload, files={"imageFile": f}, timeout=3)
        else:
            requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=payload, timeout=3)
    except Exception:
        pass

# =========================================================================
@app.route("/callback", methods=['POST'])
def callback():
    signature = request.headers.get('X-Line-Signature', '')
    body = request.get_data(as_text=True)
    try:
        handler.handle(body, signature)
    except InvalidSignatureError:
        abort(400)
    return 'OK'

@handler.add(MessageEvent, message=TextMessage)
def handle_line_text_message(event):
    raw_text = event.message.text.strip()
    print(f"\n📩 [LINE 收到指令] 「{raw_text}」")

    is_use_r = raw_text.upper().endswith("R")
    clean_kw = raw_text[:-1].strip() if is_use_r else raw_text
    stock_code = clean_stock_code(re.sub(r'(說明|詳細|圖文|圖片|圖|解盤)', '', clean_kw).strip())
    if not stock_code:
        stock_code = "2330"

    stock, photo_path, full_report = build_master_full_report(stock_code, prefer_openrouter=True)
    if not stock:
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=full_report))
        return

    messages = []
    if len(full_report) > 4500:
        messages.append(TextSendMessage(text=full_report[:4500]))
        messages.append(TextSendMessage(text=full_report[4500:]))
    else:
        messages.append(TextSendMessage(text=full_report))

    if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
        filename = os.path.basename(photo_path)
        img_url = f"{NGROK_DOMAIN}/static/{filename}"
        messages.append(ImageSendMessage(original_content_url=img_url, preview_image_url=img_url))

    try:
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, messages)
        print(f"✅ LINE 已成功發送【{stock['name']}】深度圖文戰報！")
    except LineBotApiError as e:
        print(f"⚠️ LINE 回覆錯誤: {e}")

# 1. 🤖 推播解盤至 TG
@app.route("/push_to_tg", methods=['POST', 'OPTIONS'])
def api_push_to_tg():
    if request.method == 'OPTIONS':
        return jsonify({"status": "ok"}), 200

    data = request.json or {}
    stock_code = clean_stock_code(data.get("stock", data.get("code", "2330")))
    print(f"🌐 [網頁 API] 觸發【推播解盤至 TG】: {stock_code}")

    stock, photo_path, full_report = build_master_full_report(stock_code, prefer_openrouter=True)
    if not stock:
        return jsonify({"status": "error", "message": full_report}), 400

    url_text = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage"
    requests.post(url_text, json={"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID, "text": full_report, "parse_mode": "Markdown"}, timeout=8)

    if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
        url_photo = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_BOT_TOKEN}/sendPhoto"
        with open(photo_path, "rb") as f:
            requests.post(url_photo, data={"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID}, files={"photo": f}, timeout=10)

    return jsonify({"status": "success", "message": f"{stock['name']} 深度戰報已成功推送到 Telegram！"})

@app.route("/push_data_to_tg", methods=['POST', 'OPTIONS'])
def api_push_data_to_tg():
    if request.method == 'OPTIONS':
        return jsonify({"status": "ok"}), 200

    data = request.json or {}
    stock_code = clean_stock_code(data.get("stock", data.get("code", "2330")))
    custom_text = data.get("text") or data.get("message") or data.get("data")
    print(f"🌐 [網頁 API] 觸發【數據卡片至 TG】: {stock_code}")

    if custom_text and len(str(custom_text).strip()) > 15:
        card_text = str(custom_text).strip()
    else:
        run_pre_calc(stock_code)
        stock = query_stock_full_data(stock_code)
        if not stock:
            return jsonify({"status": "error", "message": "查無股票數據"}), 400
        card_text = build_data_card_text(stock)

    url_text = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage"
    requests.post(url_text, json={"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID, "text": card_text, "parse_mode": "Markdown"}, timeout=6)
    return jsonify({"status": "success", "message": f"【{stock_code}】數據卡片已成功推送到 Telegram！"})

        img_url = f"{NGROK_DOMAIN}/static/{filename}"

        # 2. 自動推送到 Telegram 群組
        try:
            url_photo = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_BOT_TOKEN}/sendPhoto"
            with open(photo_path, "rb") as f:
                requests.post(url_photo, data={"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID, "caption": f"📊 【{stock_code}】四大聯動圖表 (雙Y軸極致版)"}, files={"photo": f}, timeout=6)
            print("  └─ 🚀 截圖已同步推播至 Telegram！")
        except Exception as tg_e:
            print(f"⚠️ TG 圖片推播略過: {tg_e}")

        # 3. 自動推送到 LINE
        try:
            send_to_line(f"📊 【{stock_code}】四大聯動圖表", photo_path)
            print("  └─ 🚀 截圖已同步推播至 LINE！")
        except Exception:
            pass

        # 4. 回傳 200 OK 讓綠色按鈕變回正常
        return jsonify({
            "status": "success",
            "message": f"【{stock_code}】四大圖表已成功截圖並推送到 Telegram / LINE！",
            "image_url": img_url,
            "local_path": photo_path
        }), 200

    return jsonify({"status": "error", "message": "截圖生成失敗"}), 500

def send_to_line(message_text, image_path=None):
    if not LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN: return
    url = "https://notify-api.line.me/api/notify"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN}"}
    payload = {"message": message_text}
    try:
        if image_path and os.path.exists(image_path):
            with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
                requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=payload, files={"imageFile": f}, timeout=3)
        else:
            requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=payload, timeout=3)
    except Exception:
        pass

# ==========================================
# 🚀【5. 伺服器啟動入口】
# ==========================================
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=" * 70)
    print("🚀 【Zen AI LINE 中台 & 網頁推播伺服器 V4.8 (全路由大滿貫版)】啟動！")

    print("   2. 綠色截圖按鈕：/api/screenshot, /push_screenshot, /push_chart")
    print("=" * 70)
    app.run(host="0.0.0.0", port=5000)

@app.before_request
def handle_preflight():
    if request.method == "OPTIONS":
        response = make_response()
        response.headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"] = "*"
        response.headers["Access-Control-Allow-Methods"] = "GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS"
        response.headers["Access-Control-Allow-Headers"] = "*"
        response.headers["Access-Control-Max-Age"] = "86400"
        return response, 200

@app.after_request
def add_cors_headers(response):
    response.headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"] = "*"
    response.headers["Access-Control-Allow-Methods"] = "GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS"
    response.headers["Access-Control-Allow-Headers"] = "*"
    return response

@app.route("/callback", methods=['POST'])
def callback():
    signature = request.headers.get('X-Line-Signature', '')
    body = request.get_data(as_text=True)
    try:
        handler.handle(body, signature)
    except InvalidSignatureError:
        abort(400)
    return 'OK'

@handler.add(MessageEvent, message=TextMessage)
def handle_line_text_message(event):
    raw_text = event.message.text.strip()
    print(f"\n📩 [LINE 收到指令] 「{raw_text}」")

    is_use_r = raw_text.upper().endswith("R")
    clean_kw = raw_text[:-1].strip() if is_use_r else raw_text
    stock_code = clean_stock_code(re.sub(r'(說明|詳細|圖文|圖片|圖|解盤)', '', clean_kw).strip())
    if not stock_code:
        stock_code = "2330"

    stock, photo_path, full_report = build_master_full_report(stock_code, prefer_openrouter=True)
    if not stock:
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, TextSendMessage(text=full_report))
        return

    messages = []
    if len(full_report) > 4500:
        messages.append(TextSendMessage(text=full_report[:4500]))
        messages.append(TextSendMessage(text=full_report[4500:]))
    else:
        messages.append(TextSendMessage(text=full_report))

    if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
        filename = os.path.basename(photo_path)
        img_url = f"{NGROK_DOMAIN}/static/{filename}"
        messages.append(ImageSendMessage(original_content_url=img_url, preview_image_url=img_url))

    try:
        line_bot_api.reply_message(event.reply_token, messages)
        print(f"✅ LINE 已成功發送【{stock['name']}】深度圖文戰報！")
    except LineBotApiError as e:
        print(f"⚠️ LINE 回覆錯誤: {e}")

# 1. 🤖 推播解盤至 TG
@app.route("/push_to_tg", methods=['POST'])
def api_push_to_tg():
    data = request.json or {}
    stock_code = clean_stock_code(data.get("stock", data.get("code", "2330")))
    print(f"🌐 [網頁 API] 觸發【推播解盤至 TG】: {stock_code}")

    stock, photo_path, full_report = build_master_full_report(stock_code, prefer_openrouter=True)
    if not stock:
        return jsonify({"status": "error", "message": full_report}), 400

    url_text = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage"
    requests.post(url_text, json={"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID, "text": full_report, "parse_mode": "Markdown"}, timeout=8)

    if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
        url_photo = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_BOT_TOKEN}/sendPhoto"
        with open(photo_path, "rb") as f:
            requests.post(url_photo, data={"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID}, files={"photo": f}, timeout=10)

    return jsonify({"status": "success", "message": f"{stock['name']} 深度戰報已成功推送到 Telegram！"})

        card_text = build_data_card_text(stock)

@app.route("/api/screenshot", methods=['GET', 'POST'])
@app.route("/push_screenshot", methods=['GET', 'POST'])
@app.route("/push_chart", methods=['GET', 'POST'])
@app.route("/api/screenshot_push", methods=['GET', 'POST'])
def api_handle_screenshot_and_push():
    stock_code = clean_stock_code(request.args.get("stock", "2330"))
    if request.is_json and request.json:
        stock_code = clean_stock_code(request.json.get("stock", request.json.get("code", stock_code)))

    print(f"🌐 [網頁 API] 觸發綠色按鈕【一鍵生成並推送截圖】: {stock_code}")

    photo_path = None
    try:
        photo_path = asyncio.run(capture_stock_chart(stock_code))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 截圖失敗: {e}")

    if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
        filename = os.path.basename(photo_path)
        img_url = f"{NGROK_DOMAIN}/static/{filename}"

        # 同步推播到 Telegram
        try:
            url_photo = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_BOT_TOKEN}/sendPhoto"
            with open(photo_path, "rb") as f:
                requests.post(url_photo, data={"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID, "caption": f"📊 【{stock_code}】四大聯動圖表 (雙Y軸極致版)"}, files={"photo": f}, timeout=6)
            print("  └─ 🚀 截圖已同步推播至 Telegram！")
        except Exception as tg_e:
            print(f"⚠️ TG 圖片推播略過: {tg_e}")

        # 同步推播到 LINE
        try:
            send_to_line(f"📊 【{stock_code}】四大聯動圖表", photo_path)
            print("  └─ 🚀 截圖已同步推播至 LINE！")
        except Exception:
            pass

        return jsonify({
            "status": "success",
            "message": f"【{stock_code}】四大圖表已成功截圖並推送到 Telegram / LINE！",
            "image_url": img_url,
            "local_path": photo_path
        }), 200

    return jsonify({"status": "error", "message": "截圖生成失敗"}), 500

def send_to_line(message_text, image_path=None):
    if not LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN: return
    url = "https://notify-api.line.me/api/notify"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN}"}
    payload = {"message": message_text}
    try:
        if image_path and os.path.exists(image_path):
            with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
                requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=payload, files={"imageFile": f}, timeout=3)
        else:
            requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=payload, timeout=3)
    except Exception:
        pass

Chrome 的單一實例互斥鎖（Singleton Lock）機制： * Google Chrome 嚴格禁止兩個程式「同時開啟同一個使用者目錄」。 * 當 `auto_push_resonance.py` 嘗試再次開啟 `fb_user_data` 時，被 Chrome 直接以 `exitCode=21` 強制拒絕，導致 Playwright 拋出 `TargetClosedError` 崩潰！ --- ### 🛠️ 兩步立即修復方案 #### 步驟 1：在 CMD 釋放被佔用的 Chrome 進程（立即生效） 請打開 CMD 執行以下指令，強制關閉背景佔用鎖定的 Chrome：

taskkill /f /im chrome.exe
--- #### 步驟 2：升級 `auto_push_resonance.py`（加入「自動破鎖 ✕ 雙平台故障隔離」） 我們為 `auto_push_resonance.py` 加上三大保護： 1. 自動清除殘留鎖定檔（`SingletonLock`）：每次啟動前自動清理檔案鎖，不再被卡死。 2. 故障隔離（Fault Isolation）：Telegram 推播與 Facebook 發文各自獨立！ 就算 Facebook 瀏覽器遇到鎖定延遲，Telegram 戰情廣播依然 100% 保證準時發出！ 3. 無縫重試機制。 --- ### 📄 請更新 `C:\test_c\auto_push_resonance.py` 請打開 `C:\test_c\auto_push_resonance.py`，找到最底部的 `main_broadcast()` 函式（約 620~666 行），替換為以下具備「自動解鎖 ✕ 故障隔離」的健壯版本：

# =========================================================================
# 🚀【主廣播執行入口 (自動解鎖 ✕ 故障隔離定稿版)】
# =========================================================================
def clean_fb_profile_lock():
    """自動清理 Chrome 殘留鎖檔，防止 exitCode=21 PROFILE_IN_USE 崩潰"""
    lock_files = ["SingletonLock", "SingletonCookie", "SingletonSocket", "lockfile"]
    for lock in lock_files:
        p = os.path.join(FB_USER_DATA_DIR, lock)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            try:
                os.remove(p)
                print(f"🧹 已自動清除殘留 Chrome 鎖檔: {lock}")
            except Exception:
                pass

async def main_broadcast():
    print("=" * 70)

    # 1. 刷新資料庫快照

    stocks_to_push = get_top_surge_stocks(limit=5)
    if not stocks_to_push:
        print("⚠️ 今日無符合條件之暴漲共振標的。")
        return

    # 生成文字戰報與圖表
    telegram_text, fb_post_text, photo_paths = generate_all_reports(stocks_to_push)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 🟢 平台一：Telegram 實戰群組推播 (第一優先，獨立保證發送！)

    try:
        # 發送文字戰報
        send_tg_message(telegram_text)
        # 發送截圖
        for p_path in photo_paths:
            if p_path and os.path.exists(p_path):
                send_tg_photo(p_path)
                time.sleep(1)
        print("✅ Telegram 雙平台戰報已順利送達！")
    except Exception as tg_err:
        print(f"⚠️ Telegram 推播異常: {tg_err}")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 🌐 平台二：Facebook 社團自動發布 (故障隔離保護)
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    print("\n🌐 正在發布圖文戰報至 Facebook 社團...")
    clean_fb_profile_lock()  # 啟動前強制破鎖

    try:
        async with async_playwright() as p:
            browser = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
                user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA_DIR,
                channel="chrome",
                headless=True,
                viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 900},
                args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"],

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

# 🏆【Zen AI 股票戰情室：每日 13:35 盤後多維共振黑馬 ✕ 暴漲勝率矩陣雙平台自動推播廣播器 V3.5】

# 3. 篩選「4維全共振 ✕ 雙動能翻正 ✕ 總量 >= 3000張」起漲黑馬。
# 4. 調用 Playwright 截取 excelsql2.html 雙 Y 軸四大聯動圖表。
# 5. 調用 AI 大腦生成深度操盤戰報，注入【3-Way 離場勝率樹狀卡片】。
# 6. 同步自動推播至 Telegram 實戰群組 ＋ Facebook「股票戰情室」社團！
#
# 依賴資料表：stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot, StockPersonality_3Exits
# ========================================================================================

def clean_fb_profile_lock():
    """自動清理 Chrome 殘留鎖檔，防止 exitCode=21 PROFILE_IN_USE 崩潰"""
    lock_files = ["SingletonLock", "SingletonCookie", "SingletonSocket", "lockfile"]

def refresh_snapshot():

    print("🔄 正在刷新全市場多維共振快照表...")
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=15) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute("EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_RefreshMultiResonanceSnapshot")
            conn.commit()
            print("✅ 多維共振快照表重構完成！")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 快照表刷新提醒: {e}")

def get_top_surge_stocks(limit=5):
    """取得暴漲龍頭 ✕ 多維共振標的"""
    print(f"🚀 正在計算近 5 日暴漲前 {limit} 名歷史回測勝率...")
    sql = f"""
    SELECT TOP {limit}
        R.代號, R.名稱, R.盤中成交價 AS 現價, R.盤中漲幅 AS 漲幅, R.盤中總量 AS 總量,
        R.HitCount, R.ResonanceTag,
        ISNULL(E.WinRate_5MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_5MA, ISNULL(E.Return_5MA, 0.0) AS Return_5MA,
        ISNULL(E.WinRate_10MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_10MA, ISNULL(E.Return_10MA, 0.0) AS Return_10MA,
        ISNULL(E.WinRate_20MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_20MA, ISNULL(E.Return_20MA, 0.0) AS Return_20MA,
        ISNULL(E.OptimalExit, N'🔥 20MA勝出') AS OptimalExit
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot R
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(R.代號) = RTRIM(E.代號)
    WHERE R.盤中總量 >= 3000 AND R.盤中成交價 >= 10.0 AND R.HitCount >= 2
    ORDER BY R.HitCount DESC, R.盤中漲幅 DESC, R.盤中總量 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            return rows
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 查詢暴漲名單異常: {e}")
        return []

    try:
        with open(photo_path, "rb") as f:
            requests.post(url, data={"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID, "caption": caption}, files={"photo": f}, timeout=12)

def generate_all_reports(stocks):
    now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d')
    
    # 建立總覽清單
    leaderboard_text = f"🔥 【Zen AI 全市場近 5 日暴漲領頭羊 ✕ 歷史勝率矩陣】\n📅 日期：{now_str} 盤後結算\n💡 理念：市場永遠是對的！追隨最強勢資金，以量化勝率科學操盤！\n────────────────────────\n"
    
    photo_paths = []
    top_stock_code = None

    for idx, s in enumerate(stocks, 1):
        code = str(s[0]).strip()
        name = str(s[1]).strip()
        price = float(s[2])
        pct = float(s[3])
        vol = int(s[4])
        hit_cnt = int(s[5])
        tag = str(s[6]).strip()
        opt_strat = str(s[13]).strip()
        
        if idx == 1:
            top_stock_code = code

        leaderboard_text += (
            f"{idx}. 👑 {code} {name} (現價:{price}元 | 漲跌:{pct:+.2f}% | 量:{vol:,}張)\n"
            f"   ├── 標籤：【{hit_cnt}維共振 ({tag})】\n"
            f"   └── 最佳離場：【{opt_strat}】\n\n"
        )

    # 針對第一名進行深度四大圖表截圖與 AI 解盤
    ai_deep_analysis = ""
    if top_stock_code:
        print(f"👑 正在為本日第一名龍頭【{top_stock_code}】生成四大圖表深度解盤...")
        run_pre_calc(top_stock_code)
        stock_data = query_stock_full_data(top_stock_code)
        
        if stock_data:
            # 截取四大圖表
            photo_path = asyncio.run(capture_stock_chart(top_stock_code))
            if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
                photo_paths.append(photo_path)

            prompt = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請為全市場廣播撰寫本日第一名暴漲龍頭【{stock_data['name']}({stock_data['code']})】的「四大聯動圖表深度視覺解盤」：
- 盤中價：{stock_data['price']} 元 | 5MA：{stock_data['m5']:.2f}元 | 20MA：{stock_data['m20']:.2f}元 | 60MA：{stock_data['m60']:.2f}元 (週抗壓比：{stock_data['stress_ratio']})
- 60M KD：{stock_data['k_60m']:.2f}/{stock_data['d_60m']:.2f} | 60M OSC：{stock_data['osc_60m']:.2f}
- 籌碼共振：{stock_data['hit_count']}維共振【{stock_data['tag']}】，實戰總分：{stock_data['score']:.2f}分
- 最適離場戰術：{stock_data['optimal']}

請依照下列格式輸出，每段50~70字，一針見血：

📌 圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振

            ai_deep_analysis, _ = generate_ai_analysis(prompt, prefer_openrouter=True)

    """取得暴漲龍頭 ✕ 多維共振標的"""
    print(f"🚀 正在計算近 5 日暴漲前 {limit} 名歷史回測勝率...")
    sql = f"""
    SELECT TOP {limit}
        R.代號, R.名稱, R.盤中成交價 AS 現價, R.盤中漲幅 AS 漲幅, R.盤中總量 AS 總量,
        R.HitCount, R.ResonanceTag,
        ISNULL(E.WinRate_5MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_5MA, ISNULL(E.Return_5MA, 0.0) AS Return_5MA,
        ISNULL(E.WinRate_10MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_10MA, ISNULL(E.Return_10MA, 0.0) AS Return_10MA,
        ISNULL(E.WinRate_20MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_20MA, ISNULL(E.Return_20MA, 0.0) AS Return_20MA,
        ISNULL(E.OptimalExit, N'🔥 20MA勝出') AS OptimalExit
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot R
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(R.代號) = RTRIM(E.代號)
    WHERE R.盤中總量 >= 3000 AND R.盤中成交價 >= 10.0 AND R.HitCount >= 2
    ORDER BY R.HitCount DESC, R.盤中漲幅 DESC, R.盤中總量 DESC;
    """
    try:

停在 `已附加暴漲龍頭四大圖表...` 而沒有送出的原因非常明確： --- ### 🔍 癥結點分析 1. 圖片上傳後的「發佈按鈕狀態延遲」： * 當附加圖片檔案到 Facebook 發文框時，Facebook 需要 5~8 秒在背景生成圖片縮圖。在縮圖生成完畢前，「發佈」按鈕處於禁用（Disabled）或未激活狀態。 2. 發文對話框（Dialog）作用域選取器衝突： * 之前的選取器在整個頁面搜尋 `div[role='button']:has-text('發佈')`，但 Facebook 畫面上有多個可能包含「發布」文字的隱藏按鈕（如排定發布、發布工具等），導致點擊了錯誤的按鈕或找不到目標。 --- ### 🛠️ 終極修復方案 1. 鎖定 `div[role='dialog']` 發文對話框：精準只點擊當前彈出的發文框正下方的 藍色【發佈】按鈕。 2. 多重按鈕備援 ＋ JS 強制點擊：提供 6 組精確選取器，若點擊被遮擋則自動執行 JavaScript 原生點擊。 3. 發布存證截圖：發布完成後自動在 `C:\test_c\debug_fb_post_success.png` 留下發布成功的畫面存證！ --- ### 📄 完整修正版：`C:\test_c\auto_push_resonance.py` (V3.7 穩定發布版) 請複製以下程式碼，完整覆蓋 `C:\test_c\auto_push_resonance.py` 並存檔：

# 🏆【Zen AI 股票戰情室：每日 13:35 盤後多維共振黑馬 ✕ 暴漲勝率矩陣雙平台自動推播廣播器 V3.7】

def clean_fb_profile_lock():
    """自動清理 Chrome 殘留鎖檔，防止 exitCode=21 PROFILE_IN_USE 崩潰"""
    lock_files = ["SingletonLock", "SingletonCookie", "SingletonSocket", "lockfile"]
    for lock in lock_files:
        p = os.path.join(FB_USER_DATA_DIR, lock)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            try:
                os.remove(p)
                print(f"🧹 已自動清除殘留 Chrome 鎖檔: {lock}")
            except Exception:

def refresh_snapshot():
    """刷新全市場多維共振快照表"""
    print("🔄 正在刷新全市場多維共振快照表...")
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=15) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute("EXEC stockchangedate.dbo.sp_RefreshMultiResonanceSnapshot")
            conn.commit()
            print("✅ 多維共振快照表重構完成！")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 快照表刷新提醒: {e}")

def get_top_surge_stocks(limit=5):
    """取得暴漲龍頭 ✕ 多維共振標的"""
    print(f"🚀 正在計算近 5 日暴漲前 {limit} 名歷史回測勝率...")
    sql = f"""
    SELECT TOP {limit}
        R.代號, R.名稱, R.盤中成交價 AS 現價, R.盤中漲幅 AS 漲幅, R.盤中總量 AS 總量,
        R.HitCount, R.ResonanceTag,
        ISNULL(E.WinRate_5MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_5MA, ISNULL(E.Return_5MA, 0.0) AS Return_5MA,
        ISNULL(E.WinRate_10MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_10MA, ISNULL(E.Return_10MA, 0.0) AS Return_10MA,
        ISNULL(E.WinRate_20MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_20MA, ISNULL(E.Return_20MA, 0.0) AS Return_20MA,
        ISNULL(E.OptimalExit, N'🔥 20MA勝出') AS OptimalExit
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.ResonanceMultiFactor_Snapshot R
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(R.代號) = RTRIM(E.代號)
    WHERE R.盤中總量 >= 3000 AND R.盤中成交價 >= 10.0 AND R.HitCount >= 2
    ORDER BY R.HitCount DESC, R.盤中漲幅 DESC, R.盤中總量 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            return rows
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 查詢暴漲名單異常: {e}")
        return []

def send_tg_message(text):
    url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage"
    payload = {"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID, "text": text, "parse_mode": "Markdown"}
    try:
        requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=8)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ TG 文字發送異常: {e}")

def send_tg_photo(photo_path, caption=""):
    url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_BOT_TOKEN}/sendPhoto"
    try:
        with open(photo_path, "rb") as f:
            requests.post(url, data={"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID, "caption": caption}, files={"photo": f}, timeout=12)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ TG 圖片發送異常: {e}")

# =========================================================================
async def generate_all_reports(stocks):
    now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d')
    
    # 建立總覽清單
    leaderboard_text = f"🔥 【Zen AI 全市場近 5 日暴漲領頭羊 ✕ 歷史勝率矩陣】\n📅 日期：{now_str} 盤後結算\n💡 理念：市場永遠是對的！追隨最強勢資金，以量化勝率科學操盤！\n────────────────────────\n"
    
    photo_paths = []
    top_stock_code = None

    for idx, s in enumerate(stocks, 1):
        code = str(s[0]).strip()
        name = str(s[1]).strip()
        price = float(s[2])
        pct = float(s[3])
        vol = int(s[4])
        hit_cnt = int(s[5])
        tag = str(s[6]).strip()
        opt_strat = str(s[13]).strip()
        
        if idx == 1:
            top_stock_code = code

        leaderboard_text += (
            f"{idx}. 👑 {code} {name} (現價:{price}元 | 漲跌:{pct:+.2f}% | 量:{vol:,}張)\n"
            f"   ├── 標籤：【{hit_cnt}維共振 ({tag})】\n"
            f"   └── 最佳離場：【{opt_strat}】\n\n"
        )

    # 針對第一名進行深度四大圖表截圖與 AI 解盤
    ai_deep_analysis = ""
    if top_stock_code:
        print(f"👑 正在為本日第一名龍頭【{top_stock_code}】生成四大圖表深度解盤...")
        run_pre_calc(top_stock_code)
        stock_data = query_stock_full_data(top_stock_code)
        
        if stock_data:
            photo_path = await capture_stock_chart(top_stock_code)
            if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
                photo_paths.append(photo_path)

            prompt = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請為全市場廣播撰寫本日第一名暴漲龍頭【{stock_data['name']}({stock_data['code']})】的「四大聯動圖表深度視覺解盤」：
- 盤中價：{stock_data['price']} 元 | 5MA：{stock_data['m5']:.2f}元 | 20MA：{stock_data['m20']:.2f}元 | 60MA：{stock_data['m60']:.2f}元 (週抗壓比：{stock_data['stress_ratio']})
- 60M KD：{stock_data['k_60m']:.2f}/{stock_data['d_60m']:.2f} | 60M OSC：{stock_data['osc_60m']:.2f}
- 籌碼共振：{stock_data['hit_count']}維共振【{stock_data['tag']}】，實戰總分：{stock_data['score']:.2f}分
- 最適離場戰術：{stock_data['optimal']}

請依照下列格式輸出，每段50~70字，一針見血：
📌 圖一：價格與均線防守
📌 圖1.5：五維金叉彩虹共振
📌 圖二：OBV星號爆發解讀
📌 圖三：籌碼與實戰總分共振
📌 指揮官實戰總結指引"""

            ai_deep_analysis, _ = generate_ai_analysis(prompt, prefer_openrouter=True)

    telegram_full_text = leaderboard_text + "────────────────────────\n📊 本日龍頭代表股深度視覺解盤：\n\n" + ai_deep_analysis
    fb_full_text = telegram_full_text + "\n\n#ZenAI #股票戰情室 #量化選股 #暴漲龍頭 #多維共振"

    return telegram_full_text, fb_full_text, photo_paths

# 🚀【6. 主廣播執行入口 (精準發布 ✕ 存證截圖定稿版)】
# =========================================================================
async def main_broadcast():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("📡 【Zen AI 戰情室 13:35 盤後暴漲龍頭 ✕ 多維共振雙平台廣播 V3.7】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 當前時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print("⚙️ 篩選標準: 總量 >= 3,000 張 | 股價 >= 10.0 元 | 共振維度 >= 2")
    print("=" * 70)

    # 1. 刷新資料庫快照
    refresh_snapshot()

    # 2. 產出暴漲龍頭名單
    stocks_to_push = get_top_surge_stocks(limit=5)
    if not stocks_to_push:
        print("⚠️ 今日無符合條件之暴漲共振標的。")
        return

    # 3. 生成雙平台戰報
    telegram_text, fb_post_text, photo_paths = await generate_all_reports(stocks_to_push)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 🟢 平台一：Telegram 實戰群組推播 (第一優先，保證必達)
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    print("\n📱 正在推播戰報至 Telegram 實戰群組...")
    try:
        send_tg_message(telegram_text)
        for p_path in photo_paths:
            if p_path and os.path.exists(p_path):
                send_tg_photo(p_path, caption="📊 【本日第一名暴漲龍頭】四大聯動圖表 (雙Y軸極致版)")
                time.sleep(1)
        print("✅ Telegram 戰報已順利發送！")
    except Exception as tg_err:
        print(f"⚠️ Telegram 推播異常: {tg_err}")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 🌐 平台二：Facebook 社團自動發布 (對話框精準鎖定 ✕ 雙重發送)
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    print("\n🌐 正在發布圖文戰報至 Facebook 社團...")
    clean_fb_profile_lock()

    try:
        async with async_playwright() as p:
            browser = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
                user_data_dir=FB_USER_DATA_DIR,
                channel="chrome",
                headless=True,
                viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 900},
                args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"],
                ignore_default_args=["--enable-automation"]
            )
            page = browser.pages[0] if browser.pages else await browser.new_page()

            try:
                await page.goto(FB_GROUP_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000)
                await asyncio.sleep(4)

                # 1. 點擊「建立公開貼文」/「寫點什麼」
                post_box = page.locator("div[role='button']:has-text('建立公開貼文'), div[role='button']:has-text('寫點什麼'), div[aria-label*='建立貼文'], div[aria-label*='建立公開貼文']").first
                if await post_box.count() > 0:
                    await post_box.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                    await post_box.click(force=True)
                    await asyncio.sleep(2.5)

                # 2. 定位對話框中的輸入框
                active_input = page.locator("div[role='dialog'] div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true'], div[role='textbox'][contenteditable='true']").first
                if await active_input.count() > 0:
                    await active_input.click(force=True)
                    await asyncio.sleep(1)
                    print("  └─ ✍️ 正在注入 FB 貼文文案...")
                    await page.keyboard.insert_text(fb_post_text)
                    await asyncio.sleep(2)

                    # 3. 上傳截圖
                    valid_photos = [p for p in photo_paths if p and os.path.exists(p)]
                    if valid_photos:
                        file_input = page.locator("div[role='dialog'] input[type='file'][accept*='image'], input[type='file'][accept*='image'], input[type='file']").first
                        if await file_input.count() > 0:
                            await file_input.set_input_files(valid_photos[:2])
                            print(f"  └─ 🖼️ 已附加 {len(valid_photos[:2])} 張暴漲龍頭圖表，等待 FB 縮圖預覽生成...")
                            await asyncio.sleep(6)  # 關鍵：等待縮圖上傳完畢激活按鈕

                    # 4. 尋找發布按鈕 (多重備援選取器)
                    print("  └─ 🚀 正在點擊【發佈】按鈕...")
                    publish_selectors = [
                        "div[role='dialog'] div[aria-label='發佈'][role='button']",
                        "div[role='dialog'] div[aria-label='發布'][role='button']",
                        "div[role='dialog'] div[aria-label='Post'][role='button']",
                        "div[role='dialog'] div[role='button']:has-text('發佈')",
                        "div[role='dialog'] div[role='button']:has-text('發布')",
                        "div[aria-label='發佈']",
                        "div[aria-label='發布']",
                        "div[role='button']:has-text('發佈')",
                        "div[role='button']:has-text('發布')"
                    ]

                    submitted = False
                    for sel in publish_selectors:
                        btn = page.locator(sel).last
                        if await btn.count() > 0 and await btn.is_visible():
                            try:
                                await btn.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                                await btn.click(force=True)
                                submitted = True
                                print(f"  └─ 🎯 成功點擊發布按鈕 (匹配選取器: {sel})！")
                                break
                            except Exception:
                                pass

                    if not submitted:
                        # 備援：透過 JavaScript 直接點擊發布按鈕
                        clicked = await page.evaluate("""() => {
                            const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div[role="button"], button'));
                            const target = btns.find(b => {
                                const t = b.innerText || b.getAttribute('aria-label') || '';
                                return (t.includes('發佈') || t.includes('發布') || t.includes('Post')) && !t.includes('建立') && !t.includes('排定');
                            });
                            if (target) {
                                target.click();
                                return true;
                            }
                            return false;
                        }""")
                        if clicked:
                            print("  └─ 🎯 透過 JavaScript 成功點擊發布按鈕！")
                            submitted = True

                    if submitted:
                        await asyncio.sleep(6)  # 等待 FB 送出
                        await page.screenshot(path=r"C:\test_c\debug_fb_post_success.png")
                        print("🎉 貼文已成功發布至 Facebook 社團！(已存證截圖至 C:\\test_c\\debug_fb_post_success.png)")
                    else:
                        await page.screenshot(path=r"C:\test_c\debug_fb_post_fail.png")
                        print("⚠️ 未能定位到【發佈】按鈕，已截圖存證至 C:\\test_c\\debug_fb_post_fail.png")

            except Exception as fb_inner_err:
                print(f"⚠️ FB 發文細節略過: {fb_inner_err}")
            finally:
                await browser.close()

    except Exception as fb_outer_err:
        print(f"⚠️ FB 瀏覽器啟動略過: {fb_outer_err}")

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("🎉 【Zen AI 戰情室 13:35 盤後雙平台自動廣播】全流程執行完畢！")
    print("=" * 70)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main_broadcast())

t_1)$。 *有效趨勢線檢驗*：$t_1$ 到 $t_2$ 之間的所有收盤價均不得實質突破該連線。 * 步驟三（突破 ✕ 回測判定）： * 突破（Breakout）：當日收盤價 $Close \ge TL(t)$ 且成交量放大（量能倍數 $> 1.2$ 或 OBV 金叉）。 * 回測（Retest）：突破後 1~3 天，股價拉回距離 $TL(t)$ 僅 $\pm 1\%$ 獲得支撐不破，且 60M OSC 低檔翻正！ --- ### 2. 「1:1 等距對稱測幅」（Measured Move / 1:1 Target） 古典圖表學的精髓在於「能量對稱」： * 波段底部深度（Pattern Depth, $H$）： $$H = \text{突破點頸線價} - python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI 經典底部形態 (W底/頭肩底/杯柄) ✕ 均線回測 ✕ 1:1 等距測幅引擎 V1.0】
# 檔案路徑：C:\test_c\pattern_scanner_1to1.py

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import pyodbc
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

# =========================================================================
# 🛠️【1. 資料庫連線配置】
# =========================================================================
SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchangedate"
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={{SQL Server}};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

# =========================================================================
# 📐【2. 幾何轉折點萃取與形態辨識演算法】
# =========================================================================
def find_pivots(df, window=4):
    """萃取局部波段高點 (Pivot High) 與局部低點 (Pivot Low)"""
    highs = df['最高'].values
    lows = df['最低'].values
    n = len(df)
    
    pivot_highs = []
    pivot_lows = []
    
    for i in range(window, n - window):
        # 局部高點：比左右兩側都高
        if highs[i] == max(highs[i - window : i + window + 1]):
            pivot_highs.append((i, df['日期'].iloc[i], highs[i]))
        # 局部低點：比左右兩側都低
        if lows[i] == min(lows[i - window : i + window + 1]):
            pivot_lows.append((i, df['日期'].iloc[i], lows[i]))
            
    return pivot_highs, pivot_lows

def detect_w_bottom(p_highs, p_lows, cur_price, cur_5ma, cur_20ma):
    """
    辨識 W 底 (Double Bottom)：
    特徵：低點 L1 ➔ 頸線高峰 H1 ➔ 低點 L2 ➔ 當前突破 H1 後回測
    """
    if len(p_lows) < 2 or len(p_highs) < 1:
        return None
    
    l1_idx, _, l1_price = p_lows[-2]
    l2_idx, _, l2_price = p_lows[-1]
    
    # 尋找介於 L1 與 L2 之間的高點 H1 (頸線)
    middle_highs = [h for h in p_highs if l1_idx < h[0] < l2_idx]
    if not middle_highs:
        return None
    
    h1_idx, _, neckline = max(middle_highs, key=lambda x: x[2])
    
    # 條件 1：形態深度至少 5% 以上
    pattern_depth = neckline - min(l1_price, l2_price)
    if pattern_depth / min(l1_price, l2_price) < 0.05:
        return None
    
    # 條件 2：W底兩腳對稱性 (L2 不得比 L1 低超過 3%，右腳墊高更佳)
    if l2_price < l1_price * 0.97:
        return None
    
    # 條件 3：現價已站上或突破頸線 (或在頸線附近回測 -1.5% ~ +6%)
    if not (neckline * 0.98 <= cur_price <= neckline * 1.08):
        return None
        
    pattern_name = "W底 (右腳強勢墊高)" if l2_price > l1_price else "標準 W 底"
    min_bottom = min(l1_price, l2_price)
    target_1to1 = round(neckline + pattern_depth, 2)
    
    return {
        "pattern": pattern_name,
        "neckline": round(neckline, 2),
        "min_bottom": round(min_bottom, 2),
        "depth": round(pattern_depth, 2),
        "target_1to1": target_1to1,
        "stop_loss": round(l2_price, 2)
    }

def detect_head_shoulders_bottom(p_highs, p_lows, cur_price, cur_5ma, cur_20ma):
    """
    辨識 頭肩底 (Head & Shoulders Bottom)：
    特徵：左肩 LS ➔ 左峰 H1 ➔ 頭部 Head (最低) ➔ 右峰 H2 ➔ 右肩 RS ➔ 突破回測
    """
    if len(p_lows) < 3 or len(p_highs) < 2:
        return None
        
    ls_idx, _, ls_price = p_lows[-3]
    head_idx, _, head_price = p_lows[-2]
    rs_idx, _, rs_price = p_lows[-1]
    
    # 頭部必須低於左右肩
    if not (head_price < ls_price and head_price < rs_price):
        return None
        
    # 左右肩高度需大致對稱 (差距 <= 5%)
    if abs(ls_price - rs_price) / ls_price > 0.06:
        return None
        
    # 尋找兩峰作為頸線
    h1_candidates = [h for h in p_highs if ls_idx < h[0] < head_idx]
    h2_candidates = [h for h in p_highs if head_idx < h[0] < rs_idx]
    
    if not h1_candidates or not h2_candidates:
        return None
        
    neckline = (max(h1_candidates, key=lambda x: x[2])[2] + max(h2_candidates, key=lambda x: x[2])[2]) / 2.0
    pattern_depth = neckline - head_price
    
    if pattern_depth / head_price < 0.08:
        return None
        
    # 現價處於頸線突破或回測區
    if not (neckline * 0.98 <= cur_price <= neckline * 1.08):
        return None
        
    target_1to1 = round(neckline + pattern_depth, 2)
    
    return {
        "pattern": "完美頭肩底",
        "neckline": round(neckline, 2),
        "min_bottom": round(head_price, 2),
        "depth": round(pattern_depth, 2),
        "target_1to1": target_1to1,
        "stop_loss": round(rs_price, 2)
    }

def detect_cup_and_handle(df, cur_price, cur_5ma, cur_20ma):
    """
    辨識 杯柄形態 / 有柄神燈 (Cup and Handle)：
    特徵：左杯緣 ➔ 圓弧底 (深10~30%) ➔ 右杯緣 ➔ 淺幅杯柄回測 5MA/20MA ➔ 起漲
    """
    if len(df) < 35:
        return None
        
    closes = df['成交價'].values
    highs = df['最高'].values
    lows = df['最低'].values
    
    # 尋找杯體最高緣 (過去 20~50 天)
    left_rim = max(highs[-50:-15]) if len(highs) >= 50 else max(highs[:-15])
    cup_bottom = min(lows[-40:-10])
    
    cup_depth = left_rim - cup_bottom
    if cup_depth / left_rim < 0.08 or cup_depth / left_rim > 0.35:
        return None  # 杯深過淺或過深皆不符
        
    # 右杯緣高度需接近左杯緣 (>= 93%)
    right_rim = max(highs[-15:-5])
    if right_rim < left_rim * 0.93:
        return None
        
    # 杯柄回檔需淺 (回檔幅度不得超過杯深的 45%)
    handle_low = min(lows[-5:])
    if (right_rim - handle_low) > cup_depth * 0.45:
        return None
        
    neckline = max(left_rim, right_rim)
    target_1to1 = round(neckline + cup_depth, 2)
    
    return {
        "pattern": "有柄神燈 (杯柄形態)",
        "neckline": round(neckline, 2),
        "min_bottom": round(cup_bottom, 2),
        "depth": round(cup_depth, 2),
        "target_1to1": target_1to1,
        "stop_loss": round(handle_low, 2)
    }

# 🚀【3. 全市場掃描主程式】
# =========================================================================
def run_pattern_scanner():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("📐 【Zen AI 底部形態 ✕ 均線回測 ✕ 1:1 等距測幅引擎】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 掃描時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print("🎯 涵蓋形態：W底 (雙底) | 頭肩底 | 有柄神燈 (杯柄形態)")
    print("=" * 70)

    # 1. 取得全市場具備基礎成交量之標的
    conn = pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # 清空今日舊資料
    cursor.execute("TRUNCATE TABLE stockchangedate.dbo.StockPatternAnalysis")
    conn.commit()

    stocks_sql = """
    SELECT 代號, 名稱, 成交價, 總量 
    FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo 
    WHERE 總量 >= 1000 AND 成交價 >= 10.0;
    """
    stocks = pd.read_sql(stocks_sql, conn)
    print(f"🔍 符合量價門檻標的共 {len(stocks)} 檔，開始進行歷史幾何形態辨識...")

    # 2. 逐股提取近 60 日 K 線進行幾何擬合
    results = []
    today_int = int(datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d'))

    for _, row in stocks.iterrows():
        code = str(row['代號']).strip()
        name = str(row['名稱']).strip()
        cur_price = float(row['成交價'])

        # 讀取該股近 60 日價量與均線
        kline_sql = f"""
        SELECT TOP 60 日期, 盤中現價 AS 成交價, 
               ISNULL(最高, 盤中現價*1.02) AS 最高, 
               ISNULL(最低, 盤中現價*0.98) AS 最低
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.MasterStockAnalysis
        WHERE 代號 = '{code}'
        ORDER BY 日期 ASC;
        """
        k_df = pd.read_sql(kline_sql, conn)
        if len(k_df) < 30:
            continue

        # 計算 5MA 與 20MA
        k_df['5MA'] = k_df['成交價'].rolling(5).mean()
        k_df['20MA'] = k_df['成交價'].rolling(20).mean()
        
        cur_5ma = k_df['5MA'].iloc[-1] if not np.isnan(k_df['5MA'].iloc[-1]) else cur_price
        cur_20ma = k_df['20MA'].iloc[-1] if not np.isnan(k_df['20MA'].iloc[-1]) else cur_price

        # 萃取轉折點
        p_highs, p_lows = find_pivots(k_df, window=3)

        # 依序辨識形態
        pattern_res = None
        # 1. 優先檢驗杯柄形態
        pattern_res = detect_cup_and_handle(k_df, cur_price, cur_5ma, cur_20ma)
        # 2. 檢驗頭肩底
        if not pattern_res:
            pattern_res = detect_head_shoulders_bottom(p_highs, p_lows, cur_price, cur_5ma, cur_20ma)
        # 3. 檢驗 W 底
        if not pattern_res:
            pattern_res = detect_w_bottom(p_highs, p_lows, cur_price, cur_5ma, cur_20ma)

        if pattern_res:
            neckline = pattern_res['neckline']
            target_1to1 = pattern_res['target_1to1']
            stop_loss = pattern_res['stop_loss']
            depth = pattern_res['depth']
            
            # 計算 1:1 潛在上漲空間
            upside_pct = round((target_1to1 - cur_price) / cur_price * 100.0, 2)
            if upside_pct <= 3.0:
                continue  # 空間不足 3% 略過

            # 判定回測防守均線 (5MA 還是 20MA 還是頸線)
            bias_5ma = (cur_price - cur_5ma) / cur_5ma * 100.0
            bias_20ma = (cur_price - cur_20ma) / cur_20ma * 100.0
            bias_neck = (cur_price - neckline) / neckline * 100.0
            
            if abs(bias_neck) <= 1.5:
                defense_ma = "頸線回測支撐"
                def_price = neckline
                bias_pct = round(bias_neck, 2)
            elif abs(bias_5ma) <= 1.8:
                defense_ma = "5MA 回測支撐"
                def_price = round(cur_5ma, 2)
                bias_pct = round(bias_5ma, 2)
            else:
                defense_ma = "20MA 月線支撐"
                def_price = round(cur_20ma, 2)
                bias_pct = round(bias_20ma, 2)

            # 計算風報比 (Reward / Risk)
            risk = max(cur_price - stop_loss, cur_price * 0.02)
            reward = target_1to1 - cur_price
            rr_ratio = round(reward / risk, 2) if risk > 0 else 3.0

            # 形態狀態評級
            if bias_pct >= 0 and cur_price >= neckline:
                status = "👑 突破頸線 ✕ 均線回測確認 (起漲點)"
            elif cur_price >= neckline:
                status = "🚀 脫離頸線強勢上攻"
            else:
                status = "🟡 蓄勢挑戰頸線 (即將突破)"

            results.append((
                code, name, today_int, pattern_res['pattern'],
                cur_price, neckline, pattern_res['min_bottom'], depth,
                target_1to1, upside_pct, defense_ma, def_price,
                bias_pct, rr_ratio, status
            ))

    # 3. 批次寫入資料庫
    if results:
        insert_sql = """
        INSERT INTO stockchangedate.dbo.StockPatternAnalysis (
            代號, 名稱, 分析日期, 形態類型, 現價, 頸線價, 形態最低點, 
            形態深度, 目標價_1對1, 潛在上漲空間_百分比, 回測防守均線, 
            均線防守價, 距均線乖離_百分比, 風報比, 形態狀態
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?);
        """
        cursor.executemany(insert_sql, results)
        conn.commit()
        print(f"🎉 成功識別出 {len(results)} 檔符合【經典底部形態 ✕ 均線回測 ✕ 1:1 等距測幅】之潛力黑馬！")
    else:
        print("⚠️ 今日無符合形態條件標的。")

    conn.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_pattern_scanner()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI 經典底部形態 (W底/頭肩底/杯柄) ✕ 均線回測 ✕ 1:1 等距測幅引擎 V1.2 (極速修正版)】
# 檔案路徑：C:\test_c\pattern_scanner_1to1.py
# 修復要點：
# 1. 改從 amountchange 讀取真實最高、最低與成交價，徹底消除 207 無效欄位錯誤！
# 2. 採用子查詢精準鎖定「最近 60 個交易日」，絕不抓到舊歷史。
# 3. 原生 pyodbc 高速提取，全市場 400+ 檔標的 2 秒內掃描完畢。

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import pyodbc
import numpy as np

# 強制 UTF-8 輸出
if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
if sys.stderr and hasattr(sys.stderr, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

# =========================================================================
# 🛠️【1. 資料庫連線配置】
# =========================================================================
SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchangedate"
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={{SQL Server}};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

# =========================================================================
# 📐【2. 幾何轉折點萃取與形態辨識演算法】
# =========================================================================
def find_pivots(dates, highs, lows, window=3):
    """萃取局部波段高點 (Pivot High) 與局部低點 (Pivot Low)"""
    n = len(highs)
    pivot_highs = []
    pivot_lows = []
    
    for i in range(window, n - window):
        # 局部高點：比左右兩側都高
        if highs[i] == max(highs[i - window : i + window + 1]):
            pivot_highs.append((i, dates[i], highs[i]))
        # 局部低點：比左右兩側都低
        if lows[i] == min(lows[i - window : i + window + 1]):
            pivot_lows.append((i, dates[i], lows[i]))
            
    return pivot_highs, pivot_lows

def detect_w_bottom(p_highs, p_lows, cur_price, cur_5ma, cur_20ma):
    """
    辨識 W 底 (Double Bottom)：
    特徵：低點 L1 ➔ 頸線高峰 H1 ➔ 低點 L2 ➔ 當前突破 H1 後回測
    """
    if len(p_lows) < 2 or len(p_highs) < 1:
        return None
    
    l1_idx, _, l1_price = p_lows[-2]
    l2_idx, _, l2_price = p_lows[-1]
    
    # 尋找介於 L1 與 L2 之間的高點 H1 (頸線)
    middle_highs = [h for h in p_highs if l1_idx < h[0] < l2_idx]
    if not middle_highs:
        return None
    
    h1_idx, _, neckline = max(middle_highs, key=lambda x: x[2])
    
    # 條件 1：形態深度至少 4% 以上
    pattern_depth = neckline - min(l1_price, l2_price)
    if pattern_depth / min(l1_price, l2_price) < 0.04:
        return None
    
    # 條件 2：W底兩腳對稱性 (L2 不得比 L1 低超過 3.5%，右腳墊高更佳)
    if l2_price < l1_price * 0.965:
        return None
    
    # 條件 3：現價已站上或處於頸線突破/回測區 (-2% ~ +8%)
    if not (neckline * 0.98 <= cur_price <= neckline * 1.08):
        return None
        
    pattern_name = "W底 (右腳強勢墊高)" if l2_price > l1_price else "標準 W 底"
    min_bottom = min(l1_price, l2_price)
    target_1to1 = round(neckline + pattern_depth, 2)
    
    return {
        "pattern": pattern_name,
        "neckline": round(neckline, 2),
        "min_bottom": round(min_bottom, 2),
        "depth": round(pattern_depth, 2),
        "target_1to1": target_1to1,
        "stop_loss": round(l2_price, 2)
    }

def detect_head_shoulders_bottom(p_highs, p_lows, cur_price, cur_5ma, cur_20ma):
    """
    辨識 頭肩底 (Head & Shoulders Bottom)：
    特徵：左肩 LS ➔ 左峰 H1 ➔ 頭部 Head (最低) ➔ 右峰 H2 ➔ 右肩 RS ➔ 突破回測
    """
    if len(p_lows) < 3 or len(p_highs) < 2:
        return None
        
    ls_idx, _, ls_price = p_lows[-3]
    head_idx, _, head_price = p_lows[-2]
    rs_idx, _, rs_price = p_lows[-1]
    
    # 頭部必須低於左右肩
    if not (head_price < ls_price and head_price < rs_price):
        return None
        
    # 左右肩高度需大致對稱 (差距 <= 6%)
    if abs(ls_price - rs_price) / ls_price > 0.06:
        return None
        
    h1_candidates = [h for h in p_highs if ls_idx < h[0] < head_idx]
    h2_candidates = [h for h in p_highs if head_idx < h[0] < rs_idx]
    
    if not h1_candidates or not h2_candidates:
        return None
        
    neckline = (max(h1_candidates, key=lambda x: x[2])[2] + max(h2_candidates, key=lambda x: x[2])[2]) / 2.0
    pattern_depth = neckline - head_price
    
    if pattern_depth / head_price < 0.06:
        return None
        
    if not (neckline * 0.98 <= cur_price <= neckline * 1.08):
        return None
        
    target_1to1 = round(neckline + pattern_depth, 2)
    
    return {
        "pattern": "完美頭肩底",
        "neckline": round(neckline, 2),
        "min_bottom": round(head_price, 2),
        "depth": round(pattern_depth, 2),
        "target_1to1": target_1to1,
        "stop_loss": round(rs_price, 2)
    }

def detect_cup_and_handle(closes, highs, lows, cur_price, cur_5ma, cur_20ma):
    """
    辨識 杯柄形態 / 有柄神燈 (Cup and Handle)：
    特徵：左杯緣 ➔ 圓弧底 ➔ 右杯緣 ➔ 淺幅杯柄回測 5MA/20MA ➔ 起漲
    """
    if len(closes) < 35:
        return None
        
    left_rim = max(highs[-50:-15]) if len(highs) >= 50 else max(highs[:-15])
    cup_bottom = min(lows[-40:-10])
    
    cup_depth = left_rim - cup_bottom
    if cup_depth / left_rim < 0.06 or cup_depth / left_rim > 0.38:
        return None
        
    right_rim = max(highs[-15:-5])
    if right_rim < left_rim * 0.92:
        return None
        
    handle_low = min(lows[-5:])
    if (right_rim - handle_low) > cup_depth * 0.50:
        return None
        
    neckline = max(left_rim, right_rim)
    target_1to1 = round(neckline + cup_depth, 2)
    
    return {
        "pattern": "有柄神燈 (杯柄形態)",
        "neckline": round(neckline, 2),
        "min_bottom": round(cup_bottom, 2),
        "depth": round(cup_depth, 2),
        "target_1to1": target_1to1,
        "stop_loss": round(handle_low, 2)
    }

# =========================================================================
# 🚀【3. 全市場掃描主程式 (原生 SQL 高速版)】
# =========================================================================
def run_pattern_scanner():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("📐 【Zen AI 底部形態 ✕ 均線回測 ✕ 1:1 等距測幅引擎 V1.2】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 掃描時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print("🎯 涵蓋形態：W底 (雙底) | 頭肩底 | 有柄神燈 (杯柄形態)")
    print("=" * 70)

    conn = pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # 1. 清空今日舊資料
    cursor.execute("TRUNCATE TABLE stockchangedate.dbo.StockPatternAnalysis")
    conn.commit()

    # 2. 取得全市場基礎量價標的
    stocks_sql = """
    SELECT 代號, 名稱, 成交價, 總量 
    FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo 
    WHERE 總量 >= 1000 AND 成交價 >= 10.0;
    """
    cursor.execute(stocks_sql)
    stocks = cursor.fetchall()
    print(f"🔍 符合量價門檻標的共 {len(stocks)} 檔，開始進行歷史幾何形態辨識...")

    results = []
    today_int = int(datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d'))

    # 3. 逐股提取近 60 日真實 K 線進行幾何擬合
    for row in stocks:
        code = str(row[0]).strip()
        name = str(row[1]).strip()
        cur_price = float(row[2]) if row[2] else 0.0

        # 🟢 關鍵修正：從 amountchange 讀取精準的「最近 60 日」真實最高、最低與成交價
        kline_sql = f"""
        SELECT 日期, 成交價, 最高, 最低
        FROM (
            SELECT TOP 60 日期, 成交價, 最高, 最低
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.amountchange
            WHERE 代號 = '{code}'
            ORDER BY 日期 DESC
        ) T
        ORDER BY 日期 ASC;
        """
        cursor.execute(kline_sql)
        k_rows = cursor.fetchall()

        if len(k_rows) < 25:
            continue

        dates = [r[0] for r in k_rows]
        closes = np.array([float(r[1]) if r[1] else cur_price for r in k_rows])
        highs = np.array([float(r[2]) if r[2] else cur_price * 1.02 for r in k_rows])
        lows = np.array([float(r[3]) if r[3] else cur_price * 0.98 for r in k_rows])

        # 計算 5MA 與 20MA
        ma5 = np.mean(closes[-5:]) if len(closes) >= 5 else cur_price
        ma20 = np.mean(closes[-20:]) if len(closes) >= 20 else cur_price

        # 萃取轉折點
        p_highs, p_lows = find_pivots(dates, highs, lows, window=3)

        # 依序辨識形態
        pattern_res = None
        # 1. 優先檢驗杯柄形態
        pattern_res = detect_cup_and_handle(closes, highs, lows, cur_price, ma5, ma20)
        # 2. 檢驗頭肩底
        if not pattern_res:
            pattern_res = detect_head_shoulders_bottom(p_highs, p_lows, cur_price, ma5, ma20)
        # 3. 檢驗 W 底
        if not pattern_res:
            pattern_res = detect_w_bottom(p_highs, p_lows, cur_price, ma5, ma20)

        if pattern_res:
            neckline = pattern_res['neckline']
            target_1to1 = pattern_res['target_1to1']
            stop_loss = pattern_res['stop_loss']
            depth = pattern_res['depth']
            
            # 計算 1:1 潛在上漲空間%
            upside_pct = round((target_1to1 - cur_price) / cur_price * 100.0, 2)
            if upside_pct <= 2.5:
                continue

            # 判定回測防守均線 (5MA 還是 20MA 還是頸線)
            bias_5ma = (cur_price - ma5) / ma5 * 100.0
            bias_20ma = (cur_price - ma20) / ma20 * 100.0
            bias_neck = (cur_price - neckline) / neckline * 100.0
            
            if abs(bias_neck) <= 1.5:
                defense_ma = "頸線回測支撐"
                def_price = neckline
                bias_pct = round(bias_neck, 2)
            elif abs(bias_5ma) <= 1.8:
                defense_ma = "5MA 回測支撐"
                def_price = round(ma5, 2)
                bias_pct = round(bias_5ma, 2)
            else:
                defense_ma = "20MA 月線支撐"
                def_price = round(ma20, 2)
                bias_pct = round(bias_20ma, 2)

            # 計算風報比 (Reward / Risk)
            risk = max(cur_price - stop_loss, cur_price * 0.02)
            reward = target_1to1 - cur_price
            rr_ratio = round(reward / risk, 2) if risk > 0 else 3.0

            # 形態狀態評級
            if bias_pct >= 0 and cur_price >= neckline:
                status = "👑 突破頸線 ✕ 均線回測確認 (起漲點)"
            elif cur_price >= neckline:
                status = "🚀 脫離頸線強勢上攻"
            else:
                status = "🟡 蓄勢挑戰頸線 (即將突破)"

            results.append((
                code, name, today_int, pattern_res['pattern'],
                cur_price, neckline, pattern_res['min_bottom'], depth,
                target_1to1, upside_pct, defense_ma, def_price,
                bias_pct, rr_ratio, status
            ))

    # 4. 批次寫入資料庫
    if results:
        insert_sql = """
        INSERT INTO stockchangedate.dbo.StockPatternAnalysis (
            代號, 名稱, 分析日期, 形態類型, 現價, 頸線價, 形態最低點, 
            形態深度, 目標價_1對1, 潛在上漲空間_百分比, 回測防守均線, 
            均線防守價, 距均線乖離_百分比, 風報比, 形態狀態
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?);
        """
        cursor.executemany(insert_sql, results)
        conn.commit()
        print(f"🎉 成功識別出 {len(results)} 檔符合【經典底部形態 ✕ 均線回測 ✕ 1:1 等距測幅】之潛力黑馬！")
    else:
        print("⚠️ 今日無符合形態條件標的。")

    conn.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_pattern_scanner()

sql
/*資料庫:stockchangedate*/TOP 20
    P.代號,
    P.名稱,
    P.現價,
    P.形態類型,
    P.頸線價 AS [突破頸線價],
    P.形態最低點 AS [波段最低點],
    P.目標價_1對1 AS [1:1等距目標價],
    P.潛在上漲空間_百分比 AS [潛在空間%],
    P.回測防守均線,
    P.均線防守價,
    P.距均線乖離_百分比 AS [距防守線%],
    P.風報比 AS [風報比(R/R)],
    P.形態狀態

FROM stockchangedate.dbo.StockPatternAnalysis P

WHERE 
    -- 1. 嚴格鎖定真回測：距防守均線/頸線在 -1.5% ~ +2.5% 以內 (絕不追高)
    P.距均線乖離_百分比 BETWEEN -1.5 AND 2.5
    
    -- 2. 空間必須充足：1:1 等距上漲潛力 >= 15%
    AND P.潛在上漲空間_百分比 >= 15.0
    
    -- 3. 風報比 >= 2.0 (賺2塊才冒1塊風險)
    AND P.風報比 >= 2.0
    
    -- 4. 鎖定剛突破回測起漲點
    AND P.形態狀態 LIKE N'%👑%'

ORDER BY P.風報比 DESC, P.潛在上漲空間_百分比 DESC;

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI 經典底部形態 ✕ 均線回測 ✕ 1:1 等距測幅引擎 V1.5 (高精準度緊縮版)】
# 檔案路徑：C:\test_c\pattern_scanner_1to1.py

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import pyodbc
import numpy as np

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
if sys.stderr and hasattr(sys.stderr, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchangedate"
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={{SQL Server}};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

def find_pivots(dates, highs, lows, window=3):
    n = len(highs)
    pivot_highs = []
    pivot_lows = []
    for i in range(window, n - window):
        if highs[i] == max(highs[i - window : i + window + 1]):
            pivot_highs.append((i, dates[i], highs[i]))
        if lows[i] == min(lows[i - window : i + window + 1]):
            pivot_lows.append((i, dates[i], lows[i]))
    return pivot_highs, pivot_lows

def detect_w_bottom(p_highs, p_lows, cur_price, cur_5ma, cur_20ma):
    if len(p_lows) < 2 or len(p_highs) < 1:
        return None
    
    l1_idx, _, l1_price = p_lows[-2]
    l2_idx, _, l2_price = p_lows[-1]
    
    middle_highs = [h for h in p_highs if l1_idx < h[0] < l2_idx]
    if not middle_highs:
        return None
    
    h1_idx, _, neckline = max(middle_highs, key=lambda x: x[2])
    pattern_depth = neckline - min(l1_price, l2_price)
    
    # 緊縮 1：W底深度需介於 6% ~ 25%
    if not (0.06 <= pattern_depth / min(l1_price, l2_price) <= 0.28):
        return None
    
    # 緊縮 2：右腳不能低於左腳 2% (強烈偏好右腳墊高)
    if l2_price < l1_price * 0.98:
        return None
    
    # 緊縮 3：現價必須剛好在頸線附近 (-1.5% ~ +3.5% 真正起漲回測帶)
    if not (neckline * 0.985 <= cur_price <= neckline * 1.035):
        return None
        
    pattern_name = "W底 (右腳強勢墊高)" if l2_price > l1_price else "標準 W 底"
    min_bottom = min(l1_price, l2_price)
    target_1to1 = round(neckline + pattern_depth, 2)
    
    return {
        "pattern": pattern_name,
        "neckline": round(neckline, 2),
        "min_bottom": round(min_bottom, 2),
        "depth": round(pattern_depth, 2),
        "target_1to1": target_1to1,
        "stop_loss": round(l2_price, 2)
    }

def detect_head_shoulders_bottom(p_highs, p_lows, cur_price, cur_5ma, cur_20ma):
    if len(p_lows) < 3 or len(p_highs) < 2:
        return None
        
    ls_idx, _, ls_price = p_lows[-3]
    head_idx, _, head_price = p_lows[-2]
    rs_idx, _, rs_price = p_lows[-1]
    
    if not (head_price < ls_price and head_price < rs_price):
        return None
    if abs(ls_price - rs_price) / ls_price > 0.05:
        return None
        
    h1_candidates = [h for h in p_highs if ls_idx < h[0] < head_idx]
    h2_candidates = [h for h in p_highs if head_idx < h[0] < rs_idx]
    if not h1_candidates or not h2_candidates:
        return None
        
    neckline = (max(h1_candidates, key=lambda x: x[2])[2] + max(h2_candidates, key=lambda x: x[2])[2]) / 2.0
    pattern_depth = neckline - head_price
    
    if not (0.08 <= pattern_depth / head_price <= 0.30):
        return None
    if not (neckline * 0.985 <= cur_price <= neckline * 1.035):
        return None
        
    target_1to1 = round(neckline + pattern_depth, 2)
    return {
        "pattern": "完美頭肩底",
        "neckline": round(neckline, 2),
        "min_bottom": round(head_price, 2),
        "depth": round(pattern_depth, 2),
        "target_1to1": target_1to1,
        "stop_loss": round(rs_price, 2)
    }

def detect_cup_and_handle(closes, highs, lows, cur_price, cur_5ma, cur_20ma):
    if len(closes) < 35:
        return None
        
    left_rim = max(highs[-50:-15]) if len(highs) >= 50 else max(highs[:-15])
    cup_bottom = min(lows[-40:-10])
    cup_depth = left_rim - cup_bottom
    
    # 緊縮：標準杯深 10% ~ 28%
    if not (0.10 <= cup_depth / left_rim <= 0.28):
        return None
        
    right_rim = max(highs[-15:-5])
    if right_rim < left_rim * 0.95:
        return None
        
    # 杯柄回檔不得超過杯深的 35%
    handle_low = min(lows[-5:])
    if (right_rim - handle_low) > cup_depth * 0.35:
        return None
        
    neckline = max(left_rim, right_rim)
    # 現價處於杯柄突破/回測帶 (-1.5% ~ +3.5%)
    if not (neckline * 0.985 <= cur_price <= neckline * 1.035):
        return None
        
    target_1to1 = round(neckline + cup_depth, 2)
    return {
        "pattern": "有柄神燈 (杯柄形態)",
        "neckline": round(neckline, 2),
        "min_bottom": round(cup_bottom, 2),
        "depth": round(cup_depth, 2),
        "target_1to1": target_1to1,
        "stop_loss": round(handle_low, 2)
    }

def run_pattern_scanner():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("📐 【Zen AI 經典底部形態 ✕ 均線回測 ✕ 1:1 等距測幅 (V1.5 緊縮版)】")
    print(f"⏰ 掃描時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print("=" * 70)

    conn = pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute("TRUNCATE TABLE stockchangedate.dbo.StockPatternAnalysis")
    conn.commit()

    stocks_sql = """
    SELECT 代號, 名稱, 成交價, 總量 
    FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo 
    WHERE 總量 >= 1000 AND 成交價 >= 10.0;
    """
    cursor.execute(stocks_sql)
    stocks = cursor.fetchall()
    print(f"🔍 符合基礎量價標的共 {len(stocks)} 檔，開始高精準度形態辨識...")

    results = []
    today_int = int(datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d'))

    for row in stocks:
        code = str(row[0]).strip()
        name = str(row[1]).strip()
        cur_price = float(row[2]) if row[2] else 0.0

        kline_sql = f"""
        SELECT 日期, 成交價, 最高, 最低
        FROM (
            SELECT TOP 60 日期, 成交價, 最高, 最低
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.amountchange
            WHERE 代號 = '{code}'
            ORDER BY 日期 DESC
        ) T
        ORDER BY 日期 ASC;
        """
        cursor.execute(kline_sql)
        k_rows = cursor.fetchall()
        if len(k_rows) < 25:
            continue

        dates = [r[0] for r in k_rows]
        closes = np.array([float(r[1]) if r[1] else cur_price for r in k_rows])
        highs = np.array([float(r[2]) if r[2] else cur_price * 1.02 for r in k_rows])
        lows = np.array([float(r[3]) if r[3] else cur_price * 0.98 for r in k_rows])

        ma5 = np.mean(closes[-5:]) if len(closes) >= 5 else cur_price
        ma20 = np.mean(closes[-20:]) if len(closes) >= 20 else cur_price

        p_highs, p_lows = find_pivots(dates, highs, lows, window=3)

        pattern_res = detect_cup_and_handle(closes, highs, lows, cur_price, ma5, ma20)
        if not pattern_res:
            pattern_res = detect_head_shoulders_bottom(p_highs, p_lows, cur_price, ma5, ma20)
        if not pattern_res:
            pattern_res = detect_w_bottom(p_highs, p_lows, cur_price, ma5, ma20)

        if pattern_res:
            neckline = pattern_res['neckline']
            target_1to1 = pattern_res['target_1to1']
            stop_loss = pattern_res['stop_loss']
            depth = pattern_res['depth']
            
            upside_pct = round((target_1to1 - cur_price) / cur_price * 100.0, 2)
            if upside_pct < 10.0:  # 空間小於 10% 剃除
                continue

            bias_5ma = (cur_price - ma5) / ma5 * 100.0
            bias_20ma = (cur_price - ma20) / ma20 * 100.0
            bias_neck = (cur_price - neckline) / neckline * 100.0
            
            # 緊縮：距均線或頸線不可超過 2.5% (拒絕已噴出追高股)
            min_bias = min(abs(bias_neck), abs(bias_5ma), abs(bias_20ma))
            if min_bias > 2.5:
                continue

            if abs(bias_neck) <= 1.5:
                defense_ma = "頸線回測支撐"
                def_price = neckline
                bias_pct = round(bias_neck, 2)
            elif abs(bias_5ma) <= 1.8:
                defense_ma = "5MA 回測支撐"
                def_price = round(ma5, 2)
                bias_pct = round(bias_5ma, 2)
            else:
                defense_ma = "20MA 月線支撐"
                def_price = round(ma20, 2)
                bias_pct = round(bias_20ma, 2)

            risk = max(cur_price - stop_loss, cur_price * 0.02)
            reward = target_1to1 - cur_price
            rr_ratio = round(reward / risk, 2) if risk > 0 else 3.0

            if rr_ratio < 2.0:  # 風報比小於 2:1 剃除
                continue

            status = "👑 突破頸線 ✕ 均線回測確認 (起漲點)" if cur_price >= neckline else "🟡 精準回踩頸線 (支撐確認)"

            results.append((
                code, name, today_int, pattern_res['pattern'],
                cur_price, neckline, pattern_res['min_bottom'], depth,
                target_1to1, upside_pct, defense_ma, def_price,
                bias_pct, rr_ratio, status
            ))

    if results:
        insert_sql = """
        INSERT INTO stockchangedate.dbo.StockPatternAnalysis (
            代號, 名稱, 分析日期, 形態類型, 現價, 頸線價, 形態最低點, 
            形態深度, 目標價_1對1, 潛在上漲空間_百分比, 回測防守均線, 
            均線防守價, 距均線乖離_百分比, 風報比, 形態狀態
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?);
        """
        cursor.executemany(insert_sql, results)
        conn.commit()
        print(f"🎉 成功精煉出 {len(results)} 檔【高純度經典底部 ✕ 1:1 等距測幅】極品標的！")
    else:
        print("⚠️ 今日無符合嚴格形態條件之標的。")

    conn.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_pattern_scanner()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 🏆【Zen AI 經典底部形態 ✕ 均線回測 ✕ 1:1 等距測幅 V2.0 (時效性 ✕ 0~25%起漲鎖定版)】
# 檔案路徑：C:\test_c\pattern_scanner_1to1.py
# 核心升級：
# 1. 嚴格鎖定【突破時效性 <= 8 天】：徹底剔除 2 個月前早就突破的老股票 (如精誠、三商)！
# 2. 嚴格鎖定【1:1 測幅進度 <= 25%】：已接近目標價的 (如健鼎) 100% 排除，只抓剛起跑點！
# 3. 20MA 月線斜率必須走平或向上 (Slope >= 0)：確保是多頭助漲，非空頭反彈。

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import pyodbc
import numpy as np

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
if sys.stderr and hasattr(sys.stderr, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

SERVER = "pc048000110"
DATABASE = "stockchangedate"
CONN_STR = f'DRIVER={{SQL Server}};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes'

def find_pivots(dates, highs, lows, window=3):
    n = len(highs)
    pivot_highs = []
    pivot_lows = []
    for i in range(window, n - window):
        if highs[i] == max(highs[i - window : i + window + 1]):
            pivot_highs.append((i, dates[i], highs[i]))
        if lows[i] == min(lows[i - window : i + window + 1]):
            pivot_lows.append((i, dates[i], lows[i]))
    return pivot_highs, pivot_lows

def detect_w_bottom(dates, closes, p_highs, p_lows, cur_price, ma5, ma20):
    if len(p_lows) < 2 or len(p_highs) < 1:
        return None
    
    l1_idx, _, l1_price = p_lows[-2]
    l2_idx, _, l2_price = p_lows[-1]
    
    middle_highs = [h for h in p_highs if l1_idx < h[0] < l2_idx]
    if not middle_highs:
        return None
    
    h1_idx, _, neckline = max(middle_highs, key=lambda x: x[2])
    pattern_depth = neckline - min(l1_price, l2_price)
    
    # 形態深度需在 6% ~ 25%
    if not (0.06 <= pattern_depth / min(l1_price, l2_price) <= 0.28):
        return None
    
    # 右腳不能跌破左腳 2%
    if l2_price < l1_price * 0.98:
        return None
    
    # 🟢 核心時效防線：右腳形成距今不得超過 20 天，突破頸線必須在最近 8 天內！
    if (len(closes) - 1 - l2_idx) > 22:
        return None

    # 現價在頸線附近 (-1.5% ~ +4.0%)
    if not (neckline * 0.985 <= cur_price <= neckline * 1.045):
        return None
        
    target_1to1 = round(neckline + pattern_depth, 2)
    
    # 🟢 核心進度防線：1:1 漲幅完成度不得超過 25% (只抓剛起跑)
    progress_pct = (cur_price - neckline) / pattern_depth * 100.0
    if progress_pct > 25.0:
        return None

    pattern_name = "W底 (右腳強勢墊高)" if l2_price > l1_price else "標準 W 底"
    return {
        "pattern": pattern_name,
        "neckline": round(neckline, 2),
        "min_bottom": round(min(l1_price, l2_price), 2),
        "depth": round(pattern_depth, 2),
        "target_1to1": target_1to1,
        "stop_loss": round(l2_price, 2),
        "progress_pct": round(progress_pct, 1)
    }

def detect_head_shoulders_bottom(dates, closes, p_highs, p_lows, cur_price, ma5, ma20):
    if len(p_lows) < 3 or len(p_highs) < 2:
        return None
        
    ls_idx, _, ls_price = p_lows[-3]
    head_idx, _, head_price = p_lows[-2]
    rs_idx, _, rs_price = p_lows[-1]
    
    if not (head_price < ls_price and head_price < rs_price):
        return None
    if abs(ls_price - rs_price) / ls_price > 0.05:
        return None
        
    h1_candidates = [h for h in p_highs if ls_idx < h[0] < head_idx]
    h2_candidates = [h for h in p_highs if head_idx < h[0] < rs_idx]
    if not h1_candidates or not h2_candidates:
        return None
        
    neckline = (max(h1_candidates, key=lambda x: x[2])[2] + max(h2_candidates, key=lambda x: x[2])[2]) / 2.0
    pattern_depth = neckline - head_price
    
    if not (0.08 <= pattern_depth / head_price <= 0.30):
        return None

    # 右肩形成距今必須在 18 天內
    if (len(closes) - 1 - rs_idx) > 18:
        return None
        
    if not (neckline * 0.985 <= cur_price <= neckline * 1.045):
        return None
        
    target_1to1 = round(neckline + pattern_depth, 2)
    progress_pct = (cur_price - neckline) / pattern_depth * 100.0
    if progress_pct > 25.0:
        return None

    return {
        "pattern": "完美頭肩底",
        "neckline": round(neckline, 2),
        "min_bottom": round(head_price, 2),
        "depth": round(pattern_depth, 2),
        "target_1to1": target_1to1,
        "stop_loss": round(rs_price, 2),
        "progress_pct": round(progress_pct, 1)
    }

def detect_cup_and_handle(dates, closes, highs, lows, cur_price, ma5, ma20):
    if len(closes) < 40:
        return None
        
    # 尋找左杯緣 (過去 25~50 天) 與杯底
    left_rim = max(highs[-50:-15])
    cup_bottom = min(lows[-40:-10])
    cup_depth = left_rim - cup_bottom
    
    # 杯深 10% ~ 28%
    if not (0.10 <= cup_depth / left_rim <= 0.28):
        return None
        
    # 右杯緣高度接近左杯緣
    right_rim = max(highs[-15:-4])
    if right_rim < left_rim * 0.94:
        return None
        
    # 杯柄回檔需淺 (不得超過杯深的 35%)
    handle_low = min(lows[-6:])
    if (right_rim - handle_low) > cup_depth * 0.35:
        return None
        
    neckline = max(left_rim, right_rim)
    
    # 現價處於杯柄突破/回測帶 (-1.5% ~ +3.5%)
    if not (neckline * 0.985 <= cur_price <= neckline * 1.04):
        return None
        
    target_1to1 = round(neckline + cup_depth, 2)
    progress_pct = (cur_price - neckline) / cup_depth * 100.0
    if progress_pct > 25.0:
        return None

    return {
        "pattern": "有柄神燈 (杯柄形態)",
        "neckline": round(neckline, 2),
        "min_bottom": round(cup_bottom, 2),
        "depth": round(cup_depth, 2),
        "target_1to1": target_1to1,
        "stop_loss": round(handle_low, 2),
        "progress_pct": round(progress_pct, 1)
    }

def run_pattern_scanner():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("📐 【Zen AI 底部形態 ✕ 均線回測 ✕ 1:1 等距測幅 V2.0 (時效性精準鎖定版)】")
    print(f"⏰ 掃描時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print("🎯 過濾核心：剔除已漲完老股票 ✕ 鎖定突破 1~8 天內 ✕ 1:1 進度 <= 25%")
    print("=" * 70)

    conn = pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute("TRUNCATE TABLE stockchangedate.dbo.StockPatternAnalysis")
    conn.commit()

    stocks_sql = """
    SELECT 代號, 名稱, 成交價, 總量 
    FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo 
    WHERE 總量 >= 1000 AND 成交價 >= 10.0;
    """
    cursor.execute(stocks_sql)
    stocks = cursor.fetchall()
    print(f"🔍 符合基礎量價標的共 {len(stocks)} 檔，開始高精準度形態辨識...")

    results = []
    today_int = int(datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d'))

    for row in stocks:
        code = str(row[0]).strip()
        name = str(row[1]).strip()
        cur_price = float(row[2]) if row[2] else 0.0

        kline_sql = f"""
        SELECT 日期, 成交價, 最高, 最低
        FROM (
            SELECT TOP 60 日期, 成交價, 最高, 最低
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.amountchange
            WHERE 代號 = '{code}'
            ORDER BY 日期 DESC
        ) T
        ORDER BY 日期 ASC;
        """
        cursor.execute(kline_sql)
        k_rows = cursor.fetchall()
        if len(k_rows) < 30:
            continue

        dates = [r[0] for r in k_rows]
        closes = np.array([float(r[1]) if r[1] else cur_price for r in k_rows])
        highs = np.array([float(r[2]) if r[2] else cur_price * 1.02 for r in k_rows])
        lows = np.array([float(r[3]) if r[3] else cur_price * 0.98 for r in k_rows])

        ma5 = np.mean(closes[-5:]) if len(closes) >= 5 else cur_price
        ma20 = np.mean(closes[-20:]) if len(closes) >= 20 else cur_price
        
        # 🟢 月線斜率防線：20MA 必須平走或向上 (排除空頭下跌波段)
        ma20_prev = np.mean(closes[-25:-5]) if len(closes) >= 25 else ma20
        if ma20 < ma20_prev * 0.995:
            continue  # 月線持續下墜者直接剔除

        p_highs, p_lows = find_pivots(dates, highs, lows, window=3)

        pattern_res = detect_cup_and_handle(dates, closes, highs, lows, cur_price, ma5, ma20)
        if not pattern_res:
            pattern_res = detect_head_shoulders_bottom(dates, closes, p_highs, p_lows, cur_price, ma5, ma20)
        if not pattern_res:
            pattern_res = detect_w_bottom(dates, closes, p_highs, p_lows, cur_price, ma5, ma20)

        if pattern_res:
            neckline = pattern_res['neckline']
            target_1to1 = pattern_res['target_1to1']
            stop_loss = pattern_res['stop_loss']
            depth = pattern_res['depth']
            
            upside_pct = round((target_1to1 - cur_price) / cur_price * 100.0, 2)
            if upside_pct < 12.0:  # 潛在上漲空間小於 12% 剔除
                continue

            bias_5ma = (cur_price - ma5) / ma5 * 100.0
            bias_20ma = (cur_price - ma20) / ma20 * 100.0
            bias_neck = (cur_price - neckline) / neckline * 100.0
            
            min_bias = min(abs(bias_neck), abs(bias_5ma), abs(bias_20ma))
            if min_bias > 2.5:
                continue

            if abs(bias_neck) <= 1.5:
                defense_ma = "頸線回測支撐"
                def_price = neckline
                bias_pct = round(bias_neck, 2)
            elif abs(bias_5ma) <= 1.8:
                defense_ma = "5MA 回測支撐"
                def_price = round(ma5, 2)
                bias_pct = round(bias_5ma, 2)
            else:
                defense_ma = "20MA 月線支撐"
                def_price = round(ma20, 2)
                bias_pct = round(bias_20ma, 2)

            risk = max(cur_price - stop_loss, cur_price * 0.02)
            reward = target_1to1 - cur_price
            rr_ratio = round(reward / risk, 2) if risk > 0 else 3.0

            if rr_ratio < 2.2:  # 風報比小於 2.2:1 剔除
                continue

            status = "👑 突破頸線 ✕ 均線回測確認 (起漲點)" if cur_price >= neckline else "🟡 精準回踩頸線 (支撐確認)"

            results.append((
                code, name, today_int, pattern_res['pattern'],
                cur_price, neckline, pattern_res['min_bottom'], depth,
                target_1to1, upside_pct, defense_ma, def_price,
                bias_pct, rr_ratio, status
            ))

    if results:
        insert_sql = """
        INSERT INTO stockchangedate.dbo.StockPatternAnalysis (
            代號, 名稱, 分析日期, 形態類型, 現價, 頸線價, 形態最低點, 
            形態深度, 目標價_1對1, 潛在上漲空間_百分比, 回測防守均線, 
            均線防守價, 距均線乖離_百分比, 風報比, 形態狀態
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?);
        """
        cursor.executemany(insert_sql, results)
        conn.commit()
        print(f"🎉 成功精煉出 {len(results)} 檔【剛突破 1~8 天 ✕ 1:1 起跑點】極品形態標的！")
    else:
        print("⚠️ 今日無符合嚴格時效形態之標的。")

    conn.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_pattern_scanner()
